For a given $Γ$-labeled graph with two specified vertices (or edges), we can determine in linear time whether there exist two cycles with distinct labels that are through both of the two specified vertices (or edges), and find such cycles if yes.

AI.tldr: Deterministic linear-time algorithm for finding odd cycles through two specified vertices in undirected graphs, generalized to Γ-labeled graphs with order-at-most-2 group elements.
AI.motivation: Find an odd cycle passing through two specified vertices in undirected graphs, and extend this to labeled graph settings.
AI.method: Deterministic linear-time algorithm based on group-theoretic analysis for Γ-labeled graphs with order-≤-2 elements.
AI.result: Linear-time determination of whether two cycles with distinct labels exist through specified vertices/edges, with constructive finding capability.
AI.conclusion: Solved the odd cycle detection problem through two specified vertices in linear time, with generalization to Γ-labeled graphs where group elements have order ≤ 2.

title: Usable Agent Discovery for Decentralized AI Systems
summary: Large-scale agentic systems run on distributed infrastructures where many software agents share physical hosts and are discovered via peer-to-peer mechanisms. Discovery must handle node-level churn from failures and host departures and agent-level churn from demand-driven activation, deactivation, and state changes. Their interaction reshapes classic trade-offs between structured and unstructured overlays. We study decentralized agent discovery under this two-level churn, assuming nodes host multiple agents, overlays are structured or gossip-based, and agents switch between warm and cold states. Using Kademlia as a structured and Cyclon+Vicinity as a gossip baseline, we compare stable, node-churn-only, agent-cooling-only, and combined regimes to see when routing efficiency, resilience, and service readiness align or favor different designs. Structured overlays are more robust and efficient in stable and node-churn regimes, while gossip-based overlays remain competitive and can be faster when readiness dominates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大规模分布式智能体系统中"去中心化智能体发现"的设计权衡。当物理节点（节点级 churn：故障/离开/恢复）与宿主智能体（智能体级 churn：按需激活/冷却）同时动态时，结构化覆盖网（Kademlia）与 gossip 型非结构化覆盖网（Cyclon+Vicinity）不存在单一赢家。结论：结构化覆盖网在成功率与"有用可用性"上系统性更强，且在稳定与节点 churn 场景下优势明显；但 gossip 覆盖网维护流量低得多，且在多个操作点上延迟更优。当智能体激进冷却（readiness 成为瓶颈）时，Kademlia 的优势被冷启动成本抵消；而在组合不稳定下最严重的失效更像是"陈旧路由"而非"陈旧主机信念"所致。核心度量是"有用可用性" U_Δ：在给定时延预算 Δ 内成功提供服务的期望比例。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体系统（如 AGNTCY）大规模部署到分布式基础设施上，大量软件智能体共址于同一物理主机，并通过点对点机制被发现。经典 P2P 文献将发现目标等同于节点本身，但多智能体基础设施打破了这一假设：发现不仅要定位可达主机，还要定位"可用"执行目标——主机可达、路由正确，但目标智能体可能处于 cold（已冷却、需冷启动）或 off 状态，此时对用户而言仍是失败请求。此外，已有对比通常将节点不稳定与智能体生命周期视为彼此分离的两个问题，而实际中二者耦合且压力机制不同：节点故障一次性移除一批智能体并破坏覆盖网连通性，智能体冷却则只影响服务就绪度而不改变主机可达性。作者因此主张把"节点级 churn"与"智能体级 churn"分离建模，并引入有用可用性指标 U_Δ，把评估问题从"哪个覆盖网更快"重述为"在哪种运行条件下鲁棒性才能转化为可用性"。目标不是评选普遍最优的覆盖网，而是识别出结构化与 gossip 方案各自被何种运行条件所偏好。
AI.method: 采用基于事件驱动的 SimPy 仿真器，物理节点各自承载多个智能体并加入结构化或非结构化覆盖网。结构化基线为 Kademlia（与 AGNTCY 相同的索引底座，复制因子 3、α=3、桶大小 8、publish TTL 60、重发布周期 20）；非结构化基线为 Cyclon+Vicinity（对数请求 TTL、Cyclon 缓存 20、shuffle 长度 5、Vicinity 缓存 10、shuffle 周期 20）。变更五个因素族：覆盖网类型、节点级 churn、智能体冷却策略、冷启动成本、工作负载结构；多随机种子并给出置信区间。默认合成实验为 2048 物理主机、4096 逻辑智能体（每主机 2 个）、50 个技能、每个智能体暴露 1 个技能、top_k=1，请求源自内部节点；底层网络为 Erdős–Rényi 图，零丢包、单位基础时延。五个实验族：E1 稳定基线、E2 仅节点 churn、E3 仅智能体冷却、E4 组合 churn 阶梯（核心）、E5 工作负载敏感性（后置）。主阶梯 80 周期 × 5 次重复，请求率 0.15，预热 25；稳定基线 60 周期 × 5 次重复，请求率 0.125，预热 20。观测指标：端到端时延 L(q,a)=L_disc+L_route+L_start、成功率 S(q,a)（发现且主机可达）、有用可用性 U_Δ(q,a)=E[u_Δ(L)]、消息开销（区分请求平面与后台维护平面）。图 2–6 为主视图（时延/开销权衡、维护成本、退化阶梯、成功率、U_Δ 曲线、语义稀疏性消融）。另设两个定向探针：维护强度探针（无预热、密集 gossip、Vicinity 密集、Kademlia 激进重发布；1024 智能体/512 主机）与陈旧性诊断探针（主机信念压力 vs 路由压力 vs 密集 gossip 救援；512 智能体/256 主机）。
AI.result: 稳定基线下，Kademlia 在成功率与 p95 时延上更优，但请求平面消息差距不大；主要差异在维护开销——Kademlia 因索引发布与刷新产生远高于 gossip 的后台流量，即结构化用更高的维护代价换取鲁棒查找。两族沿不同成本-质量前沿移动，"更多维护"不是通用恢复手段：密集 gossip 使开销增加约一个数量级却几乎不改善时延，Kademlia 激进重发布同样大幅增加流量而收益有限。仅节点 churn 时，Kademlia 成功率持续更鲁棒，但激进 churn 下时延优势可能转向 Cyclon+Vicinity。仅智能体冷却时，成功率差距压缩甚至轻微反转，而 Kademlia 仍保有更低 p95 时延——说明节点 churn 压力落在路由鲁棒性与维护，冷却压力落在就绪度与冷启动。组合 churn 下呈强烈区制依赖：轻度组合时成功率接近而非结构化明显胜出，且非结构化明显更快；中度时 Kademlia 重获小幅成功率优势、时延差收窄；激进档时两者急剧退化但 Kademlia 成功率仍更鲁棒。U_Δ 曲线显示 Kademlia 在稳定与节点 churn 区制 tight budget 下占优，而在激进冷却下曲线趋于平坦、Cyclon+Vicinity 随预算放宽反而改善，印证"readiness 主导 routing"。语义稀疏性影响主要出现在高度专业化情形（每智能体 1 技能、任务数增加时两覆盖网差异明显），当智能体技能较宽（[1,3] 或 [2,5]）时 p95 时延与开销曲线明显靠拢，两族均近满成功率，权衡退化为时延 vs 开销。定向探针显示：在参考诊断区制中 Kademlia 可近乎全面崩溃而 Cyclon+Vicinity 仍实现部分发现；当压力偏向主机信念时 Kademlia 恢复大部分预期强度，而偏向路由压力时即便加大缓解措施仍显脆弱；密集 gossip 救援也无法重建可信的质量优势，说明组合不稳定下的严重失效更符合"陈旧路由"解释。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化发现应被视为双层 churn 问题，结构化与非结构化覆盖网处于不同区制而非存在单一赢家；评估必须同时看查找效率、鲁棒性与就绪度，U_Δ 是可用服务的关键度量而非次要指标。三点结论：(1) 有用可用性而非成功率本身揭示路由鲁棒性何时转化为及时服务——稳定与节点 churn 区制下 Kademlia 即使在紧时延预算也能把成功率优势转化为近乎完整的 U_Δ，而在激进冷却下因冷启动主导而失效；(2) 维护模式与失效模式分化——结构化持续付出维护成本以保持索引新鲜，gossip 按需付费；组合不稳定下多数失效源于陈旧路由而非陈旧主机信念；(3) 语义稀疏性仅在极端专业化下才重要，当智能体技能适度宽泛后权衡退化为时延 vs 开销。选型应依据 churn、SLO 而非仅渐近查找成本：严格时延与鲁棒性需求偏向结构化，成本敏感且容忍优雅降级者偏向 gossip。后续方向：一是混合方案（稳定期用结构化查找，路由表衰变时回退到非结构化修复）；二是请求感知的生命周期管理，使智能体温态与覆盖网健康度、预测需求对齐，把 U_Δ 从诊断指标变为控制目标。

title: Artificial General Intelligence Forecasting and Scenario Analysis: State of the Field, Methodological Gaps, and Strategic Implications
summary: In this report, we review the current state of methodologies to forecast the arrival of artificial general intelligence, assess their reliability, and analyze the implications for strategy and policy. We synthesize diverse forecasting approaches, document significant limitations in existing methods, and propose a research agenda for developing more-robust forecasting infrastructure. The report does not endorse a specific forecast or scenario but rather provides a framework for interpreting forecasts under conditions of deep uncertainty. We experimented with an iterative approach to human and artificial intelligence collaboration for this report. The primary drafting of the text was performed by large language models (GPT 5.1, Gemini 3 Pro, and Claude 4.5 Opus), with human researchers providing direction, peer review, fact-checking, and revision.

AI.tldr: 这是一份元层面的AGI预测方法论综述报告，旨在评估和改进AGI到来时间预测的可靠性，为战略决策提供更robust的分析框架，而非给出具体的AGI时间表预测。
AI.motivation: 核心动机：随着AGI发展日益逼近，现有预测方法缺乏系统评估，可靠性存疑；政策制定者和战略规划者需要在深度不确定性条件下做出决策，却缺少可靠的分析框架。
AI.method: 研究方法包括：综合梳理现有预测方法论体系，识别并记录当前方法的重大局限性，实验性采用多LLM协作迭代的AI辅助写作流程（GPT 5.1、Gemini 3 Pro、Claude 4.5 Opus），人类研究员提供方向指引、同行评审、事实核查与修订。
AI.result: 核心产出：提供了在深度不确定性条件下解读AGI预测的通用框架；系统梳理了预测方法论的现状；识别了现有方法的关键局限；提出了加强预测基础设施的研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 该报告不提供具体预测，而是提供基础设施建议和未来研究方向，为政策制定者提供在深度不确定性下评估AGI预测的框架工具。Meta层面值得注意：报告本身采用了人机协作方式撰写，体现了AI辅助科学写作的实践探索。

title: BiTA: Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit-Transformer Aggregator in a Temporal Graph Network Framework for Alert Prediction in Computer Networks
summary: Proactive alert prediction in computer networks is critical for mitigating evolving cyber threats and enabling timely defensive actions. Temporal Graph Neural Networks (TGNs) provide a principled framework for modeling time-evolving interactions; however, existing TGN-based methods predominantly rely on unidirectional or single-mechanism temporal aggregation, which limits their ability to capture recursive, multi-scale temporal patterns commonly observed in real-world attack behaviors. In this paper, we propose BiTA, a Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit-Transformer Aggregator for temporal graph learning. Rather than introducing a deeper or higher-capacity model, BiTA redesigns the temporal aggregation function within the TGN framework by jointly encoding bidirectional sequential dependencies and long-range contextual relations over each node's temporal neighborhood. This aggregation strategy enables complementary temporal reasoning at different scales while preserving the original TGN memory and message-passing structure. We evaluate BiTA on real-world alert datasets, demonstrating significant improvements in key performance metrics such as area under the curve, average precision, mean reciprocal rank, and per-category prediction accuracy when compared to state-of-the-art temporal graph models. BiTA outperforms baseline methods under both transductive and inductive settings, highlighting its robustness and generalization capabilities in dynamic network environments. BiTA is a scalable and interpretable framework for real-time cyber threat anticipation, paving the way toward more intelligent and adaptive intrusion detection systems.

AI.tldr: BiTA 在 TGN 框架内把"启发式消息聚合（mean/last）"替换为"BiGRU 双向时序建模 + Transformer 多头自注意力"的可学习聚合器，在保持内存机制、因果性与参数量（2,381）不变的前提下，于 CESNET Warden 告警数据与 NF-UNSW-NB15-v2 上取得优于 TGN/DyRep/EdgeBank/TIDFormer/TF-TGN 等基线的链路预测与告警类别分类性能，并具备毫秒级在线推理能力。
AI.motivation: 1）任务需求：网络攻击呈多阶段、自适应、强时序相关，SOC/CERT 需要在告警爆发前做"主动预测"，不仅预测是否发生告警（链路预测），还要预测告警类别（多分类），以缓解告警疲劳并预判攻击升级路径。2）方法瓶颈：TGN 的内存模块是循环的，但其聚合算子（mean/last）是不可学习的、置换不变且时间短视的，丢弃了交互序列内部的时间结构，把所有历史消息等同看待，无法刻画真实攻击中的递归（间隔约 2–3 分钟的规律性攻击）、延迟、双向时序模式。3）已有替代方案不足：GRU/LSTM 等单向编码器无法用后续上下文回溯修正历史表示；DyRep 依赖时间点过程强度，EdgeBank 依赖近邻性/频次启发式；TIDFormer、TF-TGN、EasyDGL、TransformerG2G 等多为注意力式或单向时序编码，缺乏"可学习 + 双向 + 递归"的聚合机制。4）因此核心问题为：如何在不破坏 TGN 内存与消息传递结构、不牺牲归纳泛化能力的前提下，为 TGN 注入一个表达力强、时间感知、可学习的时序聚合函数。
AI.method:
【总体思路】不加深/不扩容，而是重构 TGN 的消息聚合环节，实现"聚合层（可学习）+ 读出层（池化）"解耦。
【流程】①消息构造 m=MSG(u,v,e,t)；②对每个目标节点按时间排序其历史入向消息序列 M_v^(t)；③连续时间编码 x=m+TimeEnc(t)（Bochner 式）；④BiGRU 对时间有序序列做前向+后向建模，取末隐状态 z_temp（式4–5）；⑤线性投影 W_e 映射到 Transformer 空间，经多头自注意力编码器在同一时刻的边集合上做上下文编码得 z_ctx（式6–8）；⑥对节点关联边做均值池化仅作为读出，得 h̄_v^(t)（式9）；⑦沿用 TGN 原始记忆更新 Mem=MemUpd(Mem(t-1), h̄)、节点嵌入更新与 Raw Message Store 协议，不作改动（式11–12）。
【预测头与损失】z_ctx 同时送入两个分类器：链路存在性 σ(W_l z+b_l) + 二元交叉熵；类别 softmax(W_c z+b_c) + Focal Loss（缓解类别不平衡）；总损失 L = L_link + λL_cat（λ=1）。
【因果性论证】双向仅作用于"已由 TGN 因果机制过滤出的历史窗口"内（t_i ≤ t），不引入未来交互；在线推理时退化为前向处理；Transformer 自注意力同样限制在同一因果窗口内。
【威胁模型与图建模】攻击图为攻击者—受害者二部有向多重图（无攻击者—攻击者边），单向攻击流、单事件角色互斥、封闭集类别、实体集合有界但支持归纳；含 5 条假设（对手不可见模型、单向流、角色互斥、封闭集、有界实体+归纳泛化）。
【数据与评测】数据集：CESNET SABU/Warden 一周告警快照（2019-03-11—17，43,088 次交互、12,310 节点，类别含 Recon.Scanning、Anomaly.Traffic、Availability DoS/DDoS，采用"中位类规模对齐"的重采样+按时间重排以平衡类别）与 NF-UNSW-NB15-v2（10 类，强不平衡，用类别加权+Focal Loss）。划分：按时间分位数（70% 验证截断、85% 测试截断）；归纳设置为在验证截断后首次出现的节点中随机抽 10% 作为新节点集，其全部交互从训练中剔除。基线：SVM、RF、GCN、GraphSAGE、GNN、GRU、JoDI、DyRep、TGN、TGN-Attention、EdgeBank、TIDFormer、EasyDGL、TF-TGN、TransformerG2G。指标：链路侧 AUC/AP/MRR/Hits@1/Hits@3；分类侧 Accuracy、macro-F1、Recall、TPR/TNR/FPR/FNR、逐类指标。消融：Last/Mean/BiGRU/BiTransformer/BiTransformerTemporal/RelativeTransformer/StackedBiTransformer/TCNBlock 六种聚合器，以及 Transformer 组件变体（BiGRU 基线、BiTA、BiTA-Residual、BiTA-AttentionPool、BiTA-Hierarchical）与聚合器架构消融（GRU、BiGRU、Transformer、GRU+Trans、BiGRU+Trans）；另做消息序列长度分箱（1、2–5、6–10、11–20、21–50、>50）与配对 t 检验、Full-graph vs Past-only 因果一致性检验、训练批次顺序不变性检验、批量/图规模/延迟可扩展性分析。实现：Python 3.10 + PyTorch 2.2，Adam lr=1e-4，batch=128，50 epoch + patience 5，2 头注意力，消息/节点/时间维度各 100，记忆维度 9，Tesla T4 16GB。
AI.result:
1）聚合器对比（表6–8）：BiGRUTransformerAggregator（BiTA）全面最优——直推式 AUC 0.9511、AP 0.9509、F1 0.9809、MRR 0.9895、Recall 0.9812、Hits@1 0.9791；归纳式 AUC 0.7689、AP 0.7722、F1 0.9383、MRR 0.9707、Recall 0.9352、Hits@1 0.9415；FPR 0.0069/0.0194、FNR 0.0208/0.0584。相对次优的 BiTransformerTemporal（归纳 AUC 0.7391）与 BiTransformer（0.7414）优势约 2–4 个点；StackedBiTransformer 与 TCNBlock 在归纳场景明显退化（F1 0.5435/0.5323，Recall 0.4941/0.5315）。
2）逐类指标（表4）：BiTA 对 Anomaly.Traffic 直推/归纳准确率 0.9761/0.9703、Recon.Scanning 0.9505/0.8645，Availability.DDoS 与 DoS 近乎 1.0；而 StackedBiTransformer 的 Availability.DDoS 归纳准确率跌至 0.2848、TCN 的 Recon.Scanning 归纳准确率仅 0.2，显示双向递归+注意力对少数类与新节点更稳健。
3）与 SOTA 对比：BiTA 在 ROC-AUC、AP、F1 等全面优于 TGN(mean/last)、DyRep、EdgeBank、TIDFormer、EasyDGL、TF-TGN、TransformerG2G；与 JODIE/GRU/GCN/GraphSAGE 对比时各项指标超过 90%。
4）公平性：在完全相同的超参、嵌入维度与参数量（均 2,381）下对比，说明增益来自聚合机制而非模型容量；代价是训练时间上升（188.18 s vs 122.68/128.80 s），推理时间 0.62 s 与基线相当，显存 583.73 MB 与 TGN-last 持平。
5）组件消融：Transformer 集成于 BiGRU 之上带来正向增益（BiTA-Proposed > BiGRU 基线，图17–18），残差/LayerNorm/Pre-Norm 变体、注意力池化与并行融合层次化设计进一步改善稳定性；序列长度分箱显示消息数 >20 时 BiTA 优势最大，配对 t 检验 p<0.05 显著。
6）因果性与稳定性：Full-graph 与 Past-only 两种配置下预测 Pearson r>0.99，Δ_max<1e-2、平均绝对差≈5.43e-3，>99% 差异低于 1e-4；训练批次随机置换下逐边预测方差均值 5.43e-3、最大 8.53e-3，>99% 低于 1e-2，证明无未来信息泄漏且具备训练顺序不变性。
7）可扩展性：batch=128 时每边延迟 0.13 ms、吞吐 7,469 边/秒（batch=500 时 0.18 ms/5,704 边/秒）；图规模 3,000 边以上每边延迟稳定在 0.08–0.12 ms、吞吐最高 12,368 边/秒；单次预测延迟均值 2.05 ms、中位 1.97 ms、P99 3.45 ms，均低于 10 ms 实时阈值，理论上可达约 6.45 亿边/天。
8）需要指出的内部不一致：表9 的架构消融中，"仅 BiGRU"的 Test AP/AUC（0.9459/0.9493）与新节点 AP/AUC（0.7580/0.7597）实际略高于 BiTA（0.9323/0.9414；0.7429/0.7461），BiTA 仅在 Accuracy/F1 上占优，这与文中"BiTA 在所有指标上最优"的表述及实验9 的结论不一致；此外章节编号 5.16 与 5.17 完全重复。
AI.conclusion: BiTA 的核心贡献不是模型深度或容量，而是把 TGN 的"聚合=启发式池化"改造为"聚合=可学习的时序—上下文表示学习（BiGRU 序列建模 + Transformer 全局注意力），池化仅作读出"，从而在不改动 TGN 记忆与消息传递机制的前提下获得多尺度（短程序列 + 长程注意力）的时序推理能力。实验表明其在真实告警流上对链路存在性与告警类别分类均有稳定提升，兼具归纳泛化、因果安全（无未来信息泄漏）、训练顺序不变、低延迟高吞吐等实用属性，可作为实时自适应入侵检测系统的候选方案。局限与后续方向：仅依赖一周 Warden 快照加单一 UNSW 派生数据集；封闭集、有界实体、强假设的单向攻击威胁模型；Transformer 自注意力为 O(n²)，超长序列成本上升；未验证极端规模、强概念漂移与自适应对手场景；后续拟研究自适应聚合深度、动态资源分配、持续/在线学习与开放世界扩展。

title: AutoPyVerifier: Learning Compact Executable Verifiers for Large Language Model Outputs
summary: Verification is becoming central to both reinforcement-learning-based training and inference-time control of large language models (LLMs). Yet current verifiers face a fundamental trade-off: LLM-based verifiers are expressive but hard to control and prone to error, while deterministic executable verifiers are reliable and interpretable but often limited in capability. We study the following question: given a development set of LLM outputs and labels for a target objective, such as correctness, can we automatically induce a minimal set of Python verifiers whose joint satisfaction closely matches that objective? We propose AutoPyVerifier, a framework that uses an LLM to synthesize candidate verifier functions and then refines them through search over a directed acyclic graph (DAG). By navigating the DAG, AutoPyVerifier systematically explores the space of deterministic executable verifiers and selects a compact verifier set whose joint satisfaction best approximates the target objective. Across mathematical reasoning, coding, function calling, and instruction-following benchmarks for several state-of-the-art LLMs, AutoPyVerifier improves target-objective prediction by up to 55.0 F1 points over the initial LLM-generated verifier sets. Additional analyses show that the most useful verification targets vary by benchmark and model, and that the DAG-based search shifts the learned verifier sets toward more structural and semantically grounded checks. We further show that exposing the discovered verifier set to an LLM as an external tool improves downstream accuracy by up to 17.0 points. We release our code

AI.tldr: AutoPyVerifier是一个通过LLM合成Python验证器并利用DAG搜索精炼的框架，能够创建比原始LLM验证器更准确预测目标目标的紧凑确定性验证器集，可作为外部工具提升下游任务表现。
AI.motivation: 当前验证器面临根本性权衡：基于LLM的验证器表达能力强但难以控制且容易出错，而确定性可执行验证器可靠且可解释但能力有限。需要一种方法根据开发集自动诱导最小化的Python验证器集，使其联合满足度尽可能接近目标目标。
AI.method: AutoPyVerifier使用LLM合成候选验证器函数，然后通过有向无环图（DAG）搜索进行精炼，通过DAG导航系统探索确定性可执行验证器空间，选择与目标目标最接近的紧凑验证器集。
AI.result: AutoPyVerifier在数学推理、编码、函数调用和指令遵循基准测试中，最高可提升目标目标预测F1分数55.0分。DAG搜索使学习到的验证器集更偏向结构化和语义基础的检查，将发现的验证器集作为外部工具暴露给LLM可提升下游准确率最多17.0分。
AI.conclusion: AutoPyVerifier能够有效地合成就近匹配目标目标的紧致验证器集，并在下游任务中作为外部工具提升准确率最多17.0分。

title: The Power of Power Law: Asymmetry Enables Compositional Reasoning
summary: Natural language data follows a power-law distribution, with most knowledge and skills appearing at very low frequency. While a common intuition suggests that reweighting or curating data towards a uniform distribution may help models better learn these long-tail skills, we find a counterintuitive result: across a wide range of compositional reasoning tasks, such as state tracking and multi-step arithmetic, training under power-law distributions consistently outperforms training under uniform distributions. To understand this advantage, we introduce a minimalist skill-composition task and show that learning under a power-law distribution provably requires significantly less training data. Our theoretical analysis reveals that power law sampling induces a beneficial asymmetry that improves the pathological loss landscape, which enables models to first acquire high-frequency skill compositions with low data complexity, which in turn serves as a stepping stone to efficiently learn rare long-tailed skills. Our results offer an alternative perspective on what constitutes an effective data distribution for training models.

AI.tldr: 自然语言数据服从幂律分布，传统观点认为均匀化数据分布有助于模型学习长尾技能，但本文通过大量实验发现，在组合推理任务（如状态跟踪、多步算术）中，幂律分布训练反而一致优于均匀分布训练。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为均匀分布的数据有助于模型更好地学习长尾技能，但作者对此假设提出质疑，希望探究不同数据分布对模型训练效果的实际影响。
AI.method: 作者设计了一个极简的技能组合任务进行理论分析，并在多种组合推理任务上进行实验对比，涵盖状态跟踪和多步算术等任务。
AI.result: 幂律分布训练在多种组合推理任务中一致优于均匀分布训练。理论分析表明，幂律采样通过诱导有益的不对称性，改善了病理性的损失景观，使模型能够首先以低数据复杂度学习高频技能组合，再以此为踏板高效学习稀有的长尾技能。
AI.conclusion: 幂律分布是一种更有效的数据分布范式，这为理解有效训练数据分布提供了新视角。

title: A Taxonomy and Resolution Strategy for Client-Level Disagreements in Federated Learning
comment: 8 pages, 16 figures. Published in IEEE BigData 2025
summary: Federated Learning (FL) typically assumes unconditional collaboration, a premise that overlooks the complexities of real-world, multi-stakeholder environments in which clients may need to exclude one another for strategic, regulatory, or competitive reasons. This paper addresses this gap, which we term 'client-level disagreements,' by first introducing a taxonomy of such scenarios. We then propose a robust, multi-track resolution strategy that guarantees strict client exclusion by creating and managing isolated model update paths ('tracks'), thereby preventing the cross-contamination and unfairness issues present in naive strategies. Through an empirical evaluation of our custom simulation system across 34 scenarios using the MNIST and N-CMAPSS datasets, we validate that our approach correctly handles permanent, temporal, and overlapping disagreement patterns. Our scalability analysis reveals the server-side resolution algorithm's overhead is negligible (<1 ms per round) even under heavy load. The primary scalability constraint is the client-side training load from participating in multiple tracks, a cost that we show can be effectively mitigated by a submodel reuse strategy. This work presents a scalable and architecturally sound method for managing client-level disagreements, and enhances the practical applicability of FL in settings where policy compliance and strategic control are non-negotiable.

AI.tldr: 本文针对联邦学习中客户端之间的"排斥需求"问题，提出了一个多轨道隔离的解决方案。通过建立独立的模型更新路径，确保被排斥的客户端无法影响目标客户端的模型更新，并在34个场景中验证了其有效性。服务器端开销极低，但客户端训练负担是主要瓶颈，可通过子模型复用策略缓解。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习(FL)传统上假设客户端之间无条件的协作关系，但现实环境中客户端可能因战略、监管或竞争原因需要相互排斥。这种"客户端级分歧"在实际应用中普遍存在，但现有研究鲜有涉及。
AI.method: 提出一种多轨道(multi-track)隔离策略：为存在排斥关系的客户端创建独立的模型更新路径("轨道")，确保被排斥客户端的更新无法影响目标客户端。实验采用MNIST和N-CMAPSS数据集，覆盖34种场景，测试永久性、时序性和重叠性分歧模式。引入子模型复用策略降低客户端训练开销。
AI.result: 方案正确处理了永久性、时序性和重叠性分歧模式。服务器端每轮开销小于1ms，具有良好的可扩展性。客户端参与多轨道的训练负担是主要瓶颈，但子模型复用策略可有效缓解。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了首个针对客户端级分歧的可扩展且架构合理的解决方案，增强了联邦学习在政策合规和战略控制要求严格的场景中的实用性。

title: RedParrot: Accelerating NL-to-DSL for Business Analytics via Query Semantic Caching
summary: Recently, at Xiaohongshu, the rapid expansion of e-commerce and advertising demands real-time business analytics with high accuracy and low latency. To meet this demand, systems typically rely on converting natural language (NL) queries into Domain-Specific Languages (DSLs) to ensure semantic consistency, validation, and portability. However, existing multi-stage LLM pipelines for this NL-to-DSL task suffer from prohibitive latency, high cost, and error propagation, rendering them unsuitable for enterprise-scale deployment. In this paper, we propose RedParrot, a novel NL-to-DSL framework that accelerates inference via a semantic cache. Observing the high repetition and stable structural patterns in user queries, RedParrot bypasses the costly pipeline by matching new requests against cached "query skeletons" (normalized structural patterns) and adapting their corresponding DSLs. Our core technical contributions include (1) an offline skeleton construction strategy, (2) an online, entity-agnostic embedding model trained via contrastive learning for robust matching, and (3) a heterogeneous Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) method that integrates diverse knowledge sources to handle unseen entities. Experiments on six real enterprise datasets from Xiaohongshu show RedParrot achieves an average 3.6x speedup and an 8.26% accuracy improvement. Furthermore, on new public benchmarks adapted from Spider and BIRD, it boosts accuracy by 34.8%, substantially outperforming standard in-context learning baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RedParrot框架，通过语义缓存加速自然语言到领域特定语言(DSL)的转换，解决传统多阶段LLM管道延迟高、成本高、误差累积的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有NL-to-DSL多阶段LLM管道存在高延迟、高成本和误差传播问题，不适合企业级大规模部署。小红书平台电商和广告业务需要实时、高准确率、低延迟的商业分析能力。
AI.method: 1) 离线骨架构建策略：将用户查询标准化为"查询骨架"（结构化模式）；2) 基于对比学习训练的实体无关嵌入模型，用于鲁棒匹配；3) 异构RAG方法，整合多源知识处理未见实体。
AI.result: 在6个真实企业数据集上，RedParrot实现平均3.6倍加速和8.26%准确率提升；在Spider和BIRD改编的公开基准上，准确率提升34.8%，显著优于标准上下文学习方法。
AI.conclusion: RedParrot通过语义缓存机制有效加速NL-to-DSL转换，在保证语义一致性的同时提升准确率，为企业级实时分析提供可行方案。

title: Source-Code Analysis of iFogSim for Simulating Distributed IoT Architectures: Coverage, Challenges, and Enhancements
summary: Simulation is an indispensable tool for validating distributed IoT architectures before physical deployment, and iFogSim has emerged as one of the most widely adopted platform in the fog and edge computing research community. Yet the experience of using iFogSim for non-canonical, application-specific architectures remains incompletely documented, leaving practitioners without guidance on when the tool is appropriate, which scientific objectives it can address, and how to manage the modelling approximations it imposes. This article helps in providing that guidance through two complementary contributions. First, we present a structured state of the art covering iFogSim and iFogSim2, a taxonomy of ten scientific objectives that motivate IoT architecture simulation, and a comparative survey of eight simulation tools assessed against those objectives. Second, we report our experience of simulating a four-tier smart emergency response system for resource-constrained urban environments, covering a 25-node synthetic road topology, four experimental configurations, and quantitative results including end-to-end alert latency (near 205 ms), FPGA-accelerated Dijkstra path computation (x10 CPU speedup), concurrent incident conflict rates (75% under dual load), and path-cache acceleration (x197). The analysis is organised around five practitioner questions: whether iFogSim fits the target architecture, which objectives it covers natively versus partially, what modelling challenges arise and how their workarounds bias reported results, what changes to the iFogSim source code would close the identified gaps, and whether tool co-simulation can provide comprehensive coverage. Seven modelling challenges are documented with source-code-grounded root causes and explicit bias assessments; finally, seven developer recommendations are proposed as an actionable improvement roadmap for the iFogSim community.

AI.tldr: 本文针对iFogSim雾计算仿真工具进行系统性评估与实践指导，帮助研究人员判断该工具是否适用于特定IoT架构模拟，涵盖iFogSim及其衍生工具的文献综述、10类科学目标的分类法、8种仿真工具的对比调查，以及基于四层智能应急响应系统的实战案例分析（25节点道路拓扑），并提出7项建模挑战和7条开发者改进建议。
AI.motivation: iFogSim作为雾/边缘计算领域最广泛使用的仿真平台，其针对非典型、特定应用架构的使用经验尚未被系统记录，导致研究人员在工具适用性判断、科学目标覆盖范围及建模近似处理等方面缺乏明确指导。
AI.method: 本文采用双重贡献策略：①系统性文献综述与工具对比（iFogSim、iFogSim2及8种仿真工具的分类评估）；②四层智能应急响应系统的实战模拟（25节点合成道路拓扑、4种实验配置），涵盖端到端告警延迟、FPGA加速Dijkstra路径计算、并发事故冲突率及路径缓存加速等指标。
AI.result: 实验获得端到端告警延迟约205ms、FPGA加速路径计算达CPU的10倍速度、双负载下并发冲突率达75%、路径缓存加速达197倍；识别出7项建模挑战（附源代码层面的根因分析和偏差评估）；提出7条面向iFogSim社区的开发者改进建议。
AI.conclusion: iFogSim适用于特定类型的IoT架构模拟，但存在建模近似和覆盖范围限制；工具协同仿真可能是实现全面覆盖的潜在解决方案；本文提供的系统性指南和实践建议为iFogSim社区的改进提供了可操作的路线图。

title: Well-Conditioned Oblivious Perturbations in Linear Space
summary:
Perturbing a deterministic $n$-dimensional matrix with small Gaussian noise is a cornerstone of smoothed analysis of algorithms [Spielman and Teng, JACM 2004], as it reduces the condition number of the input to $O(n)$, and with it the complexity of many matrix algorithms. However, when deployed algorithmically, these perturbations are expensive due to the cost of generating and storing $n^2$ Gaussian random variables. We propose a perturbation that requires generating and storing $O(n)$ random numbers in $O(\log n)$ bits of precision, and reduces the condition number of any deterministic matrix to $O(n)$, matching Gaussian perturbations. Our result in particular implies a better complexity for the perturbed conjugate gradient algorithm, showing that we can solve an $n\times n$ linear system in linear space to within an arbitrarily small constant backward error using $O(n)$ matrix-vector products.
  In our construction, we introduce the concept of a pattern matrix, which is a dense deterministic matrix that maps all sparse vectors into dense vectors, and we combine it with a sparse perturbation whose entries are dependent and located in a non-uniform fashion. In order to analyze this construction, we develop new techniques for lower bounding the smallest singular value of a random matrix with dependent entries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅需O(n)个随机数和O(log n)位精度的矩阵扰动方法，替代传统需要O(n²)高斯随机变量的扰动技术，同时保持将条件数降至O(n)的理论保证，并应用于改进的共轭梯度算法实现线性空间、线性复杂度的线性系统求解。
AI.motivation: 传统高斯扰动虽然能将矩阵条件数降至O(n)，但需要生成和存储n²个高斯随机变量，计算和存储成本高昂，限制了其在实际算法中的应用。
AI.method: 提出模式矩阵（pattern matrix）概念——一种将所有稀疏向量映射为密集向量的确定性稠密矩阵；结合非均匀分布的稀疏扰动（条目具有依赖性）。开发了新的技术来下界具有依赖条目的随机矩阵的最小奇异值。
AI.result: 新扰动方案同样可将任意确定性矩阵的条件数降至O(n)，与高斯扰动效果相当。应用于扰动共轭梯度算法，可在线性空间内以O(n)次矩阵-向量乘法求解n×n线性系统，达到任意小的常数后向误差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作降低了矩阵扰动的随机性开销，为 smoothed analysis 提供更实用的工具，同时为条件数优化和线性系统求解提供了新的理论支撑。

title: Architecture Matters for Multi-Agent Security
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS), composed of networks of two or more autonomous AI agents, have become increasingly popular in production deployments, yet introduce security risks that do not arise in single-agent settings. Even if individual agents exhibit robust security, architectural decisions governing their coordination can create attack surfaces that have not been systematically characterized. In this work, we present an empirical study of how MAS design decisions shape the tradeoff between task performance and attack resistance. Across three agentic environments (browser, desktop, and code) and 13 architectural configurations, we use stagewise evaluations that distinguish planning refusal, execution-stage interception, partial harmful execution, and successful attack completion to study three key design choices: (i) agent roles, which determine how authority and responsibility are allocated; (ii) communication topology, which shapes how and when agents interact; and (iii) memory, which determines the context and state visibility accessible to each agent. We find that multi-agent architectures are more vulnerable than standalone agents in the majority of configurations, with attack success rates varying by up to 3.8x at comparable or higher benign accuracy, and that no single design is universally safer. These results motivate the development of further evaluations that move beyond the security properties of a single agent.

AI.tldr: 该研究实证分析了多智能体系统（MAS）中架构设计决策对任务性能与攻击抵抗力的权衡关系。研究覆盖浏览器、桌面和代码三种环境，13种架构配置，重点考察智能体角色、通信拓扑和记忆三个设计维度。结果表明，多智能体架构在大多数配置下比单智能体更脆弱，攻击成功率差异可达3.8倍，且不存在 универсально安全的单一设计方案。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统（MAS）虽已广泛部署，但其安全风险尚未被系统性地表征。即使单个智能体具备良好的安全性，智能体间的协调架构仍可能产生新型攻击面。这促使研究者需要超越单智能体安全属性，建立更完善的多智能体安全评估体系。
AI.method: 采用阶段化评估方法，在三种智能体环境（浏览器、桌面、代码）中测试13种架构配置。通过区分四个攻击阶段（规划拒绝、执行阶段拦截、部分有害执行、成功完成攻击）来量化攻击效果。重点分析三个关键设计选择：(i) 智能体角色分配（权限与责任划分）、(ii) 通信拓扑结构（交互时机与方式）、(iii) 记忆机制（上下文与状态可见性）。
AI.result: 多智能体架构在多数配置下比单智能体更脆弱；攻击成功率在同等或更高良性准确率条件下差异可达3.8倍；不存在 универсально安全的单一设计选择。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了多智能体系统中架构设计与安全风险之间的重要关联，强调需要发展超越单智能体安全评估的更全面评价体系。呼吁学术界和工业界在MAS设计中更加关注协调层的安全属性，而非仅关注个体智能体的安全特性。

title: Secure On-Premise Deployment of Open-Weights Large Language Models in Radiology: An Isolation-First Architecture with Prospective Pilot Evaluation
summary:
Purpose: To design, implement, evaluate, and report on the regulatory requirements of a self-hosted LLM infrastructure for radiology adhering to the principle of least privilege, emphasizing technical feasibility, network isolation, and clinical utility.
  Materials and Methods: The isolation-first, containerized LLM inference stack relies on strict network segmentation, host-enforced egress filtering, and active isolation monitoring preventing unauthorized external connectivity. An accompanying deployment package provides automated isolation and hardening tests. The system served the open-weights DeepSeek-R1 model via vLLM. In a one-week pilot phase, 22 residents and radiologists were free to use 10 predefined prompt-templates whenever they considered them useful in daily work. Afterward, they rated clinical utility and system stability on an 0-10 Likert scale and reported observed critical errors in model output.
  Results: The applied institutional governance pathway achieved approval from clinic management, compliance, data protection and information security officers for processing unanonymized PHI. The system was rated stable and user friendly during the pilot. Source text-anchored tasks, such as report corrections or simplifications, and radiology guideline recommendations received the highest utility ratings, whereas open-ended conclusion generation based on findings resulted in the highest frequency of critical errors, such as clinically relevant hallucinations or omissions.
  Conclusion: The proposed isolation-first on-premise architecture enabled overcoming regulatory borders, showed promising clinical utility in text-anchored tasks and is the current base to serve open-weights LLMs as an official service of a German University Hospital with over 10,000 employees. The deployment package were made publicly available (https://github.com/ukbonn/ukb-gpt).

AI.tldr: 本文报告了波恩大学医院（UKB）真实落地的"隔离优先（isolation-first）"本地化开源权重 LLM 放射科服务：以 8×A100 服务器运行 DeepSeek-R1（vLLM 推理），通过三分区网络拓扑、宿主机 iptables 强制出口过滤、LDAP 气闸 IP 固定与主动隔离监控实现"零外泄"，并配套自动化隔离/加固回归测试；经董事会、数据保护、信息安全、职工委员会与合规（EU AI Act 部署者角色）审批后获准处理未匿名化 PHI。经 IRB 批准（2025-167-BO），22 名放射科医师开展一周真实工作流试点，使用 10 个固定提示模板，以 0–10 Likert 量表评估效用、稳定性与关键错误。结果显示系统稳定（稳定性中位 10.0）、TTFT 3.13 s、约 25 tokens/s、试点期零外部连通事件；源文本锚定型任务（翻译、语法纠错、指南推荐、报告简化）效用最高且几乎无关键错误，而开放式生成（由所见生成结论）关键错误最多。部署包已开源（github.com/ukbonn/ukb-gpt）。
AI.motivation: 云端专有 LLM API（如 ChatGPT、Gemini）要求患者数据出院区网络，与 GDPR/HIPAA 的保密性、数据主权与合规要求冲突，多数国家医院禁止在临床数据上使用外部 LLM。本地部署开源权重模型虽能控制数据，但本地托管本身并不保证安全：开源组件、容器镜像、模型加载代码与联网支持服务都引入攻击面，配置错误或供应链投毒仍可导致数据泄露。同时放射科文献中"概念性讨论"多、真正可复现的大医院真实部署与现场临床评估缺失（缺乏系统设计、监管治理路径与开源复现）。此外，德国医院需明确在 GDPR、EU AI Act 2024/1689 框架下医院作为"模型部署者（deployer）"而非提供者的合规义务。
AI.method: （1）架构：单台院内服务器（8×NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe），Docker Compose 编排，含 Nginx 反向代理（入口）、OpenWebUI 前端、vLLM 推理后端、Prometheus/Grafana 监控四组件。（2）网络：split-horizon 三区拓扑——入口 DMZ（仅接受院内/VPN 流量）、无路由网关的内部 Docker 网络（隔离前端与后端）、可选出口 DMZ（仅限 LDAP 等气闸），叠加宿主机 iptables/ip6tables 强制出口过滤，出口桥固定到明确配置的私网目标 IP。（3）技术验证：自动化隔离/集成/加固测试，覆盖容器对公网 ICMP 与 HTTPS 阻断、精确防火墙规则与气闸 IP/端口例外、入站允许清单与默认拒绝、TLS 最低版本与运行时协商、网络挂载与宿主端口暴露检查、以及当意外出口变为可行时的 fail-safe 容器终止；按"假定已被攻破"威胁模型列五类威胁（恶意模型权重、供应链、认证桥劫持、Web 应用漏洞与提权、凭据窃取）及对应缓解（内存注入密钥、只读挂载/tmpfs、capability 降权等）。（4）模型：以激活感知权重量化运行 671B DeepSeek-R1，平台架构与模型 profile 解耦。（5）治理：明确预期用途为放射科文本辅助、不做自主临床决策；与董事会、数据保护官、信息安全官、职工委员会、合规部门逐项协商，落实 30 天聊天记录保留期、AI 素养培训与 AD/LDAP 组准入、禁用员工使用行为监控且自愿使用、EU AI Act 部署者义务（人工监督、AI 透明度、用户资质）。（6）试点：2025 年 7 月一周，22 名放射科医师（17 住院医、3 专治医师、2 高级主治）自由使用 10 个预置提示模板（报告纠错/改进、结论生成、随访对比、CT 结构化、ICD-10 编码、患者版简化、指南推荐[CAD-RADS/PI-RADS/Bosniak/Fleischner]、邮件生成、语言纠错、翻译），事后电子问卷（0–10 Likert 评估潜在、输出质量、易编辑性、时间节省；关键错误分为无/单次/多次）加日志分析（Python/Pandas，中位数与 IQR，线性插值）。
AI.result: 安全与合规：全部自动化回归测试通过，试运行期主动隔离监控未检出任何网络边界突破或外部连通事件；五方审批全部获得，DPO 要求的 30 天留存上限被采纳，合规部门认定医院为 AI Act 部署者，AI 素养课程完成情况与 AD/LDAP 组分配绑定作为登录前提。临床效用：翻译质量中位 9.5（IQR 9.2–9.8）、易编辑性 10.0、时间节省 10.0 min；语言纠错与指南推荐质量均 8.5，报告简化易编辑性 10.0；源文本锚定任务（翻译、语法纠错、报告简化、指南推荐、随访生成、邮件生成）10 项中 6 项零关键错误。开放式生成风险更高：结论生成质量仅 6.0、易编辑性 5.0，且是唯一出现多次关键错误的任务（2 人报告多次、1 人报告单次）；报告纠错与改进亦有 1 人多次、1 人单次；ICD-10 编码被感知潜在最高（9.0）但时间节省最低（3.5 min），因 15000+ 编码空间易致"版本混用"与似是而非编码的幻觉，需检索增强或代理式修订才能真正自动化。技术性能：首日 08:00–09:00 峰值 40 请求、最大并发仅 2，TTFT 中位 3.13 s（IQR 2.00–4.81）、每 token 0.04 s（约 25 tokens/s）；用户评分稳定性 10.0（IQR 9.2–10.0）、友好性 9.0（IQR 7.2–10.0）、速度 7.0（IQR 5.0–8.0）。作者归因生成速度偏低源于老旧 PCIe 服务器跨 NUMA 节点、GPU 间通信带宽低，建议改用 NVLink 高带宽互联或部署可单卡容纳的较新小模型（如 GPT-oss-120b、Qwen3.5-122B-A10B）绕过互连瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 隔离优先的本地部署架构配合自动化测试与制度化治理路径，可使医院在本地处理未匿名化 PHI，从而突破云端 LLM 的监管边界；其安全控制（宿主机出口强制、默认拒绝、主动监控）同时构成天然的离线沙箱，是未来安全部署临床自主 AI 代理的可行基础。任务性质决定了临床价值与风险的分层：源文本锚定/受限生成（如翻译、纠错、简化、指南建议）效用高且安全，开放式内容生成（由所见写结论、编码）风险最高，必须保留人工监督。作者坦承局限：单中心、22 人、一周样本小；安全性依赖用户自报错误而非独立专家盲审；性能指标仅为特定模型快照；当前为交互式聊天场景而非自主代理。总体而言，本工作把"可行性讨论"推进为可复现的真实部署与直接临床评估，并已开源部署包供其他医院复用。

title: Stochastic KV Routing: Enabling Adaptive Depth-Wise Cache Sharing
summary: Serving transformer language models with high throughput requires caching Key-Values (KVs) to avoid redundant computation during autoregressive generation. The memory footprint of KV caching is significant and heavily impacts serving costs. This work proposes to lessen these memory requirements. While recent work has largely addressed KV cache reduction via compression and eviction along the temporal axis, we argue that the \emph{depth} dimension offers an orthogonal and robust avenue for optimization. Although prior research suggests that a full cache for every layer is redundant, implementing cross-layer cache sharing remains a practical challenge; existing methods typically suffer from reduced throughput or increased time-to-first-token. In this paper, we demonstrate that dropping a layer's cache offers efficient optimization without information loss. We propose a simple training approach: random cross-layer attention. During training, layers randomly choose to attend either to their own KV states or those of a preceding layer. This stochastic process adapts the model to be robust to various depth-wise cache sharing strategies, ensuring flexibility for unknown hardware constraints at deployment time. Our evaluations show that applying this scheme during pre-training or fine-tuning enables depth-wise cache sharing for various model families. Furthermore, for larger models in data-constrained settings, this approach is suggestive of a regularization-like effect, frequently preserving or improving performance while significantly reducing the cache's memory footprint.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过随机跨层注意力机制训练transformer模型，使其能够适应跨层缓存共享策略，从而显著降低KV缓存的内存开销，同时保持甚至提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: KV缓存占用了大量内存，严重影响Transformer语言模型的推理吞吐量和部署成本。现有方法主要从时间维度压缩缓存，而跨层缓存共享虽被证明有效，但实现困难，易导致吞吐量下降或首token延迟增加。
AI.method: 在训练阶段随机化跨层注意力：各层以一定概率选择关注自身的KV状态或前一层/指定层的KV状态。这种随机化训练使模型适应多种深度方向的缓存共享策略，提升部署灵活性。
AI.result: 该方法在预训练或微调阶段应用后，可支持多种模型家族的深度方向缓存共享。在数据有限的大模型场景下，表现出类似正则化的效果，在显著降低缓存内存占用的同时，通常能保持或提升模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 跨层缓存共享是减少KV缓存内存占用的有效正交优化方向。随机跨层注意力训练为模型提供了对不同缓存策略的鲁棒性，为硬件约束未知的部署场景提供了灵活解决方案。

title: Self Knowledge Re-expression: A Fully Local Method for Adapting LLMs to Tasks Using Intrinsic Knowledge
summary: While the next-token prediction (NTP) paradigm enables large language models (LLMs) to express their intrinsic knowledge, its sequential nature constrains performance on specialized, non-generative tasks. We attribute this performance bottleneck to the LLMs' knowledge expression mechanism, rather than to deficiencies in knowledge acquisition. To address this, we propose Self-Knowledge Re-expression (SKR), a novel, task-agnostic adaptation method. SKR transforms the LLM's output from generic token generation to highly efficient, task-specific expression. SKR is a fully local method that uses only unannotated data, requiring neither human supervision nor model distillation. Experiments on a large financial document dataset demonstrate substantial improvements: over 40% in Recall@1 for information retrieval tasks, over 76% reduction in object detection latency, and over 33% increase in anomaly detection AUPRC. Our results on the MMDocRAG dataset surpass those of leading retrieval models by at least 12.6%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自知识重表达（SKR）方法，解决大语言模型在非生成任务上因逐token生成范式导致的性能瓶颈。该方法将模型输出从通用token生成转变为高效的任务特定表达，完全基于无标注数据，无需人工监督或模型蒸馏。在金融文档数据集上，信息检索Recall@1提升超40%，目标检测延迟降低超76%，异常检测AUPRC提升超33%，在MMDocRAG数据集上超越领先检索模型至少12.6%。
AI.motivation: 当前next-token prediction（NTP）范式的顺序生成特性限制了LLM在专业化、非生成任务上的性能表现。作者认为问题源于LLM的知识表达机制，而非知识获取不足，因此需要一种方法来改善知识表达方式。
AI.method: 提出Self-Knowledge Re-expression（SKR）方法，这是一种任务无关的自适应方法。SKR将LLM的输出从通用token生成转换为高效的任务特定表达。该方法完全本地化，仅使用无标注数据，无需人工监督或模型蒸馏。
AI.result: 在大型金融文档数据集上的实验表明：信息检索任务Recall@1提升超过40%；目标检测延迟降低超过76%；异常检测AUPRC提升超过33%。在MMDocRAG数据集上的结果超越领先检索模型至少12.6%。
AI.conclusion: SKR方法有效解决了NTP范式对LLM在非生成任务上的限制，通过改变知识表达方式而非改进知识获取，实现了显著的性能提升，证明了知识表达机制优化的重要性。

title: On the Existence of an Inverse Solution for Preference-Based Reductions in Argumentation
summary: Preference-based argumentation frameworks (PAFs) extend Dung's approach to abstract argumentation (AAFs) by encoding preferences over arguments. Such preferences control the transformation of attacks into defeats, and different approaches to doing so result in different reductions from a PAF to an AAF. In this paper we consider a PAF inverse problem which takes an argumentation graph, a labelling and a semantics as an input, and outputs a ``yes" or ``no" as to whether there is a preference relation between the arguments which can yield the desired labelling. This inverse problem has applications in areas including preference elicitation and explainability. We consider this problem in the context of the four most widely-used preference based reductions under the complete semantics. We show that in most cases, the problem can be answered in polynomial time.

AI.tldr: 本文研究偏好论证框架(PAF)的逆问题：给定论证图、标签和语义，判断是否存在能够产生期望标签的偏好关系。该问题在偏好获取和可解释性方面有应用价值。研究在完全语义下考虑四种最广泛使用的基于偏好的归约方法，结果表明大多数情况下该问题可在多项式时间内求解。
AI.motivation: 基于偏好的论证框架(PAF)通过编码论证间的偏好来扩展Dung的抽象论证框架(AAF)。不同的攻击转化机制导致不同的PAF到AAF的归约方法，但目前尚缺乏系统的方法来判断是否存在特定的偏好关系能够产生期望的论证标签。该逆问题在偏好获取和论证系统的可解释性方面具有重要应用需求。
AI.method: 作者采用计算复杂性分析方法，研究了四种最广泛使用的基于偏好的归约方法在完全语义下的逆问题。这四种归约方法代表了攻击向失败转化的不同策略。通过建立数学模型，将逆问题形式化为判定问题：给定论证图G、标签L和语义S，判断是否存在偏好关系R使得在归约后的AAF中L是G在语义S下的有效标签。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，在四种最广泛使用的基于偏好归约方法中，大多数情况下该逆问题可以在多项式时间内求解。这意味着一旦给定期望的论证标签，可以高效地判断是否存在某种偏好关系能够支持该标签，从而为偏好获取和论证解释提供了有效的计算方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了PAF逆问题在计算上是易处理的，为偏好论证系统中的偏好 elicitation 和可解释性研究奠定了理论基础。未来的工作可能包括扩展到其他语义（如优先语义、稳定语义等）以及其他类型的逆问题。

title: ClusterFusion++: Expanding Cluster-Level Fusion to Full Transformer-Block Decoding
summary:
Large language model (LLM) decoding is latency-sensitive and often bottlenecked by fragmented operator execution and repeated off-chip materialization of intermediate tensors. Prior work expands fusion scope by leveraging thread-block clusters and on-chip inter-block collectives to fuse attention-side operators such as QKV projection, attention, and output projection.
  We develop ClusterFusion++, a CUDA-level extension that broadens fusion to the full Transformer decoder block for GPT-NeoX/Pythia models: LayerNorm -> QKV -> RoPE -> decode attention -> output projection -> Post-LN -> MLP -> residual. We additionally engineer a CUDA-Graph-compatible execution mode with persistent Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) descriptors to reduce per-step overhead.
  On an NVIDIA RTX 5090-class GPU, ClusterFusion++ improves throughput by 1.34x for Pythia-2.8B and yields similar gains for Pythia-6.9B, while maintaining high output fidelity (near-token-identical generation, with minor non-determinism from FP16 atomics).

AI.tldr: 本文是上海交大的一门课程项目论文：在 NVIDIA RTX 5090（sm_120）上实现 CUDA 级扩展 ClusterFusion++，把 ClusterFusion 的"簇级融合"从注意力侧（QKV/Attention/O-Projection）扩展到 GPT-NeoX/Pythia 的**完整 Transformer 解码块**（LayerNorm→QKV→RoPE→Decode Attention→O-Projection→Post-LN→MLP→Residual），并配合"持久化 TMA 描述符 + CUDA Graph"执行模式降低每步调度开销。在 Pythia-2.8B 上 TPOT/吞吐最高提升 1.34×（2048 上下文：151.5→203.5 tok/s，6.60→4.91 ms/token），Pythia-6.9B 提升 1.14–1.25×；生成结果近乎 token 级一致（token 匹配率 99.4%，Top-5 92.3%），PPL 与基线完全一致。消融揭示"融合收益非可加"：MLP Down 单独跑反而慢于 cuBLAS（0.75×），但与 Attention+MLP-Up 融合后整体可达 1.39×。
AI.motivation: LLM 自回归解码是延迟敏感环节，其瓶颈在于：(1) 单个 Transformer 块被拆成多个 kernel 执行，算子碎片化；(2) 每个中间张量（如 QKV、注意力输出、MLP 中间激活）反复写入再读出全局内存，产生大量 off-chip 流量；(3) 每 token 的 kernel launch 开销。已有工作（ClusterFusion, Luo et al. 2025）利用 NVIDIA 新硬件的 thread-block cluster + distributed shared memory (DSMEM) 提供片上 cluster 级 collective，只融合了注意力侧的 QKV 投影、注意力、输出投影。本文提出的核心问题是：这种 cluster 启用的融合能否从"注意力侧"扩展到真实 GPT 风格模型的**整个 decoder block**？作者的答案是可以，并希望证明融合收益与组件单独性能之间存在非加性协同效应。
AI.method:
**整体路线**：单个 kernel 内完成整块解码，cluster 内多 block 协同计算并通过 DSMEM 交换部分结果（partial results），避免跨 block 归约时必须结束 kernel 并借道全局内存。

**架构适配（GPT-NeoX/Pythia）**：为 LayerNorm、QKV 投影、MLP 增加 bias 项；权重按 head 交错存储而非拼接；支持 Pythia-2.8B 的 partial RoPE（仅旋转每 head 前 25% 维度，其余直通）；针对非 2 的幂 head_dim=80 定制 warp/tiling 策略。

**关键 kernel 优化**：
1. 单趟 LayerNorm：用 Var(x)=E[x²]−E[x]² 同时算均值与方差，内存流量减半；
2. Cluster 协同注意力：cluster 内多 block 分担 KV cache 序列长度，通过 DSMEM 做低延迟跨 block 通信；
3. 树形归约：将 cluster 级输出累加从 O(n) 串行环形归约改为 O(log n) 二叉树归约；
4. PTX 内建指令加速 GELU。

**CUDA Graph 模式**：为每层建立可复用的 graph context，TensorMap (TMA) 描述符每层只创建一次，输出/中间静态 buffer 跨 decode step 复用，整个 decode step 退化为一次 graph replay，消除 CPU 侧 launch 开销。

**实现分工**：项目分为 prefill、decode-attention、decode-mlp 三部分，由三位作者并行完成后再整合。
AI.result:
**端到端（RTX 5090，batch=1，PyTorch 2.9.1/CUDA 13.1，基线为 HF Transformers + KV cache）**：
- Pythia-2.8B TPOT：16→2048 长度下 CF 单独加速 1.11–1.24×，CF+Graph 加速 1.21–1.34×；2048 处 6.60→4.91 ms，吞吐 151.5→203.5 tok/s。
- Pythia-6.9B：CF 1.09–1.20×，CF+Graph 1.14–1.25×（正文称"similar gains"略显乐观，Table 7 单位为秒，与其他表不一致）。
- 算力利用率约 1.15–1.44 TFLOPS，长序列趋于 1.15。

**精度**：WikiText-2 PPL=24.00、PG-19 PPL=8.90，与基线完全一致（仅加速 decode）；token 匹配率总体 99.4%、WikiText-2 上 99.8%；logits MAE 0.0235；Top-5/Top-10 一致率 92.3%/96.0%；偶发不匹配归因于输出投影的 FP16 atomic 累加导致的非确定性。

**消融（Pythia-2.8B, 2048）**：PyTorch 6.80 ms（1.00×）；CUDA Attention + PyTorch MLP Down 5.32 ms（1.28×）；PyTorch Attention + CUDA MLP Down 9.04 ms（0.75×）；全融合 4.90 ms（1.39×）。融合节省中间流量 2×10240×2×32=1.31 MB/step，在 1.8 TB/s 下约 0.73 ms，与 5.32→4.90 ms 的实测改善高度吻合；协同来源为 launch 开销摊销、20 KB MLP 中间张量的寄存器/共享内存复用、消除同步、共用 TMA 权重加载设施。MLP Down 单独慢于 cuBLAS 的原因是 F.linear 的 cuBLAS 效率高、固定开销（TMA 描述符创建、cluster launch）摊销差、以及 26.2M 权重的内存受限特性。

**Prefill**：实现并改造了 GPT-NeoX 版 Flash Attention；纯 Flash Attention 相对 PyTorch TTFT 1.56×，但作者自研架构适配版本仅 0.33×（显著变慢），仅作为"算法本身有效"的透明参考。

**局限**：仅在单张消费级 RTX 5090、batch=1、两个 Pythia 模型上验证；基线仅为 HF（未与 vLLM/TensorRT-LLM 等强推理栈对比）；sm_120 特性依赖较强；prefill 路径明显落后；表/图编号存在笔误（"Figure 2 and Figure 2"、"Table 2 and 2"）。
AI.conclusion: ClusterFusion++ 证明：在具备 thread-block cluster 与 DSMEM 的新硬件上，cluster 协同融合可从注意力侧扩展到 GPT-NeoX/Pythia 的完整 decoder block；单 kernel 内完成 LayerNorm→QKV→RoPE→Decode Attention→O-Projection→Post-LN→MLP→Residual，配合持久化 TMA 描述符与静态 buffer 的 CUDA Graph 模式，可将 kernel 启动开销与中间全局内存流量同时削减，在 RTX 5090 上相对 HF 基线取得 1.21–1.34× 的 TPOT/吞吐提升，且输出几乎 token 级一致（PPL 不变），代价是 FP16 atomic 归约带来的轻微非确定性。论文最有价值的洞见是：融合收益是**非可加的**——单独看比 cuBLAS 更慢的 MLP Down kernel，在与 Attention+MLP-Up 融合后反而带来整体 1.39× 的收益，因为消除了 1.31 MB/step 的中间流量并摊销了固定开销。因此，评估融合优化时不应以单组件微基准的快慢作为取舍依据。未来方向包括：补齐/优化 prefill 路径、在更多 GPU 架构与更优推理栈基线上验证、消除 FP16 atomic 引入的数值非确定性、以及向多 batch 与更复杂模型结构扩展。

title: Beyond Static: Related Questions Retrieval Through Conversations in Community Question Answering
summary: In community question answering (cQA) platforms like Stack Overflow, related question retrieval is recognized as a fundamental task that allows users to retrieve related questions to answer user queries automatically. Although many traditional approaches have been proposed for investigating this research field, they mostly rely on static approaches and neglect the interaction property. We argue that the conversational way can well distinguish the fine-grained representations of questions and has great potential to improve the performance of question retrieval. In this paper, we propose a related question retrieval model through conversations, called TeCQR, to locate related questions in cQA. Specifically, we build conversations by utilizing tag-enhanced clarifying questions (CQs). In addition, we design a noise tolerance model that evaluates the semantic similarity between questions and tags, enabling the model to effectively handle noisy feedback. Moreover, the tag-enhanced two-stage offline training is proposed to fully exploit the mutual relationships among user queries, questions, and tags to learn their fine-grained representations. Based on the learned representations and contextual conversations, TeCQR incorporates conversational feedback by learning to ask tag-enhanced clarifying questions to retrieve related questions more effectively. Experimental results demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TeCQR，一种通过对话方式进行社区问答中相关问题检索的模型，利用标签增强的澄清问题构建对话，并设计噪声容忍模型处理含噪反馈，通过两阶段离线训练学习细粒度表示，显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有相关问题检索方法多依赖静态方法，忽略交互特性。本文认为对话方式能够有效区分问题的细粒度表示，有潜力提升检索性能。
AI.method: 1) 利用标签增强的澄清问题(CQs)构建对话；2) 设计噪声容忍模型评估问题与标签间的语义相似度；3) 提出标签增强的两阶段离线训练方法，充分挖掘用户查询、问题、标签间的相互关系；4) 基于学习到的表示和上下文对话，通过学习询问标签增强的澄清问题来整合对话反馈。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，TeCQR模型显著优于现有最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过对话方式结合标签增强的澄清问题，TeCQR能有效检索社区问答平台中的相关问题，证明了交互式方法在细粒度问题检索任务中的优势。

title: ArgRE: Formal Argumentation for Conflict Resolution in Multi-Agent Requirements Negotiation
summary: As software systems grow in complexity, they must satisfy an increasing number of competing quality attributes, making it essential to balance them in a principled manner -- for example, a safety requirement for sensor-fusion verification may conflict with a tight planning-cycle budget. Multi-agent large language model frameworks support this balancing process by assigning specialized agents to different objectives. However, their conflict resolution is typically heuristic. Requirements are aggregated implicitly without explicit acceptance or rejection, limiting auditability in regulated domains. We present ArgRE, a multi-agent requirements negotiation system that embeds Dung-style abstract argumentation into the negotiation stage. Each proposal, critique, and refinement is modeled as an argument, conflicts are represented as directed attack relations, and the accepted set of arguments is computed under grounded and preferred semantics. The pipeline further integrates KAOS goal modeling, multi-layer verification, and standards-oriented artifact generation. Evaluation across five case studies spanning safety-critical, financial, and information-system domains shows that ArgRE provides argument-level traceability absent from existing frameworks. Independent evaluators rated its decision justifications significantly higher than those of heuristic synthesis (4.32 vs. 3.07, p < 0.001), indicating improved auditability, while semantic intent preservation remains comparable (94.9% BERTScore F1) and compliance coverage reaches 84.7% versus 47.6%--47.8% for baselines. Structural analysis further confirms that the default pairwise protocol yields acyclic graphs in which grounded and preferred semantics coincide, whereas cross-pair arbitration introduces controlled cyclicity, leading to predictable divergence between the two semantics.

AI.tldr: ArgRE是一个多智能体需求协商系统，将Dung风格抽象论证嵌入协商阶段，通过论证框架、攻击关系和语义计算实现可审计的需求权衡。评估表明其在决策合理性评分和合规覆盖率上显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 随着软件系统复杂性增加，满足竞争性质量属性变得至关重要。现有Multi-agent LLM框架在冲突解决上依赖启发式方法，缺乏明确的接受/拒绝机制，导致在监管领域审计能力不足。
AI.method: 将Dung风格抽象论证嵌入协商阶段：每个提案、批评和细化建模为论证，冲突建模为有向攻击关系，接受的论证集通过grounded和preferred语义计算。集成KAOS目标建模、多层验证和标准导向工件生成。
AI.result: 提供论证级追溯能力；决策合理性评分显著高于启发式综合(4.32 vs 3.07, p<0.001)；语义意图保持率94.9% BERTScore F1；合规覆盖率84.7% vs 基线47.6%-47.8%。结构分析表明默认成对协议产生无环图，语义一致；跨对仲裁引入受控环性，导致两种语义间可预测的分歧。
AI.conclusion: ArgRE在保持可比语义保留率的同时，显著提升审计可追溯性和合规覆盖率。其论证框架为需求权衡提供了原则性、可解释的方法。

title: A Note on Interdiction of Linear Minimization Problems
summary: Motivated by the FPTAS for connectivity interdiction of Huang et al. (IPCO'24), we isolate the part of the argument that does not use cuts. The setting is a minimization problem over a feasible-set family $\mathcal F$ with a linear objective $w(S)=\sum_{e\in S}w(e)$. After dualizing the interdiction budget, deletion can be absorbed into truncated weights $w_λ(e)=\min\{w(e),λc(e)\}$. At an optimal Lagrange multiplier $λ^*$, the unknown optimal interdiction witness is a strict $2$-approximate minimizer of the reweighted problem. Thus an exact algorithm can be obtained whenever one can optimize $w_{λ^*}$ over $\mathcal F$, enumerate all its $2$-approximate minimizers, and solve the remaining knapsack problem.

AI.tldr: 本文从Huang等人的FPTAS for connectivity interdiction工作中提取了不依赖于割集理论的通用框架。该方法通过拉格朗日对偶将删除操作转化为截断权重，并在最优乘子下将原问题转化为2-近似极小化问题，从而在满足特定条件时获得精确算法。
AI.motivation: FPTAS for connectivity interdiction (IPCO'24) 的核心依赖于割结构，限制了方法的通用性。本文旨在将该方法的适用范围扩展到一般的可行集族 $\mathcal{F}$，建立一个更广泛的算法框架。
AI.method: 通过两步转换：(1) 拉格朗日对偶吸收删除预算约束，将目标函数改写为截断权重 $w_\lambda(e) = \min\{w(e), \lambda c(e)\}$；(2) 在最优乘子 $\lambda^*$ 下，利用对偶理论证明未知的最优 interdiction witness 是重加权问题的严格2-近似极小化器。
AI.result: 建立了精确算法存在的充分条件：给定 $\lambda^*$，若能对 $w_{\lambda^*}$ 在 $\mathcal{F}$ 上进行优化、枚举其所有2-近似极小化器，并求解剩余的背包问题，则可获得原问题的精确解。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将原有的图论技术抽象为一般性的代数/组合方法，通过对偶理论建立了从FPTAS到精确算法的理论桥梁，为 interdiction 问题的通用求解提供了新的视角。

title: DLM: Unified Decision Language Models for Offline Multi-Agent Sequential Decision Making
summary: Building scalable and reusable multi-agent decision policies from offline datasets remains a challenge in offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), as existing methods often rely on fixed observation formats and action spaces that limit generalization. In contrast, large language models (LLMs) offer a flexible modeling interface that can naturally accommodate heterogeneous observations and actions. Motivated by this, we propose the Decision Language Model (DLM), which formulates multi-agent decision making as a dialogue-style sequence prediction problem under the centralized training with decentralized execution paradigm. DLM is trained in two stages: a supervised fine-tuning phase, which leverages dialogue-style datasets for centralized training with inter-agent context and generates executable actions from offline trajectories, followed by a group relative policy optimization phase to enhance robustness to out-of-distribution actions through lightweight reward functions. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that a unified DLM outperforms strong offline MARL baselines and LLM-based conversational decision-making methods, while demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization to unseen scenarios across tasks.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes Decision Language Model (DLM), which leverages large language models for multi-agent decision making by formulating it as dialogue-style sequence prediction. DLM uses a two-stage training approach (supervised fine-tuning + group relative policy optimization) under centralized training with decentralized execution paradigm. Experiments show DLM outperforms existing offline MARL and LLM-based baselines, with strong zero-shot generalization capabilities.
AI.motivation: Existing offline multi-agent reinforcement learning methods rely on fixed observation formats and action spaces, which limits generalization. Large language models offer a flexible modeling interface that can naturally accommodate heterogeneous observations and actions across different agents.
AI.method: DLM formulates multi-agent decision making as dialogue-style sequence prediction under centralized training with decentralized execution paradigm. Training involves two stages: (1) Supervised fine-tuning using dialogue-style datasets with inter-agent context for centralized training, generating executable actions from offline trajectories; (2) Group relative policy optimization phase to enhance robustness to out-of-distribution actions through lightweight reward functions.
AI.result: A unified DLM outperforms strong offline MARL baselines and LLM-based conversational decision-making methods, while demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization to unseen scenarios across tasks.
AI.conclusion: DLM provides a scalable and reusable framework for multi-agent decision policies, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization to unseen scenarios across diverse tasks.

title: The Nexus of Science Fiction, Box Office Success and Technology Representation: A Case Study of the Marvel Cinematic Universe
summary: This paper investigated the applied science domains and subjects depicted in Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) movies and assessed the relationship between technological portrayal and box office success. The study looked at 164 publications in academic literature that employed MCU movies. In addition to the foregoing, the study discovered that MCU movies have been used in academic literature in a variety of ways, including teaching science ideas, analyzing ethical dilemmas, and examining social and cultural themes. This shows that MCU movies could be used for educational and societal goals as well. Also, the study demonstrates that MCU movies are more than just popular entertainment. They can also be used to teach science, investigate ethical dilemmas, and investigate social and cultural themes. According to our main investigation, MCU movies represent a wide range of applied science topics, such as technology, magic, ancient technology, cosmic technology, multiverse technology, energy, physics, and engineering. Also, the portrayal of technology is important in the popularity of Science Fiction movies because audiences are drawn to the spectacle of sophisticated technology and the spectacular action sequences that it allows. The study also discovered that the depiction of technology is associated with box office performance, with movies with a higher Tech Content Count being more profitable.

AI.tldr: 通过分析164篇学术文献，该研究揭示了漫威电影宇宙(MCU)电影涵盖多种应用科学领域（技术、魔法、古老技术、宇宙技术、多元宇宙技术、能源、物理、工程），并发现技术呈现程度与票房成功呈正相关，表明先进技术的视觉奇观是吸引观众并驱动商业成功的关键因素。
AI.motivation: To investigate the applied science domains depicted in MCU movies and understand whether technological portrayal influences commercial success, given the growing academic and cultural significance of these films.
AI.method: The study analyzed 164 academic publications employing MCU movies and examined the portrayal of applied science domains across films. It quantified "Tech Content Count" and statistically assessed its relationship with box office performance.
AI.result: MCU movies encompass diverse applied science topics including technology, magic, ancient technology, cosmic technology, multiverse technology, energy, physics, and engineering. Films with higher Tech Content Count demonstrated greater profitability. Additionally, MCU movies have been utilized academically for teaching science, analyzing ethics, and examining social/cultural themes.
AI.conclusion: MCU movies serve as valuable educational and analytical tools beyond mere entertainment, encompassing teaching science concepts, ethical analysis, and cultural examination. The depiction of sophisticated technology is not only culturally significant but also economically consequential, as higher Tech Content Count strongly correlates with box office success.

title: Parameter Efficiency Is Not Memory Efficiency: Rethinking Fine-Tuning for On-Device LLM Adaptation
summary: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has become the standard for adapting large language models (LLMs). In this work we challenge the wide-spread assumption that parameter efficiency equates memory efficiency and on-device adaptability. We show that this is not true - while methods like LoRA and IA3 significantly reduce trainable parameters, they remain bound by intermediate tensors that scale linearly with sequence length, often triggering out-of-memory errors on-device. In this work, we introduce LARS (Low-memory Activation-Rank Subspace), a novel adaptation framework that decouples memory consumption from sequence length. While prior PEFT methods apply low-rank constraints to model parameters, LARS instead constrains the activation subspace used during training, directly targeting the dominant source of memory consumption and fundamentally flattening the memory growth rate. LARS reduces the memory footprint by an average of 33.54% on GPUs and 51.95% on CPUs in comparison to LoRA across reasoning, understanding and long-context datasets using different models while maintaining competitive accuracy and throughput. Besides GPUs, we deploy on Raspberry Pi and consumer-grade CPUs to demonstrate that LARS provides a scalable path for sophisticated LLM personalization on resource-constrained hardware and edge devices.

AI.tldr: LARS challenges the assumption that parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods like LoRA are also memory-efficient on-device. Instead, LARS constrains activation subspace during training to fundamentally flatten memory growth rate, achieving significant memory reduction while maintaining accuracy and enabling edge device deployment.
AI.motivation: Existing PEFT methods (LoRA, IA3) assume parameter efficiency = memory efficiency, but this assumption fails on-device because intermediate tensors scale with sequence length, causing OOM errors.
AI.method: LARS constrains the activation subspace used during training (rather than model parameters) to directly target the dominant memory consumption source, decoupling memory from sequence length.
AI.result: 33.54% memory reduction on GPUs, 51.95% on CPUs vs LoRA, competitive accuracy/throughput maintained, successful deployment on resource-constrained devices (Raspberry Pi, consumer CPUs).
AI.conclusion: LARS reduces memory footprint by 33.54% on GPUs and 51.95% on CPUs vs LoRA, maintains competitive accuracy/throughput, and enables deployment on Raspberry Pi and consumer-grade CPUs for edge device LLM personalization.

title: Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Function-Calling
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed to autonomously solve real-world tasks. A key ingredient for this is the LLM Function-Calling paradigm, a widely used approach for equipping LLMs with tool-use capabilities. However, an LLM calling functions incorrectly can have severe implications, especially when their effects are irreversible, e.g., transferring money or deleting data. Hence, it is of paramount importance to consider the LLM's confidence that a function call solves the task correctly prior to executing it. Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) methods can be used to quantify this confidence and prevent potentially incorrect function calls. In this work, we present what is, to our knowledge, the first evaluation of UQ methods for LLM Function-Calling (FC). While multi-sample UQ methods, such as Semantic Entropy, show strong performance for natural language Q&A tasks, we find that in the FC setting, it offers no clear advantage over simple single-sample UQ methods. Additionally, we find that the particularities of FC outputs can be leveraged to improve the performance of existing UQ methods in this setting. Specifically, multi-sample UQ methods benefit from clustering FC outputs based on their abstract syntax tree parsing, while single-sample UQ methods can be improved by selecting only semantically meaningful tokens when calculating logit-based uncertainty scores.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估了大语言模型（LLM）函数调用场景下的不确定性量化（UQ）方法。研究发现，在函数调用任务中，语义熵等多样本UQ方法相比简单的单样本方法并无明显优势。论文还提出两项改进：基于抽象语法树聚类的多样本方法和基于语义标记选择的对数概率方法。
AI.motivation: LLM函数调用在现实任务中广泛应用（如金融转账、数据删除），错误调用可能造成严重且不可逆的后果。因此，在执行函数调用前，准确评估LLM的置信度至关重要，但目前缺乏针对函数调用场景的UQ方法系统评估。
AI.method: 本文首次对LLM函数调用场景下的多种UQ方法进行了系统性评估。实验对比了多样本方法（如语义熵）与单样本方法，并通过函数调用输出的特殊性（抽象语法树结构、语义标记）来改进现有UQ方法。
AI.result: 主要发现：（1）在函数调用场景中，多样本UQ方法（如语义熵）相比简单单样本方法无明显优势；（2）利用函数调用输出特性可改进UQ方法：多样本方法受益于基于抽象语法树的聚类，单样本方法可通过仅选择语义有意义标记来提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 函数调用场景与自然语言Q&A任务对UQ方法的需求存在显著差异。函数调用输出的结构化特性（AST）可被有效利用来提升不确定性量化性能，为该领域未来研究指明方向。

title: Towards Causally Interpretable Wi-Fi CSI-Based Human Activity Recognition with Discrete Latent Compression and LTL Rule Extraction
summary: We address Human Activity Recognition (HAR) utilizing Wi-Fi Channel State Information (CSI) under the joint requirements of causal interpretability, symbolic controllability, and direct operation on high-dimensional raw signals. Deep neural models achieve strong predictive performance on CSI-based HAR (CHAR), yet rely on continuous latent representations that are opaque and difficult to modify; purely symbolic approaches, in contrast, cannot process raw CSI streams. We propose a fully automatic and strictly decoupled pipeline in which CSI magnitude windows are compressed by a categorical variational autoencoder with Gumbel-Softmax latent variables under a capacity-controlled objective, yielding a compact discrete representation. The encoder is then frozen and used as a deterministic mapping to one-hot latent trajectories. Causal discovery is performed on these trajectories to estimate class-conditional temporal dependency graphs. Statistically supported lagged dependencies are translated into Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) rules, producing a fully symbolic and deterministic classifier based solely on rule evaluation and aggregation, without any learned discriminative head. Because rules are defined over discrete latent variables, antenna-specific rule sets can in principle be combined at the symbolic level, enabling structured multi-antenna fusion without retraining the encoder. Results from CHAR Latent Temporal Rule Extraction (CHARL-TRE) indicate competitive performance while preserving explicit temporal and causal structure, showing that deterministic symbolic classification grounded in unsupervised discrete latent representations constitutes a viable alternative to end-to-end black-box models for wireless HAR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CHARL-TRE（CHAR Latent Temporal Rule Extraction）框架：一个完全自动化、严格解耦的流水线，先用带 Gumbel-Softmax 离散隐变量的类别变分自编码器（d=6、K=4，共 24 位 one-hot 指示）把高维 Wi-Fi CSI 幅度窗口压缩为离散潜在轨迹，再冻结编码器、在隐空间用 LPCMCI（ParCorr 检验，滞后 τ∈[1,5]）做类别条件因果发现，最后把带符号的滞后依赖确定性地翻译成 LTL 规则（正→激活、负→排斥），经基于对数似然比（LLR）的加权聚合得到完全确定性的符号分类器（无学习判别头），必要时对无规则类别用原型回退。实验在公开 CSI 数据集场景 S1 的 12 类活动上取得 >70% 准确率，验证了“离散潜在表征 + 统计因果结构 + 形式逻辑规则”作为端到端黑箱模型替代方案的可行性。
AI.motivation: Wi-Fi CSI 人体活动识别（CHAR）数据高维、噪声大且时序性强，高性能方法几乎都依赖深度神经网络，但这类模型的内部状态是连续、分布式、不可检视的，难以被终端用户理解和修改；而声明式/符号方法又无法直接处理原始 CSI 流。作者此前工作要么把压缩与下游推理纠缠在一起（如多天线 CSI 的 VAE 生成式压缩），要么依赖外部提供的语义基元（如基于视频提取的符号活动做因果发现与逻辑约束）。因此本文要同时满足三个要求：(i) 直接处理原始高维 CSI；(ii) 具有因果可解释的时序结构；(iii) 以确定性、形式逻辑语言完成分类，并且整个流程全自动、无需人工干预或特征工程。
AI.method:
三阶段严格解耦流水线 CHARL-TRE：
1. 预处理与分窗：仅保留 CSI 幅度（去相位以避免校准不稳），频域取前半段并每 4 个子载波下采样（2048→256），训练集全局 min-max 归一化；CSI 张量 X∈R^{T×Nf×Na}（T=12000 帧、150 fps、80 s/活动），单天线配置 Na=1；窗口长度 W=75、步长 1。
2. 类别变分自编码器：隐变量 z_i∈{1..K} 独立分类分布，d=6、K=4；采样用 straight-through Gumbel-Softmax（温度 τ）；编码器为三层 2D 卷积（核 (5,8),(5,8),(3,4)，步 (5,8),(5,8),(1,1)）+GELU+两个线性头，解码器镜像用转置卷积。损失 L=L_rec+λ_KL L_KL，其中 L_KL 采用 β-VAE 式容量控制：(1/B)Σ max(0, Σ_i KL[q(z_i|x)||p(z_i)]−C)，均匀先验 Cat(1/K)；每 epoch 三项协调调度：τ 单调下降、λ_KL 渐增、C 线性 ramp-up，以抑制后验坍塌并控制信息容量。训练后冻结编码器，取 argmax 得到硬 one-hot 潜在码，形成二值潜在时间序列（24 个原子命题 z_{d,c}）。
3. 因果发现与 LTL 规则抽取：在每个活动类别内分别对潜在轨迹做 LPCMCI（改进的 PCMCI，限制条件集于祖先、引入 middle marks，输出 PAG），MCI 检验采用偏相关 ParCorr（线性、高斯假设，但给出带符号依赖量）；滞后范围 τ∈[1,5]。带符号滞后依赖确定性翻译为 LTL：正向依赖→□(X_s → ○^τ X_d)，负向依赖→□(X_s → ○^τ ¬X_d)。
4. 两级搜索与确定性分类器：对每个候选规则统计前件出现数 n、后件满足数 h，用 Laplace 平滑得 p̂_a=(h+1)/(n+2) 与 p̂_¬a，计算判别间隔 Δ=p̂_a−p̂_¬a，保留 Δ>0 的规则并按 w_r=ω_r·max(0,Δ)·log(1+n_r) 排序（ω_r 为 LPCMCI 条件依赖统计量的绝对值），取 top-k 构成规则集 Φ_a；分类时每条规则贡献对数似然比 LLR=h·log(p̂_a/p̂_¬a)+(n−h)·log((1−p̂_a)/(1−p̂_¬a))，按归一化权重加权求和得 S_a^rule，argmax 决策；无规则类别（如 Empty）启用基于平均潜在激活的原型距离回退。
最佳配置：按时间顺序 0.7/0.3 划分，段长 80、跳步 10、分类器步长 75，规则抽取阈值 θ_p=0.0（不按边强度剪枝，仅用于可视化/摘要的过滤图阈值 θ_f=0.1），core-fraction=1.0，原型回退权重 1.0。因果图一旦估计即被复用，故性能差异来自规则选择与聚合而非随机重估。
AI.result: 初步实验显示准确率超过 70%（评估集 240 段，12 类活动：Walk、Run、Jump、Sit、Empty、Stand、Waving、Clap、Lay down、Wipe、Squat、Stretch）。混淆矩阵显示活动复杂度与误差强相关：准静态类（Stand、Wipe、Squat、Sit、Lay down）具有高召回与精度；高动态类表现差——20 段 Jump 中 15 段被误判为 Walk，Waving 仅提取到 N=4 条规则，其残余证据被更通用的 Walk 规则集吸收；Empty–Clap 混淆 7/20 段，源于 Empty 无符号规则、仅靠原型回退，其平均激活与 Clap 的稀疏签名重叠。规则数量被证明是分类难度的可靠代理（Clap N=2、Lay down N=2 最易错）。可解释性方面，每个决策都可追溯到具名潜在命题上的具体 LTL 公式、滞后 τ、经验支持 n 与间隔 Δ，例如 Walk 的 □(z_{0,3}→○²z_{1,2}) 表示“Z_0 取类别 3 时两拍后 Z_1 必取类别 2”这一有向时序规律。可扩展性上，编码器用大步长卷积早期降维、可扩展到大数据，但 LPCMCI 因变量数呈指数增长成为主要计算瓶颈。作者还指出基于逻辑合取/析取/投票可实现无需重训编码器的多天线规则级融合。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：完全确定性、基于 LTL 规则评估的分类器可以建立在无监督学习的离散潜在表征之上，在无线 HAR 中构成端到端黑箱模型的一种可行且有原则的替代方案，同时保留显式的因果结构与符号可控制性；规则可被检视、剪枝或修改而无需重训编码器。虽然潜在变量本身无预定义语义（与物理 CSI 现象的对应仍是开放问题），其时序交互结构足够稳定以支撑一致的规则抽取，说明单个潜在维度的语义可解释性并非因果与符号推理的前提。主要局限：固定容量离散压缩必然丢失信息，限制细微或快速变化活动的可分性；ParCorr 依赖线性条件独立检验，可能漏检非线性交互；滞后限制在 τ≤5，难以捕捉长程依赖；评估仅 240 段，削弱图估计的统计功效并提高采样敏感性；最佳配置中较宽松的规则阈值可能放大低支持度区域的噪声。未来工作方向为非线性因果检验、更长时域、更大评估集、域偏移鲁棒性以及多天线融合实验。

title: Towards System-Oriented Formal Verification of Local-First Access Control
summary: Conflict-free replicated data types (CRDTs) and the local-first concept are increasingly employed not only in small-scale collaboration systems among few users who trust each other, but also in large-scale systems, like Matrix for instant messaging and Keyhive for collaborative documents. Since mutual trust is no longer warranted, these systems require Byzantine fault tolerance and fine-grained access control. As of today, Matrix and Keyhive pair an informal specification with an unverified reference implementation. In this work, we follow a bottom-up approach towards constructing formally verified authorization algorithms for Byzantine fault-tolerant local-first systems. As intermediate target for formal verification, we contribute semantics and invariants of a replicated data type for managing simplified collaboration groups, based on capabilities for access control and hash chronicles for replication. To enable future integration into local-first systems like Matrix and Keyhive, we strive for accessibility to system engineers by using the Rust programming language for formal specification, verification, and implementation, enabled by the Verus framework using the Z3 theorem prover at zero runtime cost. We report on our experience and preliminary results following this approach, and discuss next steps towards scaling up access control expressiveness. Whether this approach can be scaled up to the complexity of real-world local-first access control systems like Matrix or Keyhive remains future work, but our findings demonstrate the potential of system-oriented formal verification with Verus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于拜占庭容错本地优先系统的形式化验证授权算法，采用Rust+Verus+Z3技术栈，通过能力和哈希编年史实现复制数据类型的规范与验证。
AI.motivation: 当前如Matrix和Keyhive等本地优先系统仅依赖非正式规范和未验证的参考实现，缺乏拜占庭容错和细粒度访问控制的正式验证。传统上本地优先系统假设用户间相互信任，但在大型系统中这一假设不再成立。
AI.method: 采用自底向上的方法，使用Rust编程语言通过Verus框架（在零运行时开销条件下利用Z3定理证明器）进行形式化规范、验证和实现。
AI.result: 构建了用于管理简化协作组的复制数据类型语义和不变量，基于能力（capabilities）进行访问控制，使用哈希编年史（hash chronicles）进行复制。为未来集成到Matrix和Keyhive等系统奠定了基础。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在可扩展性方面仍存在挑战，能否扩展到Matrix或Keyhive等真实系统的复杂度仍是未来工作。但初步结果表明，基于Rust的形式化验证方法在系统级验证中具有潜力。

title: Quantifying Divergence in Inter-LLM Communication Through API Retrieval and Ranking
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly operate as autonomous agents that reason over external APIs to perform complex tasks. However, their reliability and agreement remain poorly characterized. We present a unified benchmarking framework to quantify inter-LLM divergence, defined as the extent to which models differ in API discovery and ranking under identical tasks. Across 15 canonical API domains and 5 major model families, we measure pairwise and group-level agreement using set-, rank-, and consensus-based metrics including Average Overlap, Jaccard similarity, Rank-Biased Overlap, Kendall's tau, Kendall's W, and Cronbach's alpha. Results show moderate overall alignment (AO about 0.50, tau about 0.45) but strong domain dependence: structured tasks (Weather, Speech-to-Text) are stable, while open-ended tasks (Sentiment Analysis) exhibit substantially higher divergence. Volatility and consensus analyses reveal that coherence clusters around data-bound domains and degrades for abstract reasoning tasks. These insights enable reliability-aware orchestration in multi-agent systems, where consensus weighting can improve coordination among heterogeneous LLMs. Beyond performance benchmarking, our results reveal systematic failure modes in multi-agent LLM coordination, where apparent agreement can mask instability in action-relevant rankings. This hidden divergence poses a pre-deployment safety risk and motivates diagnostic benchmarks for early detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的基准测试框架，用于量化不同大语言模型在相同任务下进行 API 发现与排序时的一致性/分歧程度（inter-LLM divergence），在15个API领域、5个主流模型家族上用集合、排序与共识类指标（Average Overlap、Jaccard、RBO、Kendall's tau、Kendall's W、Cronbach's alpha）进行成对与群体层面测量。结果显示整体一致性中等（AO≈0.50，tau≈0.45），但强烈依赖领域：结构化任务（Weather、Speech-to-Text）稳定，开放式任务（Sentiment Analysis）分歧显著更大。
AI.motivation: 当LLM作为自主智能体调用外部API执行复杂任务时，其可靠性与彼此一致性（agreement）缺乏系统刻画。若多个模型对"应调用哪些API"及"如何排序"给出不同答案，多智能体系统的协同行为将不可预测，且表面一致（consensus）可能掩盖行动相关排序上的隐藏分歧，带来部署前的安全隐患。因此需要一个统一、可复现的基准框架来量化模型间的分歧，并识别多智能体协调中的系统性失效模式。
AI.method: 构建统一基准测试框架：统一任务设定下的API发现与排序输出规范化为可比较的集合/排序表示。在15个典型API领域与5个主要模型家族（多模型、跨厂商）上采集结果。采用三类指标族——(1) 集合类：Average Overlap、Jaccard相似度；(2) 排序类：Rank-Biased Overlap、Kendall's tau；(3) 共识/群体类：Kendall's W、Cronbach's alpha——同时计算成对一致性与群体层面一致性。此外进行波动性（volatility）与共识强度分析，并将分歧按领域性质（结构化 vs. 开放式/抽象推理）分组对比。
AI.result: 整体上模型间一致性处于中等水平（AO≈0.50，tau≈0.45），表明模型在API选择上大体趋同但存在系统性差异。领域依赖性显著：结构化、数据驱动的任务（Weather、Speech-to-Text）上排序稳定、共识簇（coherence cluster）明显；而开放式任务（Sentiment Analysis）与抽象推理任务上分歧大幅上升，群体一致性退化。波动性与共识分析进一步表明"表面一致"可能掩盖与行动直接相关的排序不稳定性——即高Cronbach's alpha/Kendall's W并不必然对应可靠的API优先级排序。此外，结果揭示了多智能体LLM协调中的系统性失效模式：跨模型表面一致性与实际行为稳定性脱耦。
AI.conclusion: 统一的分歧量化基准能够刻画LLM作为API调用智能体时的可靠性画像，并支持"可靠性感知"的编排（reliability-aware orchestration）：在多智能体系统中按共识强度加权模型，可改善异构LLM之间的协调。论文强调需引入诊断型基准（diagnostic benchmarks）以在部署前尽早检测隐藏分歧这一安全风险，而非仅依赖整体性能评测或粗粒度的共识指标。

title: RAT: RunAnyThing via Fully Automated Environment Configuration
summary: Automating repository-level software engineering tasks is a foundational challenge for autonomous code agents, largely due to the difficulty of configuring executable environments. However, manual configuration remains a labor-intensive bottleneck, necessitating a transition toward fully automated environment configuration. Existing approaches often rely on pre-defined artifacts or are restricted to specific programming languages, limiting their applicability to real-world repositories. In this paper, we first propose RAT (RunAnyThing), a language-agnostic framework for automated environment configuration on arbitrary repositories. RAT features a multi-stage pipeline that integrates semantic initialization, a planning mechanism, specialized toolset, and a robust sandbox for configuration. Furthermore, to enable rigorous evaluation, we propose RATBench, a benchmark that reflects the the distribution and heterogeneity of real-world repositories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RAT achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving the Environment Setup Success Rate (ESSR) by an average of 29.6% over strong baselines.

AI.tldr: RAT（RunAnyThing）是一个语言无关、模块化可扩展的智能体框架，用多阶段流水线（语言感知抽象、ImageRetriever 语义选基镜像、Standard/Automated 两种配置模式、专用配置工具集、健壮 Docker 沙箱、长期经验积累）在容器沙箱中自动完成任意仓库的环境配置；同时构建了覆盖 2,500+ 个多语言 GitHub 仓库、执行验证驱动的基准 RATBench。实验显示 RAT 在各语言上取得最优 ESSR，较强基线平均提升约 29.6%–36.1%（摘要与正文数字不一致），并在 Python 上略超资深人类工程师。
AI.motivation: 仓库级自主软件工程的一个根本瓶颈是「可执行环境」的构建：没有正确配置的环境，即使逻辑正确的代码也无法验证与运行，从而限制代码智能体的数据合成、基于执行的强化学习与部署可复现性。现有方案存在三类限制：(1) 依赖预置产物（Dockerfile、安装脚本、CI 日志），如 INSTALLAMATIC/EXECUTIONAGENT；(2) 框架僵化、语言受限，如 Repo2Run 仅支持 Python；(3) 评测基准规模小、语言覆盖窄、偏向简单项目或仅用静态指标（如 EnvBench），无法反映真实仓库的分布与异质性。因此需要语言无关、零预置假设的全自动环境配置框架，以及能真实反映分布与难度的大规模执行驱动基准。
AI.method:
框架：RAT 采用容器化沙箱内的多阶段流水线。1) Language-Aware Abstraction：识别主语言（按代码占比），把依赖模式（pom.xml、Cargo.toml 等）、包管理器协议、测试运行器封装进统一接口，实现语言解耦与低成本扩展（新增 Go 仅约 1,014 行，其中框架本体 425 行）。2) ImageRetriever：LLM 对文档与配置产物做语义分析，推断语言版本/OS/深度学习框架，从标准镜像池检索并按需生成 Docker Hub 搜索查询，再由 LLM 打分选最优基镜像（抽样 150 仓中初始选择正确率 87.39%）。3) Configuration Modes：Standard Mode（按语言固定工作流迭代执行）与 Automated Mode（自主发现仓库特定工作流，维护 plan.md 分阶段），整体以 ReAct 组织交互轨迹 τ(R)。4) Configuration Toolset：四类专用工具——仓库理解（construct_test、ls_structure、view_outline、read_file）、知识检索（search_repo、search_web、retrieve_image、retrieve_issue）、环境搭建（edit_file、detect_environment、cicd_config、change_python/java_version、stop）、验证（run_test、run_pytest/collect），并辅以测试合成与多通道错误恢复（LLM 内生调试 + 仓库 issue 检索 + StackOverflow）。5) Robust Sandbox：模板化 Dockerfile 生成、镜像本地化、工具注入与预构建校验。6) 长期经验积累：从历史轨迹合成结构化（JSON）专家知识。算法层面为「抽取配置产物与语言 → 检索基镜像并打分 → 模板构建 F0 并构建校验 → 注入工具 → ReAct 循环（上限 30 轮，150K token 上下文）→ 由 F0∪τ 推断最终 Dockerfile」。

基准：RATBench 2,500 个 GitHub 仓库（每语言 500 核心集），覆盖 Python、Java、Rust、JS/TS、Go 五语言；采用「项目规模 × 热度」二维分层抽样（规模三档、star 11–155,569，中位 294）；自动收集（近一年活跃、≥10 star、含构建清单或测试目录）并以执行驱动验证；按「容器化产物/单测是否存在」划分 S1（有产物）、S2（无产物）、S3（无产物无测试，用入口点或合成 smoke test 定义 N_verified）三档场景。指标：ESSR（N_pass/N_verified，Python 用验证过测试集作分母）、Latency、Tokens。

基线：pipreqs、Zero-shot LLM、SWE-agent、Installamatic、Repo2Run（附录另比 Claude Code）。
AI.result: 1) 主结果（DeepSeek-V3）：RAT 在 Python 63.2%、Java 41.3%、Rust 98.7%、JS/TS 68.7%、Go 71.7%，全面领先；pipreqs 35.8%、Zero-shot 15.2/0/0/7.3/0、SWE-agent 15.5/29.3/56.7/51.8/9.7、Installamatic 6.7、Repo2Run(Python) 44.8%。较 SWE-agent 平均提升 36.1%（附录另称 47.7%），摘要称平均提升 29.6%。2) 场景鲁棒性（Python S1/S2/S3）：RAT 50.5/69.5/92.0（均值 70.7），Repo2Run 39.8/25.4/3.0（均值 22.7），后者随产物缺失急剧退化。3) 消融（Python）：w/o init 40.5%、w/o tool 55.7%、RAT-auto 56.9%，完整 RAT 63.2%；auto 模式 token 364.2K、时延 16.0 min（低于完整模式的 421.9K/24.3 min）；RAT 平均成本约 $0.30/仓库。4) 骨干泛化：RAT 在 Qwen3-Coder-30B/DeepSeek-V3/GLM-5/GPT-5.2 上分别 47.2/63.2/69.5/86.8，均优于 Repo2Run 的 33.2/44.8/59.3/25.1。5) 人类对比（Python 3 仓）：工程师 ESSR 89.41%、13.73 min、难度 2.9/5、努力 3.3/5；RAT ESSR 91.52%、31.26 min（慢约 2.25 倍但高 2.36%）。跨语言（Python/Java/Rust/JS/TS 各加 10 仓）RAT 总体优于人类（Java 40.0 vs 20.04；JS/TS 80.0 vs 70.0；Rust 60.0 vs 80.0 为唯一落后项）。6) 跨基准：在第三方 Repo2Run 基准上 RAT ESSR 36%，较最强基线提升 20.5%。7) 扩展性（Figure 2）：ESSR 随执行步数上升呈类 scaling-law，单仓库延迟增长趋缓；Repo2Run 无稳定提升。8) 失败分析：主要失败为 ConnectionError（外部 API/DB/消息代理不可达、缺凭证）与 RuntimeError（缺系统库、二进制不兼容、硬件/驱动假设），另有项目深度与 ESSR 显著负相关（r=-0.2859, p=0.0009），大仓通过率仅 4.8%。
AI.conclusion: RAT 通过把「语言特定启发式」与「通用智能体能力」解耦，并结合语义镜像初始化、双配置模式、配置专用工具集与健壮沙箱，在无需预置产物的条件下实现了跨语言、跨仓库的全自动环境配置，显著优于静态工具、通用 SWE 智能体与专用配置智能体（Repo2Run、Installamatic），并在设置成功率上接近甚至超过资深人类工程师。RATBench 以执行验证、分层抽样与多语言覆盖提供了更贴近真实分布的评测基础。局限：仅支持单容器场景，未覆盖 docker-compose 多服务编排（跨容器网络、服务就绪、共享卷、sidecar 版本、Docker-in-Docker）；不支持 GPU 等硬件相关环境（驱动/CUDA/cuDNN 对齐）；不处理需外部凭证（API key）的配置。论文还承认提升幅度数字在摘要（29.6%）与正文（36.1%、47.7%）间不一致，以及部分指标以构建成功代理运行正确性、基线实现经过适配带来的可比性风险。未来方向为更广仓库与部署场景、多服务/硬件感知/人在环配置，以及面向数据合成与执行式强化学习的落地。

title: A more versatile model for enumerative kernelization: a case study for Vertex Cover
summary: Enumerative kernelization is a recent promising at the intersection of parameterized complexity and enumeration algorithms, with two proposed models. The first, known as enum-kernels and due to Creignou et al., was too permissive, leading to constant-sized kernels for every problem solvable with FPT-delay. To remedy this, Golovach et al. proposed the polynomial-delay enumeration kernelization model that, while addressing the shortcoming of the previous one, appears to be too strict, which we believe is a central reason for the slow development of the area. In this paper, we propose a new model for enumeration kernels, which we have called polynomial-delay (PD) kernels. It is more flexible than Golovach et al.'s kernels while still preserving their qualities; informally, it allows us to ignore ``bad'' solutions of the compressed instance when producing the solution set of the input instance, but still requires that the ``good'' solutions are lifted with polynomial-delay. After discussing the main properties of our model, we design a generic framework for vertex-subset problems to adapt decision kernels into PD kernels of the same size. We showcase our model's versatility and the framework's expressive power on the \textsc{Enum Vertex Cover} problem, where we want to list all vertex covers of size at most $k$ of a given graph. We generalize the kernelization dichotomy by Bougeret et al. about the existence of polynomial kernels for \textsc{Vertex Cover} parameterized by the vertex deletion distance to a minor-closed graph class, as well as by the solution size or feedback vertex number. The second one, in particular, is significantly simpler than the known kernel, requiring only a few lines for its lifting algorithm. Beyond our framework, we also show how to generalize to the enumeration setting the kernel of Bougeret et al. for the vertex-deletion distance to $c$-treedepth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的多项式延迟(PD)核模型，解决了现有枚举核化模型过于宽松或过于严格的问题。该模型在保持良好性质的同时提供了灵活性，并设计了将决策核适配为PD核的通用框架。应用该框架到Enum Vertex Cover问题，成功推广了Bougeret等人的核化二分结果，同时大幅简化了基于反馈顶点数的核化算法。
AI.motivation: 现有枚举核化模型存在根本性缺陷：Creignou等的模型过于宽松，导致几乎所有FPT延迟可解决的问题都存在常数规模核；而Golovach等的模型又过于严格，阻碍了该领域的发展。
AI.method: 1. 提出新的PD核模型，在保持 Golovach 模型优点的同时增加灵活性；2. 设计通用框架将顶点子集问题的决策核转化为同等规模的PD核；3. 应用到Enum Vertex Cover问题进行具体验证
AI.result: 1. 成功将Bougeret等的核化二分结果推广到枚举设置，涵盖参数：顶点删除距离到minor-closed图类、解的大小和反馈顶点数；2. 基于反馈顶点数的核化比已知结果简单得多，提升算法可读性；3. 进一步将Bougeret等的c-treedepth顶点删除距离核推广到枚举设置
AI.conclusion: PD kernels模型在保持良好性质的同时提供了足够的灵活性，为枚举核化领域提供了新的研究方向。该模型结合通用框架可系统地将决策核扩展到枚举设置，为枚举核化的进一步发展奠定了基础。

title: EndoGov: A knowledge-governed multi-agent expert system for endometrial cancer risk stratification
summary: Multimodal artificial intelligence models for endometrial cancer (EC) risk stratification typically optimize aggregate predictive performance but provide limited mechanisms for enforcing mandatory guideline overrides, such as assigning POLE-mutated tumors to the low-risk group despite high-grade morphology. We present EndoGov, a two-tier multi-agent expert system that factorizes the decision process as D(x) = G(P(x), R), where specialist agents P extract structured evidence and a governance agent G applies an executable rule set R. Tier 1 comprises pathology, molecular, and clinical agents that independently generate schema-constrained reports from frozen foundation-model features or structured records. Tier 2 queries an evidence-level-weighted Guideline Knowledge Graph, using deterministic hard-path rules for high-priority overrides and constrained soft-path reasoning for ambiguous cases. In TCGA-UCEC (n=541), EndoGov achieved 0.943 accuracy, 0.973 macro AUC, and a conditional logic-violation rate (C-LVR) of 0.93% among trigger-exposed cases. In CPTAC-UCEC (n=95), where reference labels are guideline-derived, EndoGov reached 0.842 accuracy compared with < 0.31 for locked-transfer neural baselines, supporting governance-pathway transfer under distribution shift rather than validation against independent clinical truth. End-to-end safety decomposition localized residual failures primarily to upstream molecular detection rather than downstream governance. Backend-swap experiments further showed that hard-path compliance is invariant to the LLM backend. These findings indicate that explicit clinical-rule governance can provide guideline-compliant, auditable EC risk assignment while preserving competitive discrimination.

AI.tldr: EndoGov 是一个两层级多智能体专家系统，将子宫内膜癌（EC）ESMO 四层风险分层决策分解为 D(x)=G(P(x), R)：Tier 1 由病理（冻结 UNI 原型匹配）、分子（DNA 优先、scGPT 兜底）、临床（FIGO 归一化）三个专家智能体各自产出模式约束的结构化报告；Tier 2 由"主席"智能体在指南知识图（Guideline-KG）上执行可执行规则层——高优先级硬路径确定性覆盖（如 POLE 突变→低风险，p53abn→高风险），无硬触发时走受约束的软路径推理，并以校验器（validator）做规则—标签一致性审计。TCGA-UCEC（N=541）上准确率 0.943、macro AUC 0.973、ECE 0.075，触发暴露子集上的条件逻辑违反率 C-LVR 为 0.93%；CPTAC-UCEC（N=95）锁定迁移下准确率 0.842（神经基线 <0.31）。核心结论是：近零规则违反是"架构性条件保证"，残余风险主要来自上游分子检测（尤其 RNA 回退路径的 p53abn/NSMP 混淆）而非下游治理。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态 EC 风险分层模型（MCAT、Porpoise、TransMME、HECTOR 等）以平均损失优化总体判别性能，无法在推理环内强制执行指南的高优先级确定性覆盖规则。例如 POLE 超突变按 ESMO/ESGO 应归入低风险组，但密集的形态学（高分级）证据会压倒稀疏却具决定性的分子信号，导致"逻辑盲区"（logic blind spot）。后置规则包装 D(x)=R(f(x)) 只能改写终端标签，无法做规则引导的证据收集、优先级仲裁与逐条溯源。本文因此提出：把决策分解为感知 P 与治理 G 的显式分离，使不确定的感知与确定的规则控制共处于同一部署管线，并建立分层的安全评估协议（触发暴露、治理层可靠性、端到端安全、校准、灰区行为）。
AI.method:
架构：将决策分解为 D(x)=G(P(x),R)，R 为存于 Guideline-KG 的可执行规则集。
