The experimental results demonstrate that SG-RAG significantly outperforms strong baselines on ERQA, delivering absolute improvements from 20.68 to 50.88 points across all evaluation metrics, while maintaining reasonable computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了精确检索问题（ERP），旨在解决现有RAG方法因仅依赖向量相似性而导致的语义噪声和条件满足不完整问题。提出了SG-RAG方法，通过子图匹配任务融入结构信息引导LLM生成，并构建了包含12万个问答对的大规模评估数据集ERQA，覆盖20个领域。实验表明SG-RAG在所有指标上实现了20.68至50.88点的绝对提升。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法主要依赖向量相似性进行检索，存在两个核心问题：(1) 语义噪声：检索结果在语义层面可能包含大量不相关信息；(2) 条件满足不完整：无法确保生成的响应完全满足事实性查询中的复杂条件约束，导致回答错误。作者认为需要引入结构化信息来增强检索的精确性。
AI.method: 作者提出两项核心贡献：(1) 问题形式化：定义"精确检索问题（ERP）"，首次明确将结构信息纳入RAG以满足事实性查询的所有条件；(2) 方法设计：提出SG-RAG，将检索过程建模为基于嵌入的子图匹配任务，利用检索到的拓扑结构引导LLM生成满足所有查询条件的答案。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，SG-RAG在ERQA数据集上显著优于强基线模型，在所有评估指标上实现了20.68至50.88个百分点的绝对提升，同时保持了合理的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过将结构化信息显式融入RAG检索过程，SG-RAG有效解决了传统方法的条件满足问题。ERQA数据集的构建为该领域提供了标准化的评估基准。实验验证了结构引导方法在提升RAG系统事实准确性方面的有效性。

title: Can LLMs be Effective Code Contributors? A Study on Open-source Projects
summary: LLM-generated code is widely used, and the share of committed code produced by LLMs is expected to increase. However, we are not at a point where LLMs can be effective contributors to production code. We present an approach that exposes the shortcomings of LLM generation on such projects, and proposes recommendations; the targets of our study are sizable open-source projects, e.g., FFmpeg and wolfSSL. First, we developed a framework that uses verification and validation to evaluate a given LLM's suitability to fix or add features to an existing project. Second, we apply the framework to 212 commits (bug fixes and small feature improvements) in eight popular open-source projects and three LLMs: GPT-4o, Ministral3, and Qwen3-Coder. The success rate varied from 0% to 60% depending on the project. The LLMs failed in a variety of ways, from generating syntactically incorrect code, to producing code that fails basic (static) verification, or validation via the project's test suite. In particular, the LLMs struggle with generating new code, handling contexts (function or file) outside a certain size range, and in many cases their success is due to parroting code changes they have been trained on.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了LLM（GPT-4o、Ministral3、Qwen3-Coder）在真实开源项目（FFmpeg、wolfSSL等）中生成生产代码的能力。通过212个提交任务的验证测试，成功率仅为0-60%，暴露了LLM在代码生成、上下文处理和泛化能力方面的显著局限性。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的代码在提交中的占比日益增加，但LLM是否能够有效参与生产代码仍不明确。本研究旨在系统性地评估LLM在大型开源项目中修复bug和添加功能的能力，并揭示其不足之处。
AI.method: 研究团队开发了一个基于验证与确认（V&V）框架，应用于8个流行开源项目中的212个提交任务（bug修复和小功能改进），对GPT-4o、Ministral3和Qwen3-Coder三个LLM进行评估。
AI.result: LLM的成功率因项目而异，从0%到60%不等。失败模式多样：生成语法错误的代码、通过不了静态验证、或无法通过项目测试套件验证。
AI.conclusion: LLM在生成新代码、处理超出特定范围的上下文（函数或文件大小）时存在困难，其"成功"在很大程度上可能依赖于对训练数据中已有代码变更的复述，而非真正的泛化能力。

title: Dynamic Grammar-Compressed Self-Index in $delta$-Optimal Space
summary: A compressed self-index stores a string in compressed form while supporting locate queries without decompression. For highly repetitive strings (arising in web crawls, versioned documents, and genomic collections), static self-indexes can match the $δ$-optimal lower bound of $Ω(δ\log(n \log σ/ (δ\log n)) \log n)$ bits up to constant factors, where $n$ is the string length, $σ$ is the alphabet size, and $δ$ is the substring complexity. Their dynamic counterparts, however, remain scarce: every existing dynamic self-index either fails to attain $δ$-optimal space, pays at least $Θ(\log n)$ time per reported occurrence during locate, or exposes the longest common prefix (LCP) of the text inside its update time. We present the dynamic RR-index, a dynamic grammar-compressed self-index built on the restricted recompression run-length straight-line program (RLSLP). To our knowledge, it is the first dynamic self-index to attain $δ$-optimal space. The index occupies expected $O(δ\log(n \log σ/ (δ\log n)) \log n)$ bits, answers locate queries in expected $O(m + \log m \log^{2} n + \mathit{occ} (\log n / \log \log n))$ time (where $m$ is the pattern length and $\mathit{occ}$ is the number of occurrences), and supports insertions and deletions of a length-$m'$ substring in expected amortized $O(m' \log^{2} n + \log^{3} n)$ time, with no dependence on the LCP. On eleven highly repetitive corpora, including a $37$ GB Wikipedia dump and a $59$ GB human-chromosome collection, the dynamic RR-index is up to $77\times$ faster than the dynamic r-index on updates and up to $11\times$ faster than other dynamic indexes on locate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态RR-index，首个达到δ-最优空间的动态语法压缩自索引。基于RLSLP构建，在高度重复字符串上实现最优空间的同时，支持高效定位查询（O(m + occ log n/log log n)）和动态更新（O(m' log² n + log³ n)），且不暴露LCP。在37GB维基百科和59GB人类染色体数据集上验证，性能显著优于现有方案。
AI.motivation: 现有动态自索引存在三个主要瓶颈：无法达到δ-最优空间、定位查询需Θ(log n)时间报告每个出现位置、或在更新时暴露最长公共前缀（LCP）。对于网页爬取、版本化文档和基因组集合等高度重复的字符串，需要一种能同时满足空间最优和时间高效的动态索引结构。
AI.method: 该索引基于受限重压缩游程直线式程序（RLSLP）构建。通过维护RLSLP的压缩表示，结合高效的查询处理算法，实现在保持δ-最优空间的同时，支持快速的位置查询和动态更新操作。
AI.result: 该索引在11个高度重复的语料库上进行了实验评估。在更新操作上比动态r-index快最多77倍，在定位操作上比其他动态索引快最多11倍。索引占用预期O(δ log(n log σ/(δ log n)) log n)位空间，定位查询时间为O(m + log m log² n + occ (log n/log log n))，插入/删除时间为O(m' log² n + log³ n)摊销时间，且不依赖LCP。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了第一个达到δ-最优空间的动态自索引结构，解决了现有动态自索引在空间效率、时间复杂度或LCP依赖性方面的权衡困境。实验表明，该索引在真实大规模数据集上（37GB维基百科和59GB人类染色体集合）显著优于现有方法，更新操作最高快77倍，定位操作最高快11倍。

title: Information-Theoretic Measures in AI: A Practical Decision Guide
comment: 25 pages, 2 tables, 1 figure. Submitted to Applied Intelligence (Springer)
summary:
Information-theoretic (IT) measures are ubiquitous in artificial intelligence: entropy drives decision-tree splits and uncertainty quantification, cross-entropy is the default classification loss, mutual information underpins representation learning and feature selection, and transfer entropy reveals directed influence in dynamical systems.
  A second, less consolidated family of measures, integrated information (Phi), effective information (EI), and autonomy, has emerged for characterizing agent complexity. Despite wide adoption, measure selection is often decoupled from estimator assumptions, failure modes, and safe inferential claims.
  This paper provides a practical decision framework for all seven measures, organized around three prescriptive questions for each: (i) what question does the measure answer and in which AI context; (ii) which estimator is appropriate for the data type and dimensionality; and (iii) what is the most dangerous misuse. The framework is operationalized in two complementary artifacts: a measure-selection flowchart and a master decision table. We cover both AI/ML and decision-making agent application domains per measure, with standardized Bridge Boxes linking IT quantities to cognitive constructs. Three worked examples illustrate the framework on concrete practitioner scenarios spanning representation learning, temporal influence analysis, and evolved agent complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文为人工智能中七种信息论和复杂性度量（熵、交叉熵、互信息、传递熵、整合信息Φ、有效信息EI、自主性）提供了实用的决策框架，通过流程图和决策表来指导从业者选择合适的度量方法。
AI.motivation: 信息论度量在人工智能中应用广泛（决策树、不确定性量化、表征学习、特征选择、动态系统分析），但度量的选择往往与估计器假设、失效模式和可靠推理条件相脱节，导致实践者难以正确应用这些工具。
AI.method: 围绕三个规范性问题组织框架：(i) 度量回答什么问题及适用的AI场景；(ii) 针对数据类型和维度选择何种估计器；(iii) 最危险的误用是什么。通过流程图和主决策表将框架操作化，并用表征学习、时间影响分析和演化智能体复杂性三个案例进行说明。
AI.result: 建立了包含度量选择流程图和主决策表的完整决策框架，覆盖AI/ML和决策智能体两大应用领域，并提供标准化的"桥接框"将信息论量与认知结构关联。
AI.conclusion: 该框架弥合了理论度量与实践应用之间的差距，为研究者和从业者提供了系统化的度量选择指南，有助于在具体应用场景中做出更可靠的推断和决策。

title: UGAF-ITS: A Standards Harmonization Framework and Validation Tool for Multi-Framework AI Governance in Distributed Intelligent Transportation Systems
summary:
Organizations deploying AI-enabled Intelligent Transportation Systems face fragmented governance: ISO/IEC 42001 demands a certifiable management system, the EU AI Act imposes binding high-risk obligations from August 2026, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework structures voluntary practice. Each instrument is internally coherent, yet they drive different control vocabularies, evidence expectations, and audit rhythms. In distributed ITS deployments where vehicle manufacturers, roadside integrators, and cloud operators each hold partial evidence and partial accountability, this fragmentation multiplies compliance effort and obscures incident traceability.
  This paper introduces UGAF-ITS, a standards harmonization framework that consolidates 154 source obligations from the three instruments into 12 unified controls across eight governance domains through a reproducible five-phase crosswalk methodology. A three-tier operating model allocates each control to the vehicle, edge, or cloud tier where enforcement and defensible evidence production are feasible. An evidence backbone of 20 versioned artifacts supports a single audit package across all three frameworks without duplicating content.
  We validate UGAF-ITS through an open-source governance engine evaluated across four architecturally distinct ITS deployment scenarios. The engine encodes the complete crosswalk catalog and executes eight compliance computations. Three-tier deployments achieve 91.7% average framework coverage with 45.9% evidence reduction, complete bidirectional traceability, and 80% of artifacts serving all three frameworks simultaneously. Partial deployments degrade gracefully: coverage and reduction scale with architectural complexity. The tool, scenarios, and all reported results are publicly available for independent replication.

AI.tldr: 本文针对AI智能交通系统面临的多元标准治理碎片化问题，提出UGAF-ITS统一治理框架。该框架通过五阶段方法论将154项源义务整合为12项跨框架控制措施，构建三层运营模型和证据主干，实现单一审计包覆盖ISO/IEC 42001、EU AI Act和NIST AI RMF三大标准，验证实现91.7%覆盖率与45.9%证据减少。
AI.motivation: AI赋能智能交通系统（ITS）面临治理碎片化困境：ISO/IEC 42001、EU AI Act和NIST AI RMF三项标准各具内部一致性，但驱动不同控制词汇、证据期望和审计节奏。在车辆制造商、路侧集成商和云运营商各自持有部分证据和部分责任的分布式ITS部署中，这种碎片化倍增合规工作量并模糊事件溯源能力。
AI.method: 采用可复现的五阶段交叉映射方法论，将154项源义务整合为12项统一控制措施，分配至车辆层、边缘层和云层三层运营模型，并建立包含20个版本化工件证据主干的单一审计包。
AI.result: 三层部署实现91.7%平均框架覆盖率，证据减少45.9%，完全双向可溯源，80%工件同时服务三个框架。部分部署可优雅降级，覆盖率和减少率随架构复杂性缩放。
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了UGAF-ITS框架的有效性：通过开放源代码治理引擎在四个不同ITS部署场景中验证，实现91.7%平均框架覆盖率、45.9%证据减少率、双向完整可追溯性，以及80%工件同时服务三个框架。分层部署可优雅降级，覆盖率和减少率随架构复杂性缩放。所有工具、场景和结果均公开可复现。

title: Avionic Main Fuel Pump Simulation and Fault-Diagnosis Benchmark
summary: In many cyber-physical systems, especially in critical applications such as aeroplanes, data to train anomaly detection and diagnosis algorithms is lacking due to data protection issues and partial observability. To combat this inherent lack of data, we introduce a high-fidelity, physics-informed co-simulation of a common aircraft main-fuel-pump system modelled in \textsc{MATLAB/Simulink Simscape Fluids}. We also describe its generated time-series data with health and fault mode annotations. To show feasibility of our benchmark, we apply an unsupervised Recurrent Variational Autoencoder (RNN-VAE) for anomaly detection and a SOM-VAE for operating mode discretization, trained to separate healthy and faulty conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于 MATLAB/Simulink Simscape Fluids 的高保真、物理信息耦合仿真模型，用于模拟飞机主齿轮燃油泵（Eaton 系列）系统，并发布带健康状态与故障模式标注的多变量时间序列基准数据集（含噪声、随机性与 9 类单故障场景，共 1000 次仿真、30 s、200 Hz）。作者以无监督 RNN-VAE 做异常检测（Composite F1 多在 0.87–1.0，白噪声与旁通阀故障失败），以 SOM-VAE 做运行模式离散化（Purity 最高 0.8846），验证了该基准对一致性诊断与异常检测研究可直接使用。
AI.motivation: 航空电子燃油系统属于关键 CPS，普遍存在部分可观测性：出于成本考虑很多状态监测传感器未安装，且真实故障数据极为稀缺，叠加数据保护限制，导致数据驱动方法难以训练与验证，预测维护的可信 AI 落地受阻。因此需要高保真、可注入故障、带有诊断算法所需标注的公开基准。已有基准（BeRfiPl、HAI-CPPS、TEP-Alarm、水网络、NoBOOM、LiU-ICE）分别存在故障类型单一、系统复杂度不足、缺少可执行模型/健康标注、缺少连续-离散混合信号或不可扩展等问题，无法满足一致性诊断（CBD）的输入需求。
AI.method: 1）仿真建模：在 Simscape Fluids 中以自定义 Isothermal Liquid 定义煤油介质（ρ=784 kg/m³，μ=7.67e-4 Pa·s，ν=9.8e-7 m²/s，等温体积模量 1.5 GPa），用 Eaton 目录数据反推泵参数建模定排量主齿轮泵（p_out=69 bar，p_in=2 bar，Δp=67 bar，n=6000 rpm，Q=58 gpm，容积效率 0.9，排量 D=40.7 cm³/rev），并搭建增压油箱、旁通阀（67 bar 压差、最大开度 157 mm²）、FMU 节流孔（最大 100 mm²，配分段线性油门 θ(t)）、PRV（200 bar 起跳）、切断阀、喷嘴（总面积 25 mm²）等部件；参考已有实验的旁通/发动机流量分配，按 k_Q≈9.6 缩放确定流量分区与孔口几何。2）故障注入：定义 7 个布尔健康分量 h0–h6（电机、传感器、泵、PRV、FMU、旁通阀、油箱）与 9 种故障（白噪声、p_FMU 传感器掉点、Q_Engine 传感器掉点、泵泄漏、泵排量变化、PRV 泄漏、FMU 孔口错位、旁通孔口错位、高增压压力）。3）数据生成：daessc 变步长刚性 DAE 求解器，Simulink 信号记录，6001 行/文件、30 s、200 Hz、1000 次运行、14 特征列+时间列（健康文件另加 UD 列），输出 1 个健康文件与 9 个故障文件，公开于 GitHub。4）评估：(i) 无监督 RNN-VAE（标准高斯先验）以模型似然作为概率残差做异常检测，采用时间维精确率与事件维召回率的调和平均 Composite F1 评价；(ii) SOM-VAE 做运行模式离散化，用 Purity π 指标评估，系统变化 SOM 地图尺寸 [3,3]/[6,6]/[12,12] 与序列长度 20/50/100 的影响；真值标签由 UD1（运行阶段）与 UD2（转速曲线）one-hot 编码组合给出。5）并以文献归纳的五项基准要求（混合信号、故障多样性、可扩展性、系统知识、CBD-ready）对比 BeRfiPl、HAI-CPPS、TEP-Alarm、水网络、NoBOOM、LiU-ICE。
AI.result: 数据集满足全部五项基准要求（混合信号、故障多样性、可扩展、显式模型与健康标注），并公开可复现。RNN-VAE 异常检测 Composite F1：泵泄漏 0.999、泵排量变化 1.000、p_FMU 传感器掉点 0.997、Q_Engine 传感器掉点 0.994、FMU 孔口错位 0.994、PRV 泄漏 0.976、高增压压力 0.872；失败两例：白噪声异常完全漏检（F1=0.0，因其与名义数据固有随机性难以区分）、旁通孔口错位 F1 仅 0.533（假阳性率高，特征与健康序列相似）。SOM-VAE 离散化 Purity：[3,3]/len20 0.7988、[3,3]/len50 0.7611、[3,3]/len100 0.7352、[6,6]/len20 0.8540、[12,12]/len20 0.8846，说明地图尺寸越大（表征能力更强）Purity 越高，序列长度增加则性能下降（长时上下文带来额外复杂度）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明高保真 Simscape 耦合仿真可生成带健康与故障标注的航空电子基准数据集，且可直接支撑无监督异常检测与状态离散化任务；SOM-VAE 提供了可解释的符号化运行模式表示，便于一致性诊断。局限在于数据为合成数据、仅覆盖单故障、油门信号为固定分段线性、假设等温流体而忽略温度效应、未建模空化与传感器延迟。作者建议后续增强机械—电子耦合细节、引入多样油门轨迹与故障叠加、测试更多时序预测模型，并使用真实泵测量数据对模型进行验证以提升可信度。

title: ContextWeaver: Selective and Dependency-Structured Memory Construction for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents often struggle in long-context interactions. As the agent accumulates more interaction history, context management approaches such as sliding window and prompt compression may omit earlier structured information that later steps rely on. Recent retrieval-based memory systems surface relevant content but still overlook the causal and logical structure needed for multi-step reasoning. We introduce ContextWeaver, a selective and dependency-structured memory framework that organizes an agent's interaction trace into a graph of reasoning steps and selects the relevant context for future actions. Unlike prior context management approaches, ContextWeaver supports: (1) dependency-based construction and traversal that link each step to the earlier steps it relies on; (2) compact dependency summarization that condenses root-to-step reasoning paths into reusable units; and (3) a lightweight validation layer that incorporates execution feedback. On the SWE-Bench Verified and Lite benchmarks, ContextWeaver improves performance over a sliding-window baseline in pass@1, while reducing reasoning steps and token usage. Our observations suggest that modeling logical dependencies provides a stable and scalable memory mechanism for LLM agents that use tools.

AI.tldr: ContextWeaver通过构建依赖结构化的记忆图谱来解决LLM智能体在长上下文交互中的信息遗漏问题，在SWE-Bench基准上提升性能的同时降低推理步骤和token消耗。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长上下文交互中表现不佳。现有上下文管理方法（如滑动窗口、提示压缩）可能遗漏后续步骤依赖的早期结构化信息；基于检索的记忆系统虽能召回相关内容，但忽视了多步推理所需的因果和逻辑结构。
AI.method: ContextWeaver是一种选择性的依赖结构化记忆框架，将智能体的交互轨迹组织为推理步骤图，并选择相关上下文用于未来行动。具体包括：(1) 基于依赖的构建与遍历，链接每个步骤与其依赖的前序步骤；(2) 紧凑依赖摘要，将根节点到目标步骤的推理路径压缩为可复用单元；(3) 轻量级验证层，整合执行反馈。
AI.result: 在SWE-Bench Verified和Lite基准测试中，ContextWeaver相比滑动窗口基线在pass@1指标上提升性能，同时减少推理步骤和token使用量。
AI.conclusion: 建模逻辑依赖为使用工具的LLM智能体提供了一种稳定且可扩展的记忆机制。

title: Analytica: Soft Propositional Reasoning for Robust and Scalable LLM-Driven Analysis
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly tasked with complex real-world analysis (e.g., in financial forecasting, scientific discovery), yet their reasoning suffers from stochastic instability and lacks a verifiable, compositional structure. To address this, we introduce Analytica, a novel agent architecture built on the principle of Soft Propositional Reasoning (SPR). SPR reframes complex analysis as a structured process of estimating the soft truth values of different outcome propositions, allowing us to formally model and minimize the estimation error in terms of its bias and variance. Analytica operationalizes this through a parallel, divide-and-conquer framework that systematically reduces both sources of error. To reduce bias, problems are first decomposed into a tree of subpropositions, and tool-equipped LLM grounder agents are employed, including a novel Jupyter Notebook agent for data-driven analysis, that help to validate and score facts. To reduce variance, Analytica recursively synthesizes these grounded leaves using robust linear models that average out stochastic noise with superior efficiency, scalability, and enable interactive "what-if" scenario analysis. Our theoretical and empirical results on economic, financial, and political forecasting tasks show that Analytica improves 15.84% accuracy on average over diverse base models, achieving 71.06% accuracy with the lowest variance of 6.02% when working with a Deep Research grounder. Our Jupyter Notebook grounder shows strong cost-effectiveness that achieves a close 70.11% accuracy with 90.35% less cost and 52.85% less time. Analytica also exhibits highly noise-resilient and stable performance growth as the analysis depth increases, with a near-linear time complexity, as well as good adaptivity to open-weight LLMs and scientific domains.

AI.tldr: Analytica是一种基于软命题推理（SPR）原则构建的新型LLM智能体架构，通过并行分治框架系统性地减少推理过程中的偏差和方差，从而提升复杂分析任务（如经济、金融、政治预测）的准确性和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体在复杂现实分析任务（如金融预测、科学发现）中存在推理不稳定、缺乏可验证性和组合结构的问题。现有方法难以形式化建模和优化推理误差。
AI.method: SPR将复杂分析重新定义为估计不同结果命题的软真值的过程。Analytica通过两个核心机制降低误差：(1) 降低偏差：使用树形结构分解问题为子命题，配备工具的LLM接地智能体（包括新型Jupyter Notebook智能体）验证和评分事实；(2) 降低方差：使用稳健线性模型递归综合已接地叶子节点，以平均化随机噪声。
AI.result: 在经济、金融和政治预测任务中，Analytica相比多种基线模型平均提升15.84%准确率。使用深度研究接地器达到71.06%准确率（最低方差6.02%）；Jupyter Notebook接地器以90.35%更低成本和52.85%更少时间达到70.11%准确率，展现强成本效益。
AI.conclusion: Analytica展现出高噪声韧性和稳定的性能增长，随分析深度增加呈近线性时间复杂度，并对开源LLM和科学领域具有良好的适应性。

title: Exact, Efficient, and Reliable Multi-Objective and Multi-Constrained IoT Workflow Scheduling in Edge-Hub-Cloud Cyber-Physical Systems
comment: This version of the manuscript has been accepted for publication in IEEE Internet of Things Journal after peer review (Author Accepted Manuscript). It is not the final published version (Version of Record) and does not reflect any post-acceptance improvements. The Version of Record is available online at https://doi.org/10.1109/JIOT.2026.3665298
summary: Emerging IoT-enabled cyber-physical applications demand low-latency, energy-efficient, and reliable execution across resource-constrained edge devices with heterogeneous multicore processors and diverse sensing and actuating capabilities, in collaboration with a hub device and a cloud server. These workflow-based applications comprise interdependent tasks that must be executed under stringent deadline, reliability, capability, memory, storage, and energy constraints. Given their critical nature, exact optimization is necessary to obtain optimal schedules that ensure dependable operation. Existing scheduling approaches, both exact and heuristic, fail to jointly address all these objectives and constraints. To this end, we propose an exact multi-objective and multi-constrained workflow scheduling approach for edge-hub-cloud cyber-physical systems, based on continuous-time mixed integer linear programming. The proposed formulation jointly optimizes latency, energy, and reliability, while holistically addressing timing and resource constraints. To enhance reliability while avoiding the overhead of unnecessary task replicas, it selectively employs task duplication. We evaluate our approach against a widely used heuristic, which we extend to ensure a fair and meaningful comparison, using a real-world IoT workflow and synthetic task graphs of varying sizes, across different system configurations and objective trade-offs. The proposed method consistently outperforms the heuristic, achieving up to 29.83%, 33.96%, and 28.49% average improvements in latency, energy, and reliability, respectively, while attaining practical runtimes. Overall, the experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach under various system configurations and objective trade-offs, and show its practical scalability to task graphs of sizes relevant to the targeted applications and system architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文（IEEE IoT Journal, KIOS CoE, 塞浦路斯大学）提出一种面向边缘—中枢—云（CPS）三层信息物理系统的连续时间多目标多约束 MILP 精确工作流调度方法：通过两阶段任务图变换（TG→TAG→ETAG）把任务分配、能力匹配与选择性任务复制统一进模型，联合最小化时延、能耗、最大化可靠性，并满足优先级、截止期、可靠性阈值、能力、内存、存储、能耗等约束。相比扩展后的 HEFT 启发式，真实 UAV 电力巡检工作流上时延/能耗/可靠性平均改善 14.47%/20.37%/20.11%，合成工作流（10–50 任务）平均改善 29.83%/33.96%/28.49%，求解时间在实用范围内。
AI.motivation: IoT 赋能的关键网络物理应用（远程患者监护、UAV 关键基础设施巡检/搜救）采用"边缘设备—中枢设备—云服务器"三层范式，工作流由相互依赖的任务组成，必须同时满足低时延、低能耗、高可靠的要求，并受截止期、可靠性阈值、设备专属能力（传感器/执行器/加速模块）、内存、存储、能量预算等多重约束。已有精确方法（离散/连续时间 MILP）只优化时延或能耗，且忽略内存/存储与多层架构、每设备单一能力等假设；已有启发式（HEFT、ACO、PSO 等）无法保证最优且不能同时处理三目标与全部约束。边缘环境温度、湿度、宇宙射线等导致瞬态故障更频繁，需要任务复制提升可靠性，但复制会带来额外时延与能耗开销，因此时延-能耗-可靠性本质冲突。对安全关键应用而言，必须取得全局最优调度；同时由于应用是预编程、确定性的，可离线使用精确方法，只要求解时间可接受。
AI.method: 1) 系统与模型：设备集 U 分为边缘/中枢/云三类，每设备含若干保留核心（异构多核）、内存/存储/能量预算、能力集合 C（基础计算能力 + 多个传感器/执行器等专用能力）；边缘与中枢全连接，中枢再连云，通信经中枢中转时按两段计算时延与能耗。任务为 DAG、不可抢占，需截止期 L_thr，任务要求特定能力。2) 两阶段任务图变换：阶段1 TG→TAG，将每个任务展开为"任务—核心"复合节点（仅保留能力兼容的核心），并在弧上定义通信时延/能耗；阶段2 TAG→ETAG，按可靠性阈值 ζ 决定是否生成副本任务（主任务+副本），实现"选择性任务复制"，退出任务的副本须与主任务同设备以保证只输出单一结果/单次执行器动作。ETAG 最坏规模相对 TG 放大 2|P| 节点、4|P|² 弧，但能力剪枝与选择性复制使实际规模远低于上界。3) 连续时间 MILP：二进制变量 x 选候选节点/弧，连续变量表示开始时间与完成时间 T，辅助二进制变量处理同核排序、主-副本联合选择、以及"任务在时刻 s_h 是否在执行"的事件驱动判定。约束包括候选节点唯一选择、弧选择一致性、可靠性约束（仅在需要时激活副本、主副本总可靠性 R=1-(1-R1)(1-R2) 必须 ≥ 阈值、退出任务同设备）、优先级约束、完成时间与截止期约束、同核非重叠约束、按任务开始时刻校验的能力/内存/存储时变累积约束、设备能量预算约束（计算 + 发送 + 接收 + 作为中转的通信能耗）。可靠性用泊松型 R=e^{-λL}，整体可靠性取对数线性化，三目标归一化后按 w_lat/w_en/w_rel 加权和（可靠性取负）作为单一 MILP 目标。4) 基线：重新实现"多目标多约束版 HEFT"（同一 ETAG 输入、含选择性复制、相同目标与约束、硬可行性过滤 + 局部加权评分选择），最坏时间复杂度 O(|U||T|³|P|⁴)。5) 实验：C++ + Gurobi 11.0.3（CentOS 7.9, Xeon Gold 6240）；真实 UAV 电力输电塔巡检工作流（16 任务、4 边缘+1 中枢+1 云），三种能力配置 C1–C3，权重以 1/3 步长遍历；合成 25 个 10/20/30/40/50 任务 DAG（平均入出度 1.45）。
AI.result: 真实工作流：MILP 在全部权重组合与三种配置下全面优于扩展 HEFT，整体平均时延降低 14.47%、能耗降低 20.37%、可靠性提高 20.11%（C1: 15.27/18.56/24.36%；C2: 14.35/20.17/17.92%；C3: 13.80/22.38/18.05%）。可靠性对权重和能力配置更敏感，部分情形两者取得相同最优可靠性；MILP 更倾向于将主任务放在云上且副本数不少于 HEFT，16 个主任务对应 2–10 个副本。求解时间 126.3–270.1 s（ETAG 256–314 节点、5440–6832 变量、20977–26869 约束），对离线调度可接受。合成工作流：时延改善 6.15%–53.25%（均值 29.83%、中位 32.46%），能耗改善 14.21%–51.79%（均值 33.96%），可靠性改善 9.78%–56.31%（均值 28.49%）；平均求解时间随规模从 0.01 h（10 任务）增至 10.47 h（50 任务），而 HEFT 仅 0.1–13.6 s；典型 10–20 任务规模下 20 s–16.6 min 即可得到最优解。ETAG 实际节点/弧数量（如 50 任务时 974 节点/32 961 弧）远低于理论上界（1800/95 904），说明模型可解。
AI.conclusion: 该精确连续时间 MILP 首次为边缘—中枢—云 CPS 提供同时优化时延、能耗、可靠性并满足全部时序/资源/能力/可靠性约束的最优调度方案，通过两阶段图变换把"任务复制"纳入精确决策，兼顾可靠性增强与复制开销，并在真实与合成工作流上稳定优于同假设下的 HEFT 扩展版本，具备实用可扩展性。局限在于依赖参数确定性（离线固定输入）、假设故障由硬件/运行时检测且仅考虑设计期增强、模型规模与求解时间随任务数快速上升（50 任务需数小时）、加权求和只给出折中解而非完整 Pareto 前沿。后续工作将探索精确与启发式混合方法，以及任务执行时间、网络带宽等参数存在不确定性时的调度。

title: R$^3$AG: Retriever Routing for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become a cornerstone for knowledge-intensive tasks. However, the efficacy of RAG is often bottlenecked by the ``one-size-fits-all'' retrieval paradigm, as different queries exhibit distinct preferences for different retrievers. While recent routing techniques attempt to select the optimal retriever dynamically, they typically operate under a ``single and static capability'' assumption, selecting retrievers solely based on semantic relevance. This overlooks a critical distinction in RAG: a retrieved document must not only be relevant but also effectively support the generator in producing correct answers. To address this limitation, we propose R$^3$AG, a novel routing framework that explicitly models the dynamic alignment between queries and retriever capabilities. Unlike previous approaches, R$^3$AG decomposes retriever capability into two learnable dimensions: retrieval quality and generation utility. We employ a contrastive learning objective that leverages complementary supervision signals, \textit{i.e.}, document assessments and downstream answer correctness, to capture query-specific preference shifts. Extensive experiments on several knowledge-intensive tasks show that R$^3$AG consistently outperforms both the best individual retrievers and state-of-the-art static routing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R3AG，一种新颖的RAG路由框架，通过将检索器能力分解为检索质量和生成效用两个可学习维度，并利用对比学习和互补监督信号（文档评估+答案正确性）捕获查询特定的偏好偏移，解决了现有方法仅考虑语义相关性的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统采用"一刀切"的检索范式，路由技术仅基于语义相关性选择检索器，忽视了检索文档不仅要相关，还需有效支持生成器产生正确答案的关键区分。
AI.method: 提出R3AG框架，采用对比学习目标，结合文档评估和下游答案正确性两种互补监督信号，显式建模查询与检索器能力之间的动态对齐关系。
AI.result: R3AG在多个知识密集型任务上一致优于最佳单个检索器和最先进的静态路由方法。
AI.conclusion: R3AG通过将检索器能力分解为检索质量和生成效用两个维度，利用对比学习和互补监督信号来建模查询特定的偏好偏移，在多个知识密集型任务上优于单个检索器和静态路由方法。

title: Empirical Insights of Test Selection Metrics under Multiple Testing Objectives and Distribution Shifts
comment: Accepted for publication at the ACM International Conference on the Foundations of Software Engineering (FSE 2026)
summary: Deep learning (DL)-based systems can exhibit unexpected behavior when exposed to out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios, posing serious risks in safety-critical domains such as malware detection and autonomous driving. This underscores the importance of thoroughly testing such systems before deployment. To this end, researchers have proposed a wide range of test selection metrics designed to effectively select inputs. However, prior evaluations of metrics reveal three key limitations: (1) narrow testing objectives, for example, many studies assess metrics only for fault detection, leaving their effectiveness for performance estimation unclear; (2) limited coverage of OOD scenarios, with natural and label shifts are rarely considered; (3) Biased dataset selection, where most work focuses on image data while other modalities remain underexplored. Consequently, a unified benchmark that examines how these metrics perform under multiple testing objectives, diverse OOD scenarios, and different data modalities is still lacking. This leaves practitioners uncertain about which test selection metrics are most suitable for their specific objectives and contexts. To address this gap, we conduct an extensive empirical study of 15 existing metrics, evaluating them under three testing objectives (fault detection, performance estimation, and retraining guidance), five types of OOD scenarios (corrupted, adversarial, temporal, natural, and label shifts), three data modalities (image, text, and Android packages), and 13 DL models. In total, our study encompasses 1,640 experimental scenarios, offering a comprehensive evaluation and statistical analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文是一项关于深度学习测试选择指标的综合性基准研究，旨在评估15种现有指标在多种测试目标、OOD场景和数据模态下的表现，为实践者提供选择依据。
AI.motivation: 当前对测试选择指标的三方面局限性：测试目标单一（多关注故障检测，忽视性能估计）、OOD场景覆盖不足（自然偏移和标签偏移研究较少）、数据模态偏差（主要集中于图像数据）。缺乏统一基准来指导实践者选择合适的指标。
AI.method: 对15种现有测试选择指标进行大规模实证研究，在3种测试目标、5种OOD场景、3种数据模态和13个深度学习模型下进行评估，共计1640个实验场景。
AI.result: 建立了包含1640个实验场景的全面评估体系，提供深入的比较分析和统计检验。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为不同测试目标、OOD场景和数据模态下的指标选择提供了系统性指导，填补了深度学习测试选择指标统一基准的空白。

title: New Convex Programming Technique for Nash Social Welfare and Scheduling
summary:
We propose a new convex programming relaxation for the weighted Nash social welfare (NSW) problem that achieves a matching $(e^{1/e}\approx 1.445)$-approximation via the rounding algorithm of Feng and Li. Unlike the exponential-size configuration LP used in prior work, our formulation can be converted into a compact linear program of polynomial size, incurring only an additive loss of $\ln(1+ε)$ in the objective. This allows the program to be solved directly using standard LP solvers, without the ellipsoid method or dual separation oracles.
  In the unweighted case, we show that our convex program is equivalent to the restricted-spending Fisher market convex program of Cole and Gkatzelis, yielding a constructive proof that its integrality gap is exactly $e^{1/e}$. With a minor modification, our analysis also gives a simple proof of the $e^{1/e}$ EF1 gap for the identical agent setting. Finally, we show that our convex programming technique extends to two unrelated machine scheduling problems, recovering the best-known approximation ratios with simpler analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的加权Nash社会福利(NSW)问题的凸规划松弛，可转换为多项式规模的紧凑线性规划，仅产生ln(1+ε)的加性损失。通过Feng和Li的舍入算法获得e^(1/e)≈1.445的近似比。
AI.motivation: 现有方法使用指数规模的配置LP，需借助椭球法或对偶分离Oracle效率较低。需要一种可直接用标准LP求解器求解的紧凑公式。
AI.method: 构建新的凸规划松弛公式，可转换为紧凑线性规划；在无权重情形证明其与受限支出Fisher市场凸规划的等价性。
AI.result: 获得e^(1/e)≈1.445的近似比；无权重情形积分间隙恰好为e^(1/e)；identical agent设置EF1间隙为e^(1/e)；技术扩展至两台无关机调度问题。
AI.conclusion: 该凸规划技术不仅简化了NSW问题的分析框架，还可为相关调度问题提供更简洁的分析，同时保持最佳已知近似比。

title: LLM-Guided Agentic Floor Plan Parsing for Accessible Indoor Navigation of Blind and Low-Vision People
summary: Indoor navigation remains a critical accessibility challenge for the blind and low-vision (BLV) individuals, as existing solutions rely on costly per-building infrastructure. We present an agentic framework that converts a single floor plan image into a structured, retrievable knowledge base to generate safe, accessible navigation instructions with lightweight infrastructure. The system has two phases: a multi-agent module that parses the floor plan into a spatial knowledge graph through a self-correcting pipeline with iterative retry loops and corrective feedback; and a Path Planner that generates accessible navigation instructions, with a Safety Evaluator agent assessing potential hazards along each route. We evaluate the system on the real-world UMBC Math and Psychology building (floors MP-1 and MP-3) and on the CVC-FP benchmark. On MP-1, we achieve success rates of 92.31%, 76.92%, and 61.54% for short, medium, and long routes, outperforming the strongest single-call baseline (Claude 3.7 Sonnet) at 84.62%, 69.23%, and 53.85%. On MP-3, we reach 76.92%, 61.54%, and 38.46%, compared to the best baseline at 61.54%, 46.15%, and 23.08%. These results show consistent gains over single-call LLM baselines and demonstrate that our workflow is a scalable solution for accessible indoor navigation for BLV individuals.

AI.tldr: 提出一种智能体框架，将楼层平面图图像转换为结构化知识库，用于为视障人士生成无障碍导航指令。系统采用多智能体模块解析平面图，并通过路径规划器和安全评估器生成安全导航路径。在UMBC真实建筑和CVC-FP基准测试中，性能显著优于单次调用LLM基线方法。
AI.motivation: Indoor navigation for blind and low-vision (BLV) individuals relies on costly per-building infrastructure, creating a critical accessibility gap. There is a need for scalable, low-cost solutions that can work across different buildings without extensive infrastructure requirements.
AI.method: Two-phase system: (1) Multi-agent module with self-correcting pipeline using iterative retry loops and corrective feedback to parse floor plan images into spatial knowledge graphs; (2) Path Planner with Safety Evaluator agent to generate accessible navigation instructions and assess route hazards. Evaluation conducted on real-world UMBC buildings and CVC-FP benchmark.
AI.result: On MP-1: 92.31%, 76.92%, 61.54% success rates for short, medium, long routes (vs. baseline 84.62%, 69.23%, 53.85%). On MP-3: 76.92%, 61.54%, 38.46% (vs. baseline 61.54%, 46.15%, 23.08%). Consistent improvements across all route lengths and buildings.
AI.conclusion: The agentic framework significantly outperforms single-call LLM baselines for accessible indoor navigation, achieving up to 92.31% success rate on short routes and demonstrating a scalable, low-cost solution for BLV individuals without requiring per-building infrastructure deployment.

title: Cross-Course Generalizability of SRL-Aligned Predictive Models Using Digital Learning Traces
summary: STEM dropout rates remain high at universities, particularly in computer science programs with theory-intensive courses. Digital learning environments now capture rich behavioral data that could help identify struggling students early, yet the generalizability of data-driven prediction models across courses and institutions remains uncertain. Guided by self-regulated learning (SRL) theory, this study analyzed multimodal digital-trace data from three undergraduate theoretical computer science courses (N1 = 137, N2 = 104, N3 = 148) at two universities. Weekly SRL-aligned digital-trace indicators were modeled using Elastic Net, Random Forest, and XGBoost to evaluate predictive performance over time and across settings, and model calibration both within and across courses. Early prediction of at-risk students was feasible, with SRL-related behaviors such as time management, effort regulation, and sustained engagement emerging as key predictors. While Random Forest achieved the highest in-sample accuracy, Elastic Net generalized more robustly across contexts. Out-of-sample accuracy and calibration declined between institutions with different base rates, underscoring the contextual nature of predictive analytics in higher education. These findings suggest that digital learning traces enable early identification of at-risk students within courses, but generalizing predictive models beyond their original context requires caution, particularly if the at-risk rates differ between contexts.

AI.tldr: 研究利用数字学习环境中的行为数据，基于自我调节学习(SRL)理论，在两所大学的三门理论计算机科学课程中预测高危学生。通过比较Elastic Net、Random Forest和XGBoost模型，发现SRL相关行为(如时间管理、努力调节、持续参与)是关键预测因子。Random Forest样本内准确率最高，但Elastic Net跨情境泛化能力更强。院校间准确率和校准度下降，提示跨情境预测需谨慎。
AI.motivation: STEM尤其是计算机科学专业的学生流失率居高不下，理论课程难度大。数字学习环境积累了丰富的行为数据，有望早期识别困境学生，但数据驱动模型的跨课程、跨机构泛化能力尚不明确。
AI.method: 研究纳入两所大学三门本科理论计算机科学课程(N₁=137, N₂=104, N₃=148)。基于SRL理论提取周度数字痕迹指标，采用Elastic Net、Random Forest和XGBoost建模，评估时序预测性能和跨情境泛化能力，并对模型进行校准分析。
AI.result: 早期预测高危学生可行。SRL相关行为(时间管理、努力调节、持续参与)是核心预测因子。Random Forest样本内准确率最高，Elastic Net跨情境泛化更稳健。院校间样本外准确率和校准度因基础率差异而下降。
AI.conclusion: 数字学习痕迹可实现课程内高危学生的早期识别，但模型跨情境泛化需谨慎，特别是在风险基准率存在差异的情况下。这强调了高等教育预测分析的语境依赖性。

title: Towards Understanding the Expressive Power of GNNs with Global Readout
summary: We study the expressive power of message-passing aggregate-combine-readout graph neural networks (ACR-GNNs). Particularly, we focus on the first-order (FO) properties expressible by this formalism. While a tight logical characterisation remains a difficult open question, we make two contributions towards answering it. First, we show that sum aggregation and readout suffice for GNNs to capture FO properties that cannot be expressed in the logic C2 on both directed and undirected graphs. This strengthens known results by Hauke and Wał{\k e}ga (2026) where aggregation and readout functions are specially crafted for the task. Second, we identify two natural ways of restoring characterisability (with regard to C2) for ACR-GNNs. One option is to limit local aggregation (without imposing restrictions on global readout), whilst the second is to run ACR-GNNs over graphs of bounded degree (but unbounded size). In both cases, the FO properties captured by GNNs are exactly those definable by a formula in graded modal logic with global counting modalities. Our results thus establish an innate lower- and upper-bound in terms of how far (fragments of) C2 can be taken to characterise GNNs, and imply that is indeed the unbounded interaction of aggregation and readout that pushes the logical expressive power of GNNs above C2.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带全局 readout 的消息传递 GNN（聚合-组合-读出型，ACR-GNN）的一阶（FO）表达能力。作者证明了两点：(1) 仅用 sum 作为聚合与 readout 的"简单" ACR-GNN 就能刻画 C²（带计数量词的一阶逻辑二变量片段）无法表达的 FO 性质（在有向图与无向图上均成立），从而把 Hauke 与 Wałęga (2026) 的结果从"特制聚合/读出函数"强化为"标准 sum 函数"；(2) 给出恢复 C² 可刻画性的两种自然途径——限制图的最大度（Theorem 10）或限制聚合函数为有界（Proposition 11），此时 ACR-GNN 能捕获的 FO 性质恰为带全局计数模态算子的分级模态逻辑 GML^∃ 所定义者。整体结论：正是聚合与 readout 的"无界交互"把 GNN 的逻辑表达能力推到了 C² 之上。
AI.motivation: Barceló 等 (2020) 已确立：仅局部聚合的 GNN 恰好等价于分级模态逻辑 (GML)，且"局部聚合 + 全局 readout"的 GNN 能表达 C² 的全部公式，但 C² 是否恰好刻画此类 GNN 当时仍是开放问题。Hauke 与 Wałęga (2026) 给出反例：存在某些 ACR-GNN 能捕获、而 C² 无法表达的 FO 性质（他们用的是专门设计的、含指数运算的聚合/读出/组合函数，实践中无法用 FFNN 或 sum/mean/max 实现），于是"用何种逻辑刻画带 readout 的 GNN"成为悬而未决的问题。另一方面，Cuenca Grau、Feng 与 Wałęga (2026) 仅在聚合与读出都"有界"（对多重集截断敏感）时给出 GML 加全局计数模态的完整刻画，导致已知上界与下界之间存在明显缺口。本文的目标是缩小这一缺口：一方面证明标准 sum 函数已足以突破 C²，另一方面给出在何种限制下可恢复 C² 层面的完整逻辑刻画。
AI.method: 逻辑与模型论为主，结合 GNN 架构分析。核心要素：(1) 定义框架：ACR-GNN（含 d-特征带特征图、指点图）、有界多重集函数（c-bounded，max 为 1-bounded 而 sum/mean/product 不可界）、分级模态逻辑 GML 与带全局计数模态的 GML^∃、C² 等；(2) 关键技术引理（Lemma 3）：n 顶点有向图是严格全序 iff |E|=C(n,2) 且 |hom(P₂,G)|=C(n,3)，证明用到度数序列与共轭序列、Gale–Ryser 定理、重排不等式、Abel 求和（分部求和）；(3) 显式构造 6 层"简单" ACR-GNN（聚合=readout=sum，组合=ReLU 线性组合，分类器=线性阈值）：分别用 4 层网络在互不相同的维度上算出 |E|、C(n,2)、|hom(P₂,G)|、C(n,3)（经由出度、长度 2 路径计数、全局求和、以及用 n、n²、n³ 的多项式组合读出 C(n,2)、C(n,3)），再用 2 层通过 ReLu 构造的"差值对"（x[i]+x[j]=0 当且仅当相等）与总和 ≤0 的判据完成相等性检验；(4) 无向图：定义 gadgetisation（把每个顶点拆成 s_v/t_v/ι_v 三点并加 2-特征），把计数改为 gadgetised P₂ 的同态数（给出双射证明），并用 Lemma 25/26 给出 FO 公式与简单 ACR-GNN 的刻画；(5) 不可判定性一侧：用 2-pebble c-bijective back-and-forth 等价 (Hella 1996) 及 Lemma 29 的构造（把一条边 (s_{-1},t_1) 换成 (s_1,t_{-1}) 制造长度 3 环）证明 gadgetised 严格全序不可被任何 C² 分类器捕获；(6) 上界/刻画：定义带无界全局计数的 c-graded L-turn 双模拟 ~^{L,c,*}_∃（Lemma 16 说明它是 c-bounded 聚合 ACR-GNN 的不变性上界），并引入带界全局计数版本 ~^{L,c,q'}_∃；关键在于把无界计数不变性"降级"为有界计数不变性——由于经典 unravel/加点的办法会产生不可双模拟的图，作者改用"就地同质化"（Lemmas 18、19、32、33、35：不添加顶点地搬运边、并按 ~^{L,c}-类型与枚举序号复制出边行为），再以 Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé 游戏中 duplicator 的取胜策略（Lemma 36）证明同量词秩 FO 分类器在两个伴随图上一致，从而得 Proposition 30（取 q'=q+c-1）；最后用 GML 与 GML^∃ 的特征公式（Definition 37/38、Lemma 39）说明有界计数双模拟的等价类有限且各由唯一 GML^∃ 公式刻画，取有限析取即得 Proposition 13 与 Proposition 11；(7) 由 Proposition 11 加"度数 ≤ c"的可被 ACR-GNN 捕获的公式 ψ_c，构造性地把刻画归约到任意图，推出 Theorem 10。
AI.result: (1) Theorem 1（有向图）与 Theorem 5（无向图）：存在 FO 顶点性质不等价于任何 C² 公式，但可被简单 ACR-GNN（仅 sum 聚合 + sum readout）捕获——有向情形使用与 Hauke–Wałęga 相同的 FO 性质"边关系构成严格全序"（其传递性子式需 3 个变量，故不在 C² 中），但改用新的同态计数刻画 Lemma 3，从而只需 sum；无向情形通过自制的 gadgetisation（其 gadget 不破坏同态计数）加 Proposition 8 与 Proposition 9（2-pebble c-bijective 双模拟不可区分性）完成。(2) Proposition 11：带 c-bounded 聚合函数（读出任意）的 ACR-GNN 所捕获的 FO 分类器当且仅当等价于某个 GML^∃ 分类器——推广了 Cuenca Grau 等 (2026) 的"聚合与读出都需有界"的结果，表明允许无界读出相对 FO 并不增加表达能力。(3) Theorem 10：在最大度有界（顶点数无界）的图上，ACR-GNN 捕获的 FO 分类器恰为 GML^∃ 所定义者（与 Theorem 1/5 形成鲜明对照）。此外 Proposition 12 给出 GML^∃ → 有界聚合 ACR-GNN 的正向翻译（k-bounded sum 足够，k 取公式中出现的最大 ◇_≥k）。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了 ACR-GNN 表达能力在 C² 层面的"内禀"上下界：(a) 即使只用实践中最常见的 sum 聚合与 sum readout，ACR-GNN 已能表达 C² 之外的 FO 性质（严格全序及其 gadget 版本）；(b) 一旦限制图的度数上界、或限制聚合函数为有界（读出可不受限），ACR-GNN 的 FO 表达能力就精确回落到 GML^∃，从而恢复 C² 层面的可刻画性。因此，真正把 GNN 的逻辑表达能力推过 C² 的机制是"聚合与全局 readout 的无界交互"，而非任一单独组件。方法论上，基于同态计数的全序刻画与"就地同质化 + 双模拟 + EF 博弈"的模型论技术对有限模型论本身可能有独立价值。遗留问题：sum 聚合 + sum readout 的 ACR-GNN 的确切表达能力仍未确定；作者提出一个可能的子问题——无界 sum 聚合与有界 sum readout 组合时的 FO 表达能力，留待未来研究。

title: Mixture of Heterogeneous Grouped Experts for Language Modeling
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) based on Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) are pivotal in industrial applications for their ability to scale performance efficiently. However, standard MoEs enforce uniform expert sizes,creating a rigidity that fails to align computational costs with varying token-level complexity. While heterogeneous expert architectures attempt to address this by diversifying expert sizes, they often suffer from significant system-level challenges, specifically unbalanced GPU utilization and inefficient parameter utilization, which hinder practical deployment. To bridge the gap between theoretical heterogeneity and robust industrial application, we propose Mixture of Heterogeneous Grouped Experts (MoHGE) which introduces a two-level routing mechanism to enable flexible, resource-aware expert combinations. To optimize inference efficiency, we propose a Group-Wise Auxiliary Loss, which dynamically steers tokens to the most parameter-efficient expert groups based on task difficulty. To address the critical deployment challenge of GPU load balancing, we introduce an All-size Group-decoupling Allocation strategy coupled with an Intra-Group Experts Auxiliary Loss. These mechanisms collectively ensure uniform computation distribution across GPUs. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that MoHGE matches the performance of MoE architectures while reducing the total parameters by approximately 20% and maintaining balanced GPU utilization. Our work establishes a scalable paradigm for resource-efficient MoE design, offering a practical solution for optimizing inference costs in real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoHGE（混合异构分组专家），通过两层路由机制和辅助损失函数解决异构专家架构中的GPU负载均衡和参数效率问题，在保持性能的同时减少约20%的参数量。
AI.motivation: 标准MoE架构中专家规模统一，导致计算成本与token复杂度不匹配；现有异构专家架构虽尝试多样化专家规模，但存在GPU利用率不平衡和参数利用效率低下的系统级问题，限制了其工业部署。
AI.method: MoHGE采用两层路由机制实现灵活、资源感知的专家组合；提出组级辅助损失（Group-Wise Auxiliary Loss）根据任务难度动态引导token选择参数效率最高的专家组；引入全尺寸组解耦分配策略配合组内专家辅助损失以解决GPU负载均衡问题。
AI.result: 实验表明MoHGE在匹配MoE性能的同时减少约20%总参数量，并维持均衡的GPU利用率。
AI.conclusion: MoHGE为资源高效的MoE设计建立了可扩展范式，为优化实际场景中的推理成本提供了实用解决方案。

title: Towards Automated Ontology Generation from Unstructured Text: A Multi-Agent LLM Approach
summary: Automatically generating formal ontologies from unstructured natural language remains a central challenge in knowledge engineering. While large language models (LLMs) show promise, it remains unclear which architectural design choices drive generation quality and why current approaches fail. We present a controlled experimental study using domain-specific insurance contracts to investigate these questions. We first establish a single-agent LLM baseline, identifying key failure modes such as poor Ontology Design Pattern compliance, structural redundancy, and ineffective iterative repair. We then introduce a multi-agent architecture that decomposes ontology construction into four artifact-driven roles: Domain Expert, Manager, Coder, and Quality Assurer. We evaluate performance across architectural quality (via a panel of heterogeneous LLM judges) and functional usability (via competency question driven SPARQL evaluation with complementary retrieval augmented generation based assessment). Results show that the multi-agent approach significantly improves structural quality and modestly enhances queryability, with gains driven primarily by front-loaded planning. These findings highlight planning-first, artifact-driven generation as a promising and more auditable path toward scalable automated ontology engineering.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了大语言模型(LLM)自动从自然语言生成正式本体论的问题，通过保险合同领域的受控实验，对比单智能体基线和四角色多智能体架构(领域专家、管理员、编码员、质量保证员)，发现多智能体方法显著提升结构质量，收益主要来自前置规划阶段。
AI.motivation: 自动从未结构化自然语言生成正式本体论是知识工程的核心挑战。虽然LLM显示出潜力，但当前方法的架构设计选择如何影响生成质量、为何失败仍不明确。
AI.method: 1) 建立单智能体LLM基线并识别失败模式(本体设计模式合规性差、结构冗余、无效迭代修复)；2) 提出四角色多智能体架构(领域专家、管理员、编码员、质量保证员)；3) 使用异构LLM评审团评估架构质量；4) 通过 competency questions 驱动SPARQL评估结合RAG辅助评估功能可用性。
AI.result: 多智能体方法显著提升结构质量，适度增强查询能力；收益主要来自前置规划(front-loaded planning)。
AI.conclusion: 规划优先、 artifact驱动的生成方式是实现可扩展自动化本体工程的有前景且更可审计的路径。

title: Incisor: Ex Ante Cloud Instance Selection for HPC Jobs
summary: We present Incisor, a cloud HPC job submission system for the ex ante instance selection problem: choosing suitable hardware in the challenging but common setting where only the executable, inputs, and invocation commands are available at submission time. In practice, this task is manual and expertise-intensive, requiring users to combine incomplete knowledge of rapidly evolving cloud offerings with workload-specific intuition, static analysis, and systems reasoning to infer hardware constraints and select an instance type for each job. Incisor automates this process by pairing widely available program analysis tools with LLM-guided reasoning to infer hardware requirements and choose cloud instances. Using submission artifacts alone, Incisor atop frontier coding LLMs selects working AWS EC2 instances ex ante for 100% of first-time runs of source-compiled (C, C++, Fortran) and Python applications. Against a strong baseline combining expert-derived constraints with SkyPilot's instance selection, Incisor cuts job runtime by 54% and instance costs by 44%.

AI.tldr: Incisor是一个云HPC作业提交系统，通过结合程序分析工具与LLM推理来自动推断硬件需求并选择云实例，解决了仅凭可执行文件、输入和命令无法预知硬件需求的难题。
AI.motivation: 当前云HPC实例选择依赖人工专家经验，需要用户将不完整的云服务知识与工作负载直觉、静态分析和系统推理相结合，既费时又容易出错。这在仅有提交工件可用的情况下尤为困难。
AI.method: Incisor将广泛可用的程序分析工具与LLM引导推理配对，从提交工件中推断硬件约束并选择AWS EC2实例类型。
AI.result: 基于前沿编码LLM，Incisor对C/C++/Fortran源码编译应用和Python应用的首次运行实现100%成功选例；相比专家约束+SkyPilot基线，作业运行时间缩短54%，实例成本降低44%。
AI.conclusion: LLM辅助的程序分析可有效自动化云HPC实例选择，仅凭提交工件即可实现高效、低成本的实例匹配。

title: IntrAgent: An LLM Agent for Content-Grounded Information Retrieval through Literature Review
summary: Scientific research relies on accurate information retrieval from literature to support analytical decisions. In this work, we introduce a new task, INformation reTRieval through literAture reVIEW (IntraView), which aims to automate fine-grained information retrieval faithfully grounded in the provided content in response to research-driven queries, and propose IntrAgent, an LLM-based agent that addresses this challenging task. In particular, IntrAgent is designed to mimic human behaviors when reading literature for information retrieval -- identifying relevant sections and then iteratively extracting key details to refine the retrieved information. It follows a two-stage pipeline: a Section Ranking stage that prioritizes relevant literature sections through structural-knowledge-enabled reasoning, and an Iterative Reading stage that continuously extracts details and synthesizes them into concise, contextually grounded answers. To support rigorous evaluation, we introduce IntraBench, a new benchmark consisting of 315 test instances built from expert-authored questions paired with literature spanning five STEM domains. Across seven backbone LLMs, IntrAgent achieves on average 13.2% higher cross-domain accuracy than state-of-the-art RAG and research-agent baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出新任务 IntraView（基于文献综述的内容锚定信息检索）与首个专用 LLM 智能体 IntrAgent：采用"章节排序（Section Ranking）+ 迭代阅读（Iterative Reading）"两阶段流水线，先用结构化推理对论文章节按相关性重排，再逐节提取细节并通过"信息充分性检查"判断是否可作答，从而抑制幻觉；同时发布首个 IntraView 基准 IntraBench（315 个测试实例、25 篇论文、覆盖物理/地球科学/公共卫生/工程/材料科学五个 STEM 领域）。在 7 个骨干 LLM 上，IntrAgent 跨域平均准确率比最强 RAG/研究智能体基线高 13.2%，且统计显著（Wilcoxon 检验 Holm–Bonferroni 校正后 p_adj<0.001）。
AI.motivation: 科学研究高度依赖从文献中准确抽取元数据、实验设置与方法学细节（如激发波长、采样率、模型参数、结论数值）。但现有方案难以胜任：一是直接查询 LLM 无法处理整篇文献的海量信息；二是 RAG 仅依赖表层语义相似度做块检索，难以对齐领域专有术语与问题，且忽略科学文档的层级结构；三是现有科研智能体（PaperQA2、QASA、SciMaster 等）面向"通过外部检索回答开放科学问答"，答案可依赖外部知识与作者意图，与 IntraView"严格锚定于给定论文内容"的要求本质不同。此外，实际应用必须能明确承认"文献中不存在该信息"以避免幻觉，而通用 CQA 基准也无法评估这一能力，因此需要新任务定义与配套基准。
AI.method:
**任务定义（IntraView）**：给定文献 C 与研究驱动问题 Q，生成严格基于 C 的答案 A；相较常规 CQA 的两点差异是提供完整文献（答案可能出现在任何位置或根本不存在），以及问题具领域专属性、可能需要跨章节交叉引用。

**IntrAgent（"思维仿生"式人类阅读行为）**：
1. *章节排序阶段*：(a) 章节标题解析——用 minerU 将 PDF 转为带标准标题标记的 Markdown；(b) 层级保留——由 LLM 推断标题间的父子关系，构造 section tree，并过滤"父标题后紧跟无内容子标题"的冗余路径；(c) 推理式排序——LLM 基于层级与问题推理，输出章节索引重排序列 R，得到 (标题, 正文) 对列表。
2. *迭代阅读阶段*：动作空间包含"重排章节访问""章节细节提取""信息充分性检查"。细节 D_i 锚定原句存入短期记忆；充分性检查由 LLM 判断 YES/NO，NO 则继续读下一节，从而支持跨章节证据合成与显式"信息不存在"回答；提供 conservative/balanced/aggressive 三档置信度调节读取开销；最终由 LLM 汇总 D_1..D_m 生成答案。

**IntraBench**：由领域专家从熟悉论文池中随机选取 25 篇高影响力同行评审论文，基于自然阅读实践设计 63 个问题，覆盖四类任务导向类别（研究对象与实验设置／数据特征与采集／技术方法与细节／结论与结果），每题含 1 正确项+5 干扰项（含"All of the above"/"None of the above"）。评测采用 LLM 将模型自由生成的短答案映射到选项（默认 GPT-4.1），以准确率为指标，以缓解术语同义/缩写与数值精确性问题。

**基线**：vanilla RAG（all-MiniLM-L6-v2 / E5-mistral-7b-instruct / GritLM-7B，500 token 分块、余弦相似度）、Contextual RAG、DRAGIN、R²AG、LongRAG，以及智能体类 LUMOS、PaperQA2、Agentic-Hybrid-RAG、SciMaster；骨干 LLM 为 GPT-4o、GPT-4.1、DeepSeek-R1、o3、o4-mini、Gemini-2.5 Pro、Llama-3.1-70B。
AI.result:
1. **主结果**：IntrAgent 在全部 5 个领域、7 个骨干上全面领先。跨域宏平均准确率分别为 GPT-4o 70.0%、GPT-4.1 75.8%、DeepSeek-R1 74.4%、o3 73.4%、o4-mini 73.8%、Gemini-2.5 Pro 75.9%、Llama-3.1-70B 68.8%，较各骨干下最强基线分别提升 7.9/11.6/8.9/18.2/17.4/21.0/7.4 个百分点，平均提升 13.2%。增益来自定向证据选择而非更长上下文；原为在线检索设计的智能体在给定单篇文献后退化为类 RAG 管线，表现不佳。

2. **消融**：层级保留（HP）使 GPT-4o/GPT-4.1/DS-R1 准确率从 60.7/70.3/64.2 提升到 65.6/72.5/67.6；去掉充分性检查（仅读 top-1 章节）后物理域从 75.4% 跌至 32.2%，失败模式为"检索不完整"（跨章节证据缺失而答"None of the above"）与"幻觉"（编造句子、章节标题与 532 nm 等数值并虚构引用）；置信度方面 balanced（68.3%，平均 5.1 次迭代、6376 token）最优，conservative 虽读更多章节（9.9 次、7853 token）反而最差（58.9%），aggressive 迭代最少（3.9 次、2233 token）但准确率降至 62.7%，符合长上下文性能衰减规律。

3. **鲁棒性**：映射模型 GPT-4o/GPT-4.1/DS-R1 与专家标注的正确性一致率在物理集上分别达 59/65、65/65、61/65（选 GPT-4.1 为默认）；骨干×映射模型的所有组合中 IntrAgent 始终优于 vanilla RAG；将章节标题改写为"初学者风格/高噪声/莎士比亚风格"后准确率仅从 89.2% 降至 84.6%。

4. **统计与效率**：Wilcoxon 单侧符号秩检验（35 组配对样本）中位数增益 +10.9 至 +27.3 个百分点，12 项比较经 Holm–Bonferroni 校正后 p_adj<0.001；混合效应回归显示论文长度对性能无显著影响（斜率 −0.1444，p=0.463）；运行时间中位数约 129 秒/题（基线约 1 分钟内）。
AI.conclusion: 本文的贡献是把"基于文献综述的细粒度内容锚定信息检索"形式化为 IntraView 任务，并交付首个专用智能体 IntrAgent（结构感知的章节排序 + 带充分性检查的迭代阅读）与首个 IntraBench 基准（315 实例、5 领域），实验证明其相对 SOTA RAG 与文献型科研智能体有显著且模型无关的准确率优势，同时具备对非标准标题的鲁棒性。局限在于：仅处理文本，未纳入图表等非文本模态；论文类型未覆盖综述等；仍存在"上下文关系盲视"（LLM 缺乏领域术语知识导致关键关联被忽略、最终答"None of the above"）的问题，作者指出更强的科学推理能力或可缓解。后续工作将扩展更多论文类型与查询形式，并在跨领域术语与映射模型质量上进一步探索。

title: An Empirical Evaluation of Locally Deployed LLMs for Bug Detection in Python Code
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on a wide range of software engineering tasks, including code generation and analysis. However, most prior work relies on cloud-based models or specialized hardware, limiting practical applicability in privacy-sensitive or resource-constrained environments. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical evaluation of two locally deployed LLMs, LLaMA 3.2 and Mistral, for real-world Python bug detection using the BugsInPy benchmark. We evaluate 349 bugs across 17 projects using a zero-shot prompting approach at the function level and an automated keyword-based evaluation framework. Our results show that locally executed models achieve accuracy between 43% and 45%, while producing a large proportion of partially correct responses that identify problematic code regions without pinpointing the exact fix. Performance varies significantly across projects, highlighting the importance of codebase characteristics. The results demonstrate that local models can identify a meaningful share of bugs, though precise localization remains difficult for locally executed LLMs, particularly when handling complex and context dependent bugs in realistic development scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了本地部署的LLM（LLaMA 3.2和Mistral）在Python bug检测任务上的表现，解决了云端模型在隐私敏感场景中的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在软件工程任务中表现优异，但大多数研究依赖云端模型或专用硬件，在隐私敏感或资源受限环境中实际应用受限。因此需要评估本地部署模型的可行性。
AI.method: 使用BugsInPy基准测试集（349个bug，17个项目），采用零样本提示方法在函数级别进行评估，建立自动化关键词评估框架，对比LLaMA 3.2和Mistral两款本地模型。
AI.result: 本地模型准确率在43%-45%之间；产生大量部分正确的响应（能定位问题区域但无法精确定位修复点）；不同项目间性能差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 本地模型能有效识别部分bug，但精确bug定位仍是挑战，尤其是面对复杂上下文依赖的真实开发场景时。本地部署是可行的但需进一步提升定位能力。

title: Finding Shortest Reconfiguration Sequences on Independent Set Polytopes
summary: We initiate the study of the shortest reconfiguration problem for independent sets under the adjacency relation derived from the independent set polytope. Given a graph and two independent sets, the problem asks for a shortest sequence transforming one into the other such that the subgraph induced by the symmetric difference of any two consecutive sets is connected. This is equivalent to finding a shortest path on the $1$-skeleton of the independent set polytope. We prove that the problem is NP-hard even on planar graphs of bounded degree, as well as on split graphs. Notably, the hardness for planar graphs of bounded degree still holds even when deciding whether the target can be reached in at most two steps. For split graphs, we further show the W[2]-hardness when parameterized by the number of steps, as well as the inapproximability of the optimal length. As a consequence, we prove that the length of a shortest path between two vertices of a 0/1 polytope in $\mathbb{R}^n$ described by $O(n)$ linear inequalities is hard to approximate within a factor of $(1-\varepsilon)\ln n$ for any constant $ε>0$, unless $P=NP$. On the positive side, we provide polynomial-time algorithms for block graphs, cographs, and bipartite chain graphs. Moreover, for paths and cycles, we show that the optimal length of the shortest reconfiguration sequence exactly matches a trivial upper bound.

AI.tldr: 本文研究独立集多面体1-骨架上的最短重配置问题，证明其在平面有界度图和分裂图上NP难，并建立了路径长度的不可近似性结果，同时给出了若干图类的多项式时间算法
AI.motivation: 独立集重配置问题是组合重配置研究中的核心问题，文章首次从独立集多面体几何角度研究最短重配置序列，揭示该问题的计算复杂性边界
AI.method: 将重配置问题转化为独立集多面体的1-骨架上的最短路径问题。通过构造性归约证明NP难性，利用参数复杂性分析证明W[2]-硬度，并基于容错性归约建立不可近似性结果
AI.result: 证明了问题在平面有界度图和分裂图上的NP难性，以及分裂图上参数步数的W[2]-硬度；在0/1多面体上建立了最短路径长度的不可近似性下界(1-ε)ln n；给出了块图、余图和双分链图上的多项式算法；证明了路径和圈上最优解等于平凡上界
AI.conclusion: 1. 最短独立集重配置问题在平面有界度图和分裂图上是NP难和W[2]-难的；2. 在0/1多面体上的最短路径长度无法在(1-ε)ln n因子内近似，除非P=NP；3. 但在块图、余图和双分链图上存在多项式时间算法；4. 在路径和圈上最优长度恰好等于平凡上界

title: A pragmatic approach to regulating AI agents
summary: The current advancement in and deployment of agentic AI systems has created a set of key challenges for the legal frameworks that govern their use. We cover two central components: first, the regulatory classification of agents under the EU AI Act, and second, the legal status and validity of autonomous actions within the established framework of EU contract law. We argue that the unique capacity of agents to autonomously reason, plan, and execute tasks across disparate external systems necessitates a fundamental shift in oversight toward the orchestration layer, where multi-agent interactions introduce novel risks of misalignment. While agents generally utilise general-purpose AI models, we posit that their structural complexity and cross-system permeability require them to be regulated as "AI systems" with distinct obligations under the AI Act. Consequently, our proposals highlight the need for robust accountability mechanisms to manage this heightened autonomy. On the contractual side, we advocate for a "traffic light" system of staggered task authorization based on operational risk and the creation of a statutory list of non-delegable legal acts. By implementing these measures, we provide a pragmatic pathway to ensure that the increasing autonomy of AI agents remains firmly anchored in human accountability and existing legal standards

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇法律研究论文，讨论代理式AI（AI agents）在欧盟法下的规制路径：一方面主张将AI代理在《欧盟人工智能法》下归类为需承担独立义务的"AI系统"，另一方面主张在欧盟合同法框架内重新界定代理自主行为的效力，并提出"交通灯式"分级授权机制与不可委托法律行为清单，以在提升自主性的同时维持人类问责。
AI.motivation: 代理式AI系统（agentic AI）的快速发展与实际部署，对现行欧盟法律框架提出了两方面核心挑战：一是《欧盟人工智能法》(EU AI Act) 下如何对代理进行监管分类；二是代理自主完成的行为在既有欧盟合同法框架中的法律地位与效力问题。代理具备跨异构外部系统自主推理、规划与执行任务的能力，这种结构性复杂性与跨系统可穿透性带来了传统"工具性"AI所没有的风险，尤其是多代理交互在编排层（orchestration layer）引入的失配（misalignment）风险，因此需要从传统的模型层/用户监督范式转向对编排层的监督。文章同时强调，代理通常依赖通用大模型，这不足以覆盖其系统级风险，必须通过专门义务加以规制。
AI.method: 采用规范分析与学说建构相结合的方法：一是对《欧盟人工智能法》的现有风险分级与分类体系（基于用途、角色与自主性）进行解释，将代理视为具有独立义务的"AI系统"而非单纯的通用模型工具，并据此提出针对性的合规义务与问责机制；二是援引欧盟合同法既有概念（代理、授权、合同相对性、法律行为有效性），分析自主行为中人类意思表示的定位与瑕疵后果；进而提出两项制度设计——按运营风险分级的"交通灯"式阶梯任务授权（task authorization）体系，以及法定不可委托法律行为清单（non-delegable legal acts）。
AI.result: 得出规范性结论：(1) 在AI法层面，鉴于代理的结构复杂性与跨系统可穿透性，应被规制为承担独立义务的"AI系统"，监管重心应从模型层转向编排层监督，以应对多代理交互带来的失配风险；(2) 在合同法层面，提出建立以运营风险为基础的"交通灯"式分级任务授权制度（低风险放行、中风险需确认、高风险禁止），并以法定清单方式界定不可委托给AI代理的法律行为（如特定人身性、处分性或受严格形式要求的行为）；(3) 配套提出强化问责机制（robust accountability mechanisms）以管理不断增强的代理自主性，使代理行为在既有法律标准下保持可归责于人类的锚定。
AI.conclusion: 总体而言，代理式AI的自主性提升不应通过放松法律控制来实现，而应通过重构法律控制的对象与方式来回应。结论主张将代理在AI法下确立为独立规制主体，监督焦点前移至编排层；在合同法中通过分级授权与不可委托清单的双重制度，为自主代理行为提供可操作的合法性与归责路径，从而在提高AI代理效用与可部署性的同时，将其稳固地置于人类问责与既有法律标准之下，提供一条务实可行的治理路径。

title: When Policies Cannot Be Retrained: A Unified Closed-Form View of Post-Training Steering in Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) can learn effective policies from fixed datasets, but deployment objectives may change after training, and in many applications the trained actor cannot be retrained because of data, cost, or governance constraints. We study deployment-time adaptation for frozen offline actors using Product-of-Experts (PoE) composition with a goal-conditioned prior. Our main practical finding is graceful degradation rather than universal performance gain: under degraded or random priors, precision-weighted composition remains anchored to the frozen actor, while additive and prior-only adaptation collapse, and a KL-budget selector often recovers a near-oracle operating point. We also make explicit a closed-form identity in the frozen-actor setting: for diagonal-Gaussian actors and priors, PoE with coefficient alpha yields the same deterministic policy as KL-regularized adaptation with beta = alpha / (1 - alpha), with posterior covariances differing only by a global scalar factor. Empirically, across four D4RL environments (3,900 MuJoCo episodes), we observe a 4/5/3 HELP/FROZEN/HURT split. Extending the analysis to six harder cells and two AntMaze diagnostics reveals an actor-competence ceiling: medium-expert remains HURT in all 9 cells at every tested alpha, while AntMaze with a behavior-cloned frozen actor yields zero success for all composition rules. Overall, PoE and KL-regularized adaptation are best viewed as a single actor-anchored safety mechanism for deployment-time steering.

AI.tldr: 本文研究离线强化学习中冻结策略的部署时适应方法，发现PoE组合与KL正则化适应存在闭式恒等关系，精度加权组合能够锚定冻结策略实现优雅降级，但存在演员能力天花板：使用中等-专家数据的策略在所有测试场景中持续表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习从固定数据集学习有效策略，但部署目标可能在训练后发生变化，且许多应用中由于数据、成本或治理约束无法重新训练已部署的策略，因此需要研究冻结离线演员的部署时适应方法。
AI.method: 使用带目标条件先验的Product-of-Experts (PoE)组合实现冻结策略的部署时适应；推导了PoE系数alpha与KL正则化适应系数beta = α/(1-α)之间的闭式恒等关系；通过D4RL环境的3,900个MuJoCo回合和AntMaze诊断任务进行实证评估；比较了精度加权组合、加法组合和仅先验适应等不同方法；引入KL预算选择器恢复近Oracle操作点。
AI.result: 主要发现为"优雅降级"而非普遍性能提升：在降级或随机先验下，精度加权组合仍锚定冻结策略，而加法和仅先验适应则崩溃，KL预算选择器常能恢复近Oracle性能。经验结果中D4RL环境呈现4/5/3的HELP/FROZEN/HURT分割。揭示了演员能力天花板：中等-专家数据在所有9个单元中始终HURT；使用行为克隆冻结演员的AntMaze在所有组合规则下成功率为零。
AI.conclusion: PoE和KL正则化适应应被视为单一的演员锚定安全机制，用于部署时转向；其核心价值不在于提升性能，而在于提供一种可控且稳健的策略调整手段，尤其适用于无法重新训练的场景。

title: Mechanistic Steering of LLMs Reveals Layer-wise Feature Vulnerabilities in Adversarial Settings
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can still be jailbroken into producing harmful outputs despite safety alignment. Existing attacks show this vulnerability, but not the internal mechanisms that cause it. This study asks whether jailbreak success is driven by identifiable internal features rather than prompts alone. We propose a three-stage pipeline for Gemma-2-2B using the BeaverTails dataset. First, we extract concept-aligned tokens from adversarial responses via subspace similarity. Second, we apply three feature-grouping strategies (cluster, hierarchical-linkage, and single-token-driven) to identify SAE feature subgroups for the aligned tokens across all 26 model layers. Third, we steer the model by amplifying the top features from each identified subgroup and measure the change in harmfulness score using a standardized LLM-judge scoring protocol. In all three approaches, the features in the layers [16-25] were relatively more vulnerable to steering. All three methods confirmed that mid to later layer feature subgroups are more responsible for unsafe outputs. These results provide evidence that the jailbreak vulnerability in Gemma-2-2B is localized to feature subgroups of mid to later layers, suggesting that targeted feature-level interventions may offer a more principled path to adversarial robustness than current prompt-level defenses.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过概念对齐tokens提取与三种特征分组策略，揭示Gemma-2-2B越狱漏洞集中于中后层（16-25层）的特定特征子组，为靶向特征级干预提供了理论依据。
AI.motivation: 尽管有安全对齐，LLM仍可被越狱生成有害输出。现有攻击展示了该漏洞，但未揭示其内部机制。本文探索越狱成功是否由可识别的内部特征驱动，而非仅由提示词驱动。
AI.method: 三阶段流程：1）通过子空间相似性从对抗响应中提取概念对齐tokens；2）应用三种特征分组策略（聚类、层次链接、单token驱动）识别26层中对齐tokens的SAE特征子组；3）放大各子组top特征并用LLM-judge协议测量危害性分数变化。
AI.result: 三层方法均证实中层（16-25层）的特征更易受操控 steering；中后层特征子组对不安全输出负有更大责任。
AI.conclusion: Gemma-2-2B的越狱漏洞集中于中后层特征子组，靶向特征级干预可能比当前提示级防御提供更原则性的对抗鲁棒性路径。

title: PhySE: A Psychological Framework for Real-Time AR-LLM Social Engineering Attacks
summary: The emerging threat of AR-LLM-based Social Engineering (AR-LLM-SE) attacks (e.g. SEAR) poses a significant risk to real-world social interactions. In such an attack, a malicious actor uses Augmented Reality (AR) glasses to capture a target visual and vocal data. A Large Language Model (LLM) then analyzes this data to identify the individual and generate a detailed social profile. Subsequently, LLM-powered agents employ social engineering strategies, providing real-time conversation suggestions, to gain the target trust and ultimately execute phishing or other malicious acts. Despite its potential, the practical application of AR-LLM-SE faces two major bottlenecks, (1) Cold-start personalization, Current Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) methods introduce critical delays in the earliest turns, slowing initial profile formation and disrupting real-time interaction, (2) Static Attack Strategies, Existing approaches rely on fixed-stage, handcrafted social engineering tactics that lack foundation in established psychological theory. To address these limitations, we propose PhySE, a novel framework with two core innovations, (1) VLM-Based SocialContext Training, To eliminate profiling delays, we efficiently pre-train a Visual Language Model (VLM) with social-context data, enabling rapid, on-the-fly profile generation, (2) Adaptive Psychological Agent, We introduce a psychological LLM that dynamically deploys distinct classes of psychological strategies based on target response, moving beyond static, handcrafted scripts. We evaluated PhySE through an IRB-approved user study with 60 participants, collecting a novel dataset of 360 annotated conversations across diverse social scenarios.

AI.tldr: PhySE 是一个面向 AR 眼镜 + 多模态大模型的实时社会工程攻击框架，通过「基于社会情境的 VLM 微调（LoRA + CLIP 式跨模态对比对齐）」解决画像冷启动延迟，并引入「自适应心理智能体（潜在信任状态 + 三类心理策略路由：亲和/可信度/承诺行动）」替代固定阶段脚本。在 IRB 批准、60 名参与者、360 段对话的实验中，社会体验评分 4.83（σ=0.37）优于 SEAR（4.73）、Naive AR+LLM（4.13）与普通对话（3.03），画像生成平均延迟由 43.3 s 降至 10.5 s。
AI.motivation: AR 可穿戴设备与多模态 LLM 的融合带来了新的攻击面：攻击者用 AR 眼镜采集目标的面部、语音与场景线索，LLM 推断身份与社会画像，再由 LLM 智能体给出逐轮（turn-level）话术建议，最终将线下建立的信任转移到短信、电话、邮件等下游渠道实施钓鱼。已有的 AR-LLM 社会工程系统（如 SEAR）存在两个阻碍实用化的瓶颈：(1) 冷启动个性化——依赖检索增强生成（RAG）构建画像，在开场几轮产生约 50 s 的明显停顿，破坏面对面交互的自然流畅性与首轮说服力；(2) 静态攻击策略——固定阶段的手工提示词（开场→建立信任）假设目标按预期轨迹反应，无法应对目标的迟疑、转移话题或疑虑，也缺乏心理学理论支撑。作者的目标是让 AR-LLM 社会工程在真实交互中达到稳定、高保真的执行水平，并同时为防御研究提供数据与威胁分析基础。
AI.method:
系统由感知侧与决策侧两个紧耦合组件构成，整体为「AR→VLM→心理智能体」的实时流水线。

威胁模型：攻击者使用 AR 硬件（摄像头与麦克风）采集面部外观、语音与周边环境，结合可获取的公开社交痕迹进行个性化；目标仍是受互惠、权威线索、认知负荷等常规社会影响机制影响的普通人；商业级 AR 设备缺乏实时身份/隐私保护。攻击分为线下建立信任阶段（本文重点）与下游渠道利用阶段（钓鱼消息、诈骗电话）。

(1) VLM-Based SocialContext Training：在 LLaVA-v1.5-7B 上做参数高效微调（LoRA，rank r=128、α=256，视觉编码器为 CLIP ViT-L/14 336），使模型内化社会情境知识而非在推理时检索。训练数据为 LLaVA 风格的图文指令对，标注社交可用属性（姓名线索、组织归属、兴趣、可用于寒暄的背景信息）。采用 CLIP 式跨模态对比对齐：图像/文本编码器分别 L2 归一化，相似度 s_ij = z_i^T z_j / τ，使用对称 InfoNCE 损失 L_con = ½(L_I→T + L_T→I)；同时加入同一人的多样图像与负例/干扰样本以防记忆像素与虚假相关。训练后将 LoRA 权重合并入基座（W = W₀ + BA），消除适配器运行时开销、降低内存搬移与延迟抖动。

(2) Adaptive Psychological Agent：采用 ReAct 风格控制循环的紧凑 LLM 路由器。交互状态 s_t 仅含四项轻量信息：Social-VLM 生成的画像摘要、场景/位置快照、近期对话滚动窗口、参与度信号（回应性、认同或迟疑、话题热情度）。路由器先估计 receptivity 与 suspicion risk，再决定维持当前策略或转向更安全策略，将「战术选择（为何此刻这么做）」与「表层措辞（怎么说）」解耦。三类理论支撑策略：Path A 亲和/ rapport（共享兴趣、 reflective listening、低风险互惠，基于 SCM 的 warmth）；Path B 可信度/承诺（角色、机构、情境合理的专业性引用以支撑 competence，保持可核查）；Path C 动机/行动（小步请求、承诺一致性、时间有限框架，仅在参与度显示就绪时启用）。生成端输出 1–2 句、可直接照读或改写的建议，约束为场景一致、画像一致（不虚构个人信息），并在疑虑升高时给出退出策略。潜在信任状态建模：T_{t+1} = (1−λ)T_t + λ·g_θ(x_t, a_t) − β·r_t + ε_t，其中 g_θ 为策略相关线性增益、r_t 为怀疑风险惩罚；依从概率为逻辑函数 Pr(y_t=1) = σ(αT_t − γd_t + η^T z_t)，仅当 T_t 超过就绪阈值才提高请求难度 d_t，否则降级回 rapport/可信度建设。设计中还对比并排除替代方案：有限状态机（心理解释受限、状态难维护）、LLM 强化学习（理由不透明、探索不安全、依赖数据）、端到端 next-action 预测（难以归因、跨提示不稳定），隐式信任状态在可解释性、可控性、鲁棒性上取得较好折中。

实现：RayNeo X2 AR 眼镜（Android）采集；桌面服务器（RTX 4090 24GB、Intel Platinum 8352 36 核、32GB RAM）运行模型；音频前端用 Silero VAD 切分语音、Whisper 转写，与画像摘要共同送入心理智能体。

评测：IRB 批准的真实场景（咖啡馆、社交活动）用户研究，60 名参与者（23–62 岁，均值 34 岁；男 28/女 32），360 段对话，参与者轮换扮演攻击者与目标以平衡偏差；设置 7 种条件（基础对话、Naive AR+LLM、SEAR、PhySE 完整版、去 VLM 优化、去心理路由）；数据集含 AR 多模态流、公开社交情境数据、问卷与逐轮路由轨迹；问卷含配置级对比、11 个主观体验维度（相关性、恰当性、自然度、节奏、真诚度、情感推进、AR 舒适度、无辅助意愿、未来意图、深度、接受度）与 6 项易感度结果（Photo Link、Social App、SMS、Phone Call、Trust-Before/After）。
AI.result: 社会体验评分（5 分制）：PhySE 均值 4.83、σ=0.37 最高且最稳定，其中 83.3% 评 5 分、16.7% 评 4 分，无 3 分及以下；SEAR 4.73（σ=0.51，仍有 3.3% 中评）；Naive AR+LLM 4.13（σ=0.72，20% 中评）；基础对话 3.03（σ=1.30，38.3% 评 2 分、6.7% 评 1 分）。攻击有效性：PhySE 在 Photo Link、Social App、SMS、Phone Call 四项指标上均优于 SEAR 且方差小，增益最大的是需要更强信任的短信与电话应答，而低摩擦渠道（照片链接、加好友）维持既有高水平；主观体验 11 个维度全面优于 SEAR，差距最大者为 Sincerity、Depth、Acceptance、FutureIntent 等信任与参与相关项，ARComfort 达 4.67/5。延迟：多模态画像生成平均由 43.3 s 降至 10.5 s，P90 由 52.7 s 降至 19.7 s（区间 4.6–20.6 s）；社会智能体平均延迟升高（5.8 s vs 2.8 s）但区间收窄至 4.8–6.3 s（SEAR 为 1.0–10.6 s），节奏更可预测；AR 采集延迟可忽略（平均 80.6 ms），瓶颈仍是多模态 LLM 阶段。消融：完整版 4.83/σ=0.37；去掉训练 VLM 降至 2.93（σ=1.14，↓39.3%）；去掉心理智能体降至 3.00（σ=1.13，↓37.9%），说明感知侧与决策侧缺一不可且共同影响稳定性。作者亦指出语言自然度与本地化仍存在改进空间（偶有生硬措辞）。
AI.conclusion: PhySE 通过「社会情境 VLM 微调 + 自适应心理路由智能体」把 AR-LLM 社会工程从依赖检索的固定脚本推进到低延迟、心理理论支撑的实时系统：在 IRB 批准的实验中取得最高且最稳定的社会体验、跨渠道更强且更一致的易感度，并以 10.5 s 的画像生成时延消除了现实交互的关键瓶颈。作者同时强调该威胁的现实有效性，并呼吁加强防护：实时感知保护（约束 AR 的音视频采集）、行为层面的风险检测与用户侧干预；并开源 360 段标注对话数据集与代码以支撑检测、干预与政策研究。伦理方面，研究经 IRB 批准、数据匿名化并声明未披露个人身份信息，作者定位该工作为面向防御的攻防基础研究。

title: SpotVista: Availability-Aware Recommendation System for Reliable and Cost-Efficient Multi-Node Spot Instances
summary:
Cloud vendors offer discounted spot instances to maximize surplus resource utilization, but these instances are subject to the risk of sudden interruption. Traditional pricing datasets have been employed to predict this risk, yet recent policy changes by cloud vendors have diminished their effectiveness. To promote spot instance usage, public cloud vendors provide instant availability datasets to help users mitigate interruption risks. While existing research utilizing this data has proposed methods to reduce interruptions, these studies have primarily focused on single-node instances, overlooking the stability of multi-node environments widely adopted for modern cloud workloads.
  This paper proposes SpotVista, a system that recommends a resource pool of reliable and cost-efficient multi-node spot instances by leveraging various publicly available datasets. To achieve this, SpotVista collects a large-scale multi-node availability dataset while overcoming significant query limitations. Through a thorough analysis of multi-node spot instance availability behavior, SpotVista establishes a methodology for recommending cost-efficient and reliable multi-node configurations.
  To evaluate how effectively the proposed methodology reflects multi-node availability and cost efficiency, extensive real-world interruption experiments were conducted. The results demonstrate that SpotVista outperforms the state-of-the-art work, SpotVerse, achieving 81.28% greater availability and 2.84\% more cost savings in a multi-region setup. When compared to a publicly available service, AWS SpotFleet, SpotVista provides 21.6\% higher stability and 26.3% greater cost savings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpotVista系统，通过利用多种公开可用性数据集，为用户推荐可靠且成本高效的多节点Spot实例。系统通过收集大规模多节点可用性数据并分析其行为模式，建立了一套推荐方法论。实验结果表明，SpotVista在多区域环境下相比SpotVerse可用性提升81.28%、成本节省增加2.84%；相比AWS SpotFleet稳定性提升21.6%、成本节省增加26.3%。
AI.motivation: 1) 云厂商政策变化导致传统定价数据集预测中断风险的效果下降；2) 现有公开可用性数据集的研究主要聚焦于单节点实例，忽视了现代云工作负载中广泛采用的多节点环境的稳定性问题。
AI.method: 1) 收集大规模多节点可用性数据集，并克服显著的查询限制；2) 对多节点Spot实例的可用性行为进行深入分析；3) 建立一套方法论用于推荐成本效益高且可靠的多节点配置方案。
AI.result: 1) 相比当前最优方案SpotVerse：在多区域设置下可用性提升81.28%，成本节省增加2.84%；2) 相比AWS SpotFleet：稳定性提升21.6%，成本节省增加26.3%。
AI.conclusion: SpotVista通过整合多源公开可用性数据集，并针对多节点环境建立系统的稳定性评估与成本优化方法论，显著提升了多节点Spot实例的可用性和成本效益，优于现有方案SpotVerse和AWS SpotFleet。

title: A Large-Scale, Cross-Disciplinary Corpus of Systematic Reviews
summary: Existing benchmarks for systematic reviewing remain limited either in scale or in disciplinary coverage, with some collections comprising only a modest number of topics and others focusing primarily on biomedical research. We present Webis-SR4ALL-26, a large-scale, cross-disciplinary corpus of 301,871 systematic reviews spanning all scientific fields as covered by OpenAlex. Using a multi-stage pre-processing pipeline, we link reviews to resolved OpenAlex metadata and reference lists and extract, when explicitly reported, structured method artifacts relevant to retrieval and screening. These artifacts include reported search strategies (Boolean queries or keyword lists) that we normalize into executable approximations, as well as reported inclusion and exclusion criteria. Together, these layers support cross-domain benchmarking of retrieval and screening components against review reference lists, training and evaluation of extraction methods for review artifacts, and comparative meta-science analyses of systematic review practices across disciplines and time. To demonstrate one concrete use case, we report large-scale baseline retrieval signals by executing normalized search strategies in OpenAlex and comparing retrieved sets to resolved reference lists. We release the corpus and the pre-processing pipeline, along with code used for extraction validation and the retrieval demonstration.

AI.tldr: 提出了Webis-SR4ALL-26，一个跨学科的大规模系统评价语料库，包含301,871篇覆盖OpenAlex所有科学领域的系统评价。该语料库通过多阶段预处理流程与OpenAlex元数据及参考文献关联，提取搜索策略和纳排标准等结构化方法构件，支持跨领域基准测试和元科学研究。
AI.motivation: 现有系统评价基准测试在规模或学科覆盖上存在局限，部分仅包含少量主题，部分主要聚焦生物医学领域。
AI.method: 采用多阶段预处理流程，将系统评价与OpenAlex元数据和参考文献列表关联，并提取结构化的方法构件（包括搜索策略和纳排标准）。
AI.result: 构建了包含301,871篇跨学科系统评价的大规模语料库；通过在OpenAlex中执行归一化搜索策略，报告了大范围基线检索信号。
AI.conclusion: 发布了语料库和预处理管道及相关代码，支持跨领域基准测试、方法提取训练评估，以及跨学科和时间的系统评价实践比较研究。

title: UniAda: Universal Adaptive Multi-objective Adversarial Attack for End-to-End Autonomous Driving Systems
comment: Published at IEEE Transactions on Reliability journal (2023)
summary: Adversarial attacks play a pivotal role in testing and improving the reliability of deep learning (DL) systems. Existing literature has demonstrated that subtle perturbations to the input can elicit erroneous outcomes, thereby substantially compromising the security of DL systems. This has emerged as a critical concern in the development of DL-based safety-critical systems like Autonomous Driving Systems (ADSs). The focus of existing adversarial attack methods on End-to-End (E2E) ADSs has predominantly centered on misbehaviors of steering angle, which overlooks speed-related controls or imperceptible perturbations. To address these challenges, we introduce UniAda, a multi-objective white-box attack technique with a core function that revolves around crafting an image-agnostic adversarial perturbation capable of simultaneously influencing both steering and speed controls. UniAda capitalizes on an intricately designed multi-objective optimization function with the Adaptive Weighting Scheme (AWS), enabling the concurrent optimization of diverse objectives. Validated with both simulated and real-world driving data, UniAda outperforms five benchmarks across two metrics, inducing steering and speed deviations from 3.54 degrees to 29 degrees and 11 km per hour to 22 km per hour on average. This systematic approach establishes UniAda as a proven technique for adversarial attacks on modern DL-based E2E ADSs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniAda，一种针对端到端自动驾驶系统的多目标白盒对抗攻击方法，通过生成图像无关的对抗扰动同时影响转向和速度控制，采用自适应加权策略实现多目标优化，在模拟和真实驾驶数据上验证，可诱导3.54°至29°的转向偏差和11至22km/h的速度偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗攻击方法主要关注端到端自动驾驶系统的转向角控制，忽略了速度相关控制或难以察觉的扰动，且缺乏同时攻击多目标的系统性方法。随着深度学习在自动驾驶等安全关键系统中的广泛应用，现有攻击方法的局限性严重制约了对系统可靠性的全面评估。
AI.method: 提出UniAda多目标白盒攻击技术，核心是生成图像无关的对抗扰动同时影响转向和速度控制。采用精心设计的多目标优化函数，结合自适应加权策略（AWS）实现多目标并发优化。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实驾驶数据上验证，UniAda在两个评估指标上均优于五个基准方法，可诱导平均3.54°至29°的转向偏差和11至22km/h的速度偏差。
AI.conclusion: UniAda作为一种系统性方法，证明了其对现代深度学习端到端自动驾驶系统进行对抗攻击的有效性，为评估自动驾驶系统安全性提供了新的技术手段。

title: Near-Optimal Heaps and Dijkstra on Pointer Machines
summary:
A heap is a dynamic data structure that stores a set of labeled values under the following operations: pop returns the minimum value of the heap, Push($x_i$) pushes a new value $x_i$ onto the heap, and DecreaseKey($i$, $v$) decreases the value $x_i$ to $v$.
  A working-set heap is a heap that supports the $x_i \gets$ pop$()$ operation in $O(\log Γ(x_i) )$ time where $Γ(x_i)$ is the size of the \emph{working set}: the number of elements that were pushed onto the heap while $x_i$ was in the heap.
  The goal of working set heap design is to maintain the working set property while minimizing the overhead of the Push and DecreaseKey operations.
  On a word RAM, there exist working set heaps that support Push and DecreaseKey in amortized constant time.
  In this paper, we show via a simple construction that pointer machines, one of the most general and least-assuming computational models, support working set heaps that support Push in amortized constant time and DecreaseKey in inverse-Ackermann time. A by-product of this analysis is that Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm can be near-universally optimal on a pointer machine -- incurring only an additive $O(m \, α(m))$ overhead compared to the optimal running time for distance ordering, where $m$ denotes the number of edges in the graph.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在指针机器这一通用计算模型上，工作集堆可以支持Push（摊销常数时间）和DecreaseKey（逆Ackermann时间）操作，并展示了该结构可使Dijkstra算法达到near-universally optimal的性能边界，仅有O(m·α(m))的加性开销。
AI.motivation: 现有研究已在Word RAM模型上实现了 amortized constant time的Push和DecreaseKey操作，但指针机器作为更通用、更少假设的计算模型，是否能支持类似性能的工作集堆仍不清楚。该研究旨在探索指针机器模型上的最优堆结构设计。
AI.method: 作者通过一个简单构造方法，在指针机器模型上实现了支持工作集性质的堆结构。该结构将Push操作摊销常数时间与DecreaseKey操作的逆Ackermann时间相结合，同时保持了工作集堆的核心性质——pop操作的时间复杂度与元素的working set大小Γ(x_i)相关。
AI.result: 在指针机器模型上成功构建了工作集堆，使得Push操作达到摊销常数时间，DecreaseKey操作达到逆Ackermann时间。由此，Dijkstra最短路径算法在指针机器上可达到near-universally optimal，仅产生O(m·α(m))的加性开销。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了指针机器模型上可以实现接近最优的工作集堆结构，并成功应用于Dijkstra最短路径算法的优化，为指针机器上的算法设计提供了新的理论基准。

title: Rewarding the Scientific Process: Process-Level Reward Modeling for Agentic Data Analysis
summary: Process Reward Models (PRMs) have achieved remarkable success in augmenting the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) within static domains such as mathematics. However, their potential in dynamic data analysis tasks remains underexplored. In this work, we first present a empirical study revealing that general-domain PRMs struggle to supervise data analysis agents. Specifically, they fail to detect silent errors, logical flaws that yield incorrect results without triggering interpreter exceptions, and erroneously penalize exploratory actions, mistaking necessary trial-and-error exploration for grounding failures. To bridge this gap, we introduce DataPRM, a novel environment-aware generative process reward model that (1) can serve as an active verifier, autonomously interacting with the environment to probe intermediate execution states and uncover silent errors, and (2) employs a reflection-aware ternary reward strategy that distinguishes between correctable grounding errors and irrecoverable mistakes. We design a scalable pipeline to construct over 8K high-quality training instances for DataPRM via diversity-driven trajectory generation and knowledge-augmented step-level annotation. Experimental results demonstrate that DataPRM improves downstream policy LLMs by 7.21% on ScienceAgentBench and 11.28% on DABStep using Best-of-N inference. Notably, with only 4B parameters, DataPRM outperforms strong baselines, and exhibits robust generalizability across diverse Test-Time Scaling strategies. Furthermore, integrating DataPRM into Reinforcement Learning yields substantial gains over outcome-reward baselines, achieving 78.73% on DABench and 64.84% on TableBench, validating the effectiveness of process reward supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/zjunlp/DataMind.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DataPRM——面向智能体式数据分析的环境感知生成式过程奖励模型（PRM）。它以 ReAct 范式主动与代码解释器/文件环境交互来探测中间执行状态，从而发现"静默错误"（代码能跑通但结果错误）；同时采用"反思感知"三元奖励（1.0 严格正确 / 0.5 可纠正的接地错误 / 0.0 不可恢复错误），避免惩罚必要的试错探索。配套构建了 7K+ 步级标注数据的可扩展流水线（多样性驱动的轨迹生成 + 知识增强的步骤标注）。4B 参数的 DataPRM 在 Best-of-N 下把策略模型 Qwen3-235B 在 ScienceAgentBench 提升 7.21%、DABStep 提升 11.28%，优于 72B 的通用 PRM 并实现 58× 参数效率；用于 GRPO 强化学习时在 DABench 达 78.73%、TableBench 达 64.84%。
AI.motivation: 自动化数据科学要求 LLM 智能体自主完成多步数据分析，但现有方法只做结果级（outcome）监督，忽视过程严谨性，易传播"看似合理但无效"的幻觉逻辑。过程奖励模型（PRM）虽在数学等静态领域成功，但其在动态数据分析中的适用性尚未探索。作者先做实证研究（RQ1/RQ2），发现通用领域 PRM 在数据分析任务上存在两类系统性失效模式：(1) 静默错误（Silent Errors）——代码执行成功但因逻辑缺陷产生错误结果，纯静态阅读代码的 PRM 无法发现；(2) 接地错误（Grounding Errors）——智能体因不了解数据 schema 而产生的语法/列名错误本属可恢复的探索步骤，通用 PRM 却将其判为致命错误并重罚，导致搜索算法剪掉本可自我纠正的正确轨迹。此外 PRM 引导的 Best-of-N 甚至不如简单的 Majority Voting，成本效益更差。因此需要一个"环境感知"的验证器：既要宽容可恢复的探索错误，又要主动与数据环境交互以捕获静默错误。
AI.method: （1）问题形式化：将数据分析建模为 POMDP (U,S,A,T,O)，状态包含代码解释器与文件集，智能体按 ReAct 生成 (z_t,a_t,o_t)，仅通过解释器观测获得部分可观测性；PRM 依据历史轨迹 h_t 与当前步 τ_t 输出步级奖励，轨迹奖励由 Sum/Mean 聚合。（2）DataPRM 架构：采用与策略模型相同的 ReAct 范式做生成式验证，内部多步产生验证三元组 κ=(ẑ,â,ô) 并更新内部上下文，最终输出 (ẑ_K, r_t, c_t)（分数 + 理由）；历史验证反馈 f_t=(r_0,c_0,…) 被追加进下一步输入以保证评分一致性。工具增强：解耦"内在推理"（训练获得）与"外在感知"（工具获得），提供 query_document 与 query_image 两个函数调用工具，用于读取手册文档与图像（多模态理解、长上下文理解）。（3）反思感知三元奖励：R={1.0 严格正确, 0.0 不可恢复错误（逻辑谬误/幻觉、轨迹走入死路）, 0.5 可纠正错误（语法错、路径错等，但触发环境反馈回路、带来有效信息增益）}。（4）数据构建流水线：适配 AutoSDT 爬取 GitHub 科学数据分析文件并由专家修订扩展；用 DeepSeek-V3.2 合成面向推理的 query（可视化任务沿用已验证 AutoSDT query）；以 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct 为策略模型 K=4 平行采样，用 DeepSeek-V3.2 裁判判断最终答案是否彼此矛盾，仅保留答案不一致的轨迹以聚焦信息量高的边界样本；随后 Qwen3-235B 初标步骤与错误归因，用 AutoManual 框架合并相似错误类别，专家人工核验类别理由并注入为结构化 few-shot 示例，最后由 DeepSeek-V3.2 按三元奖励打标；过滤超时/文件损坏等非分析性错误，100 次人工抽检显示原始准确率 86.0%、QWK κ=0.83。（5）RL 集成：基于 GRPO（含 clip-higher、token-level loss），总奖励 r_total=(1-β)·r_outcome + β·mean(r_prm)，β=0.5，组归一化优势，并对最后一步施加一致性校正 r_prm(τ_T)←r_outcome；用 verl + AgentLoop/RewardLoop 异步 rollout 与打分。
AI.result: 通用 PRM 评测：ThinkPRM 把单路径 32.67% 提到 40.00%（N=16）却仍不及 Majority Voting；错误分析显示通用 PRM 给"最终答案正确但含接地错误"的步骤打低分，且纯 ICL 验证器在获得环境交互（单轮/多轮代码）后选步准确率明显提升，多轮优于单轮。TTS 主结果（基座 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507，N∈{4,8,16}）：DataPRM（4B）在 ScienceAgentBench 达 25.64%（Easy 77.78%），DABStep 达 40.89%，同时超过 Majority Vote、LLM-as-a-judge（DeepSeek-V3.2）、Self-Rewarding（Qwen3-235B）、GenPRM-32B 与 Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-72B，相比大模型自奖励有 58× 参数效率；且随 N 增大稳定提升，而部分 PRM 在 N=8→16 反而退化（如 72B PRM 31.33%→29.11%）。消融：CoT 38.89% → 单轮带环境 39.77% → 多轮带环境 39.77%（Hard 32.80%）→ 完整 DataPRM 40.89%（Hard 33.86%），增益在 Hard 子集最明显。过滤策略消融：不过滤在 N=16 最好（40.89%），Process Consistency 在 N=4 略优（38.00% vs 37.11%），说明"多样性优于纯净度"。搜索策略扩展：Beam Search 与 DVTS 下 DataPRM 全面领先且稳定（35.33%→38.00%→38.89%），对照 72B PRM 出现 reward hacking 式波动。推理成本：GenPRM 7061 token/1 turn/14.86s；Self-Rewarding 25283 token/3.32 turn/194.95s；DataPRM 21456 token/2.57 turn/24.66s（token 降 15.1%、turn 降 22.6%），并行沙箱优化后延迟降至 3.30s。RL 结果：以 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct 为基座，过程奖励训练在 DABench 达 78.73%、TableBench 达 64.84%，优于 SFT 与纯结果奖励；结果奖励训练在约 200 步后熵塌缩至 ~0.12 且奖励停滞，过程奖励保持熵 ~0.18 并持续上升，pass@3 也能提升。
AI.conclusion: 环境交互是数据分析场景过程监督的关键：只有通过主动执行探测真实数据环境，才能从根本上识别静默错误，静态文本推理式 PRM 存在结构性盲区；"可纠正错误"应当给予中性（0.5）奖励而非常规惩罚，以保留试错探索带来的信息增益——这一三元机制可由 POMDP 下的贝叶斯视角严格推导（奖励 = 任务进展 G 与隐藏环境信息增益 I 的加权组合，I 用 KL 散度近似）。此外，在探索空间巨大的场景中，监督样本的多样性比标注的严格专精（纯净度）更有利于 PRM 的可扩展性与区分能力。DataPRM 首次系统性地将 PRM 引入智能体式数据分析领域，为其他复杂智能体任务提供了可迁移的过程监督框架。局限包括：仅覆盖推理与可视化类分析而未涉及模型训练/预测等复杂工程任务；仅用 SFT 训练、依赖高质量人工核验轨迹，未来计划探索 RL 与 Skill 等低人工依赖的路线。

title: Institutions for the Post-Scarcity of Judgment
comment: 5 pages, 9 references. Submitted to Communications of the ACM (Opinion section). Comments welcome
summary: Each major technological revolution inverts a particular scarcity and rebuilds institutions around the shift. The near-consensus diagnosis of the AI revolution holds that AI collapses the cost of prediction while judgment remains scarce. This Opinion argues the inversion has now flipped: competent-looking judgment (selecting, ranking, attributing, certifying) is produced at scale and at marginal cost approaching zero, and four complements become scarce: verified signal, legitimacy, authentic provenance, and integration capacity (the community's tolerance for delegated cognition). Because judgment is the substance of institutions, the institutions built to manufacture legitimate judgment (courts, journals, licensing bodies, legislatures) now compete with the technology for the same functional role. The piece traces the pattern across scientific institutions, professional licensing, intellectual property, democratic legitimacy, and foundation-model concentration, and closes with a three-move agenda: reframe AI policy as institutional redesign, build provenance and verification as commons, and develop the formal apparatus for institutional composition under strategic agents.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文（Opinion），主张当前关于 AI 的主流共识已经过时：AI 并不只是让"预测"变便宜，而是让"看起来称职的判断"（选择、排序、归因、认证）以近乎零边际成本规模化生产，因此稀缺性已经翻转——判断成为新的丰裕品，而与之互补的四种要素成为新的稀缺品：可验证信号、合法性、真实溯源、整合能力。由于判断本身就是制度的产品，法院、期刊、执照机构、立法机关等"制造合法判断"的制度因此与技术争夺同一功能角色。作者沿科学制度、职业资格认证、知识产权、民主合法性、基础模型集中化五个领域追踪这一模式，并提出三步议程：把 AI 政策重构为制度再设计、把溯源与验证建成公共品（commons）、发展战略行为者条件下制度组合的形式化装置。
